aberration hunter.name: Aberration Hunter
aberration hunter.description: A githyanki wearing this amulet has Advantage on Intelligence Saving Throws. Aberrations also have Disadvantage on Attack Rolls against them. [See: Bugs]

ability drain.name: Ability Drain
ability drain.description: Once per turn, when you make an Attack Roll, the attack reduces that target's corresponding Ability by 1. The reduced ability score cannot be decreased lower than 1.

ablaze.name: Ablaze
ablaze.description: When the sphere is ablaze, it leaves behind a Fire surface and deals 2d6 Fire to nearby creatures and objects.

absolute night.name: Absolute Night
absolute night.description: Blind targets that fail a Dexterity Saving Throw. Deals an additional 2d6 Piercing to certain creatures that sport multiple sets of eyes.

absolute's aegis.name: Absolute's Aegis
absolute's aegis.description: If the wielder bears the Absolute's Brand, all damage received from spells is reduced by 1.

absolute's bane.name: Absolute's Bane
absolute's bane.description: On a hit with a weapon attack, possibly inflict a -1d4 penalty to the target's Attack Rolls and Saving Throws.

absolute's tempest.name: Absolute's Tempest
absolute's tempest.description: If the wearer bears the Absolute's Brand, they deal 1 additional Thunder damage with Thunder damage spells and attacks.

absolute's ward.name: Absolute's Ward
absolute's ward.description: If the wielder bears the Absolute's Brand, they gain a +1 bonus to Saving Throws.

absorb elements.name: Absorb Elements
absorb elements.description: Absorb elemental damage once per Short Rest. Take half damage from the next elemental attack targeting you, and deal an additional 1d6 of that element type on your next attack.

accretion.name: Accretion
accretion.description: The wearer gains Arcane Charge when they deal damage with close-quarter-range spells or close-quarter-range cantrips.

accursed coins.name: Accursed Coins
accursed coins.description: This cursed visage controls part of the coins protecting the Toll Collector.

accursed spectre.name: Accursed Spectre
accursed spectre.description: When you or an ally within 18 m (60 ft) slay a creature that is afflicted with Hexblade's Curse, you can raise an Accursed Spectre that will fight alongside you for a short period of time.

acolyte of nature.name: Acolyte of Nature
acolyte of nature.description:
Learn one of the following Druid cantrips:
* Poison Spray
* Produce Flame
* Shillelagh
* Thorn Whip
Get one of the following proficiencies:
* Animal Handling
* Nature
* Survival

actor.name: Actor
actor.description: You have become a true thespian. Your Charisma increases by 1, to a maximum of 20 [See: Bugs] . Your Proficiency Bonus is doubled for Deception and Performance Checks.

adamantine backlash.name: Adamantine Backlash
adamantine backlash.description: When a melee attack hits you, the attacker is sent Reeling for 2 turns.

adamantine shield.name: Adamantine Shield
adamantine shield.description: When a melee attack misses you, the attacker is sent Reeling for 2 turns.

adamantine skin.name: Adamantine Skin
adamantine skin.description: Made entirely from adamantine, this mass is about as heavy as a dragon, and nearly as indestructible. Only intense heat can soften the metal enough to be shaped.

adaptable skullduggery.name: Adaptable Skullduggery
adaptable skullduggery.description: This creature can perform a Sneak Attack with any weapon, not only those marked as Finesse.

adrenaline rush.name: Adrenaline Rush
adrenaline rush.description: When you Dash you gain Wrath for 3 turns. [See: Bugs]

adroit caster.name: Adroit Caster
adroit caster.description: Cantrips targeting foes and allies can target an additional creature. The same target can be chosen twice. Usable once per short rest.

adroit reflexes.name: Adroit Reflexes
adroit reflexes.description: When you make an Attack Roll as a Reaction, you make it with Advantage.

advanced unarmoured movement.name: Advanced Unarmoured Movement
advanced unarmoured movement.description: Difficult Terrain doesn't slow you down and you can Jump an additional 6 m (20 ft) while you are not wearing armour or using a shield.

aegis palms.name: Aegis Palms
aegis palms.description: When you heal a creature, it gains the effect of Blade Ward. When you Revive a creature it gains the effect of Death Ward.

after death do us part.name: After Death Do Us Part
after death do us part.description: When the wearer is Downed, they rise once more with half their Hit Points restored, but are gripped by Shadow Possession.

agile chassis.name: Agile Chassis
agile chassis.description: The lightweight build of this Steel Watcher grants it Advantage on Dexterity Saving Throws and an additional 9 m (30 ft) movement speed.

agonising blast.name: Agonising Blast
agonising blast.description: When you cast Eldritch Blast, add your Charisma Modifier to the damage it deals, unless it is negative.

alert.name: Alert
alert.description: You gain +5 to Initiative and can no longer be surprised.

ambusher.name: Ambusher
ambusher.description: Gain a +1 bonus to Initiative Rolls.

ambusher's streak.name: Ambusher's Streak
ambusher's streak.description: In combat, you deal an additional 1d6 Necrotic damage against creatures that haven't taken a turn yet.

angelclocker knuckles.name: Angelclocker Knuckles
angelclocker knuckles.description: Your unarmed attacks deal an additional 1d4 Radiant damage.

antimagic susceptibility.name: Antimagic Susceptibility
antimagic susceptibility.description: Held together by the Weave itself, this armour is Incapacitated by antimagic fields.

arcane absorption.name: Arcane Absorption
arcane absorption.description: When you kill an enemy with a melee attack, regain one of your spent 1st Level spell slots.

arcane ashes.name: Arcane Ashes
arcane ashes.description: Whenever you deal Fire damage, you gain 2 turns of Heat.

arcane battery.name: Arcane Battery
arcane battery.description: Alleviate the arcane burden of spellcasting with the power of this staff. The next spell you cast doesn't cost a spell slot.

arcane echomalefaction.name: Arcane Echomalefaction
arcane echomalefaction.description: When the wearer inflicts a condition upon a hostile creature, they also inflict 2 turns of Reverberation. [See: Bugs]

arcane enchantment.name: Arcane Enchantment
arcane enchantment.description: You gain a +1 bonus to Spell Save DC and Spell Attack rolls.

arcane radiance.name: Arcane Radiance
arcane radiance.description: When the wearer deals spell damage while illuminated by a light source, they also inflict Radiating Orb upon the target for 2 turns.

arcane vampirism.name: Arcane Vampirism
arcane vampirism.description: When the creatures affected by your spells fail any associated Saving Throws, you regain 1d4 Hit Points .

arcane vehemence.name: Arcane Vehemence
arcane vehemence.description: Once per Short Rest, you regain a Level 1 spell slot when you land a Critical Hit with the Spellthief.

arcane vivaciousness.name: Arcane Vivaciousness
arcane vivaciousness.description: You gain 8 temporary hit points after casting a spell while in melee.

arcane ward.name: Arcane Ward
arcane ward.description: The residual magic of your spells forms a ward around you that protects you from harm.

archery.name: Archery
archery.description: You gain a +2 bonus to Attack Rolls you make with ranged Weapons.

arctic.name: Arctic
arctic.description: You can cast Hold Person and Spike Growth.

arming enhancement.name: Arming Enhancement
arming enhancement.description: Gain a +2 Bonus to attack and damage rolls with weapons.

armour of agathys.name: Armour of Agathys
armour of agathys.description: A spectral frost covers you and your gear. When a creature hits you with a melee attack, it takes 5 x spell level Cold .

armour of hexes.name: Armour of Hexes
armour of hexes.description: When a creature you cursed with Hexblade's Curse attacks you, potentially nullify the attack as a reaction. This has a 50% chance of succeeding.

armour of shadows.name: Armour of Shadows
armour of shadows.description: You can cast Mage Armour on yourself at will, without expending a Spell Slot. Mage Armour increases your Armour Class when you are not wearing armour.

army arcana.name: Army Arcana
army arcana.description: Create pockets of safety within your spells. Allies automatically succeed their Saving Throws against these spells and take no damage from them.

artificer's lore.name: Artificer's Lore
artificer's lore.description: Add twice your Proficiency Bonus to History checks.

artificial sight.name: Artificial Sight
artificial sight.description: The wearer can see in the dark up to 12 m (40 ft) and cannot be Blinded.

aspect of the beast: bear.name: Aspect of the Beast: Bear
aspect of the beast: bear.description:
The Aspect of the Bear infuses you with strength.
Your Carrying Capacity is doubled, and you have Advantage on Strength Checks.

aspect of the beast: chimpanzee.name: Aspect of the Beast: Chimpanzee
aspect of the beast: chimpanzee.description:
The Aspect of the Chimpanzee grants you a nimble mischievousness.
You gain Resistance to falling damage, and throwing camp supplies Blinds targets.

aspect of the beast: crocodile.name: Aspect of the Beast: Crocodile
aspect of the beast: crocodile.description:
The Aspect of the Crocodile increases your agility in the water.
Your Movement Speed increases by 3 m (10 ft) while standing in water-based surfaces.
On slippery surfaces, you also have Advantage on Saving Throws against being knocked Prone

aspect of the beast: eagle.name: Aspect of the Beast: Eagle
aspect of the beast: eagle.description:
The Aspect of the Eagle enhances your eyesight.
You can see in the dark up to 12 m (40 ft), and gain Advantage on Perception Checks.

aspect of the beast: elk.name: Aspect of the Beast: Elk
aspect of the beast: elk.description:
The Aspect of the Elk grants you astounding swiftness.
You can use Aspect of the Elk, giving yourself and nearby allies extra Movement Speed.

aspect of the beast: honey badger.name: Aspect of the Beast: Honey Badger
aspect of the beast: honey badger.description: If you're Poisoned, Frightened, or Charmed at the start of your turn, you have a 50% chance to begin Raging without expending a Rage Charge.

aspect of the beast: stallion.name: Aspect of the Beast: Stallion
aspect of the beast: stallion.description:
The Aspect of the Stallion creates safety in movement.
Dashing grants you temporary hit points equal to twice your Barbarian level.

aspect of the beast: tiger.name: Aspect of the Beast: Tiger
aspect of the beast: tiger.description:
The Aspect of the Tiger infuses you with an unrelenting ferocity.
You add an additional Strength Modifier to Attack Rolls against Bleeding or Poisoned targets, and gain Proficiency in Survival

aspect of the beast: wolf.name: Aspect of the Beast: Wolf
aspect of the beast: wolf.description:
The Aspect of the Wolf boosts your stealthiness.
You gain Proficiency in Stealth, and can use Aspect of the Wolf.

aspect of the beast: wolverine.name: Aspect of the Beast: Wolverine
aspect of the beast: wolverine.description:
The Aspect of the Wolverine grants you the tools to relentlessly pursue your prey.
When you attack a Bleeding or Poisoned target, you also Maim it for 1 turn

assassin's alacrity.name: Assassin's Alacrity
assassin's alacrity.description: Quick as an alley cat in a rain-dark city, you immediately restore your Action and Bonus Action at the start of combat

assassinate: ambush.name: Assassinate: Ambush
assassinate: ambush.description: Any successful Attack Roll against a Surprised creature is a Critical Hit.

assassinate: initiative.name: Assassinate: Initiative
assassinate: initiative.description: You are deadliest against unprepared enemies. In combat, you have Advantage on Attack Rolls against creatures that haven't taken a turn yet.

athlete: standing up.name: Athlete: Standing Up
athlete: standing up.description: When you are Prone, standing up uses significantly less movement. Your Jump distance also increases by 50%.

aura of murder.name: Aura of Murder
aura of murder.description: Enemies within 3 m (10 ft) become Vulnerable to Piercing damage, unless they are Immune to it.

authority.name: Authority
authority.description: You have Advantage on Intimidation checks and Insight checks.

aversion of fire.name: Aversion of Fire
aversion of fire.description: If this entity takes Fire damage, it receives Disadvantage on Attack Rolls and Ability Checks until the end of its next turn.

awakened.name: Awakened
awakened.description: You can use all of your Illithid Powers as a Bonus Action. Your resistance to the zaith'isk in the githyanki infirmary awakened this power.

balance.name: Balance
balance.description: Gain a +1 bonus to Dexterity Saving Throws and Ability Checks

balduran's favour.name: Balduran's Favour
balduran's favour.description: You have a +1 bonus to Armour Class and Saving Throws.

balduran's vitality.name: Balduran's Vitality
balduran's vitality.description: The helmet heals you 2 Hit Points at the beginning of every turn.

baneful bond.name: Baneful Bond
baneful bond.description: On a hit, possibly Bane your target.

baneful strike.name: Baneful Strike
baneful strike.description: Whenever you deal damage with a weapon attack, the target receives a -1d4 penalty to its Saving Throw against your next spell.

bardic roll.name: Bardic Roll
bardic roll.description: Add a +1d6 bonus to your next Ability Check.

battle acuity.name: Battle Acuity
battle acuity.description: Whenever you deal damage with a weapon attack, you gain Arcane Acuity for 2 turns.

battlemage's power.name: Battlemage's Power
battlemage's power.description: When you hit a target with a spell or cantrip that uses a weapon, you gain Arcane Acuity.

bear heart.name: Bear Heart
bear heart.description: While Raging, you can use Unrelenting Ferocity, and have Resistance to all damage except Psychic damage.

beast speech.name: Beast Speech
beast speech.description: You can cast Speak with Animals on yourself at will, without expending a Spell Slot.

beast tamer.name: Beast Tamer
beast tamer.description: You have cultivated a strong bond with animals. You can cast Find Familiar without expending a spell slot.

become the bulwark.name: Become the Bulwark
become the bulwark.description: You gain a +2 bonus to Armour Class as long as you are not wearing armour or holding a shield.

beguiling defences.name: Beguiling Defences
beguiling defences.description: You have built stoic barriers in your heart and mind, and cannot be Charmed.

beguiling influence.name: Beguiling Influence
beguiling influence.description: You invoke your patron's bewitching charm. You gain Proficiency in Deception and Persuasion.

bend luck.name: Bend Luck
bend luck.description: When a creature you can see makes an Attack Roll, Ability Check, or a Saving Throw, you can use your reaction and spend 2 Sorcery Points to roll 1d4, applying the number rolled as a bonus or penalty (your choice) to the creature's roll.

berserk.name: Berserk
berserk.description: This entity will go Berserk if its health diminishes.

bestial fury.name: Bestial Fury
bestial fury.description: Grants all your companions an extra attack.

blazing hide.name: Blazing Hide
blazing hide.description: When the hellsboar is hit with a melee attack, the attacker starts Burning for 3 turns.

blessed healer.name: Blessed Healer
blessed healer.description:
Healing others heals you as well.
When you cast a healing spell of Level 1 or higher on another creature, you regain hit points equal to 2 + the spell's level Hit Points .

blessed mercy.name: Blessed Mercy
blessed mercy.description: When you heal a creature, it gains a +1d4 bonus to Attack Rolls and Saving Throws for 2 turns.

blessings of knowledge.name: Blessings of Knowledge
blessings of knowledge.description: Gain Expertise in two of the following Skills: Arcana, History, Nature, or Religion. Your Proficiency Bonus is doubled for Ability Checks made using these Skills.

blightbringer.name: Blightbringer
blightbringer.description: Attacking Gnomes or Dwarves with this weapon receives a 1d4 bonus to Attack and Damage rolls.

blindsight.name: Blindsight
blindsight.description: This creature can perceive its surroundings without relying on sight.

blood thirst.name: Blood Thirst
blood thirst.description: Unarmed and melee attacks will deal an extra 2 Necrotic damage as long as you don't have your full health. If you don't deal any damage this turn, you will take 1d4 Necrotic damage at the end of your turn.

blood-curdling emission.name: Blood-Curdling Emission
blood-curdling emission.description: On a hit, possibly inflict Frightened ( DC 12 Wisdom Saving Throw). Gain a +1d4 bonus to attack and damage against Frightened creatures.

body aid.name: Body Aid
body aid.description: Gain a +1 bonus to Strength Saving Throws and Ability Checks.

bolstering critical.name: Bolstering Critical
bolstering critical.description: When scoring a Critical Hit or killing a hostile creature, wearer gains 15 temporary hit points.

bolstering smite.name: Bolstering Smite
bolstering smite.description: When you apply a condition with one of your Smite spells, you gain Temporary Hit Points equal to your Charisma modifier.

book of ancient secrets.name: Book of Ancient Secrets
book of ancient secrets.description:
You can inscribe magical rituals in your Book of Shadows. Gain Ray of Sickness, Chromatic Orb, and Silence spells.
You can cast them once per Long Rest and they don't expend spell slots

booming blows.name: Booming Blows
booming blows.description: Your unarmed attacks deal an additional 1d4 Thunder damage.

boon of the raven queen.name: Boon of the Raven Queen
boon of the raven queen.description: While wearing the amulet, the wearer's jump and flying speed increase by 1.5 m (5 ft), and they gain the Feather Fall condition. Feather Fall's effect will persist while the wearer is Polymorphed or Wild-Shaped.

boooal's faithful.name: BOOOAL's Faithful
boooal's faithful.description: Chance to apply Bleeding to targets.

booze remedy.name: Booze Remedy
booze remedy.description: While wearing this amulet, regain 2d4 Hit Points per turn while Drunk. Additionally, increase the duration of your inebriation by 5 rounds.

born into darkness.name: Born into Darkness
born into darkness.description: This creature can see through magical and non-magical darkness, and cannot be Blinded.

bounty hunter.name: Bounty Hunter
bounty hunter.description: Gain Proficiency in Investigation. Creatures you hit with Ensnaring Strike (either ranged or melee) have Disadvantage on their Saving Throw.

brave.name: Brave
brave.description: You have Advantage on Saving Throws against Frightened.

break the unbroken.name: Break the Unbroken
break the unbroken.description: Deals an additional 1d8 Piercing to targets that still have all their hit points.

breezeswift speed.name: Breezeswift Speed
breezeswift speed.description: While using Step of the Wind, your next Attack Roll has Advantage and deals an additional 1d8 Force damage.

browbeaten.name: Browbeaten
browbeaten.description: The wearer gains a +1 bonus to spell save DC while Threatened.

brutal critical.name: Brutal Critical
brutal critical.description: You've trained to strike swift and true. When you land a Critical Hit, you roll an extra damage die as well as the normal additional critical die.

brute.name: Brute
brute.description: Deals an extra 1d8 Physical when attacking with a melee weapon.

bull's strength.name: Bull's Strength
bull's strength.description: You gain Bull's Strength and increase your Strength by 2, to a maximum of 20.

burned alive.name: Burned Alive
burned alive.description: Deals an additional 1d4 Weapon damage to Burning targets.

burning fury.name: Burning Fury
burning fury.description: When dealing Fire damage, the wearer deals an additional 1 Fire .

burst of speed.name: Burst of Speed
burst of speed.description: When the wearer has 50% Hit Points or less, their Movement Speed is increased by 3 m (10 ft).

callous glow.name: Callous Glow
callous glow.description: The wearer deals an additional 2 points of Radiant [See: Bugs] damage against creatures that are illuminated.

careful veil.name: Careful Veil
careful veil.description: This creature has Disadvantage on Dexterity Saving Throws while Invisible.

caretaker's care.name: Caretaker's Care
caretaker's care.description: Acidic surfaces don't affect you, and you are Resistant to Acid damage.

cat's grace.name: Cat's Grace
cat's grace.description: You gain Cat's Grace and increase your Dexterity by 2, to a maximum of 20.

caustic reprisal.name: Caustic Reprisal
caustic reprisal.description: Whenever a creature deals melee damage to the wearer, that creature takes 1d4 Acid Damage.

caustic strikes.name: Caustic Strikes
caustic strikes.description: This creature's attack deals additional 4d8 Acid damage and may inflict Paralysed.

cauteriser.name: Cauteriser
cauteriser.description: Deals an additional 1d4 Fire . On a hit, the target starts Burning unless it succeeds a Constitution Saving Throw.

cautious healer.name: Cautious Healer
cautious healer.description: When the wearer heals a creature, it automatically Disengages and won't trigger Opportunity Attacks.

channel divinity: guided strike.name: Channel Divinity: Guided Strike
channel divinity: guided strike.description: Channel the guidance of your god to strike with supernatural accuracy. You gain a +10 bonus to your Attack Roll.

channel divinity: touch of death.name: Channel Divinity: Touch of Death
channel divinity: touch of death.description: When hitting a creature with a melee attack, Channel Divinity Charge can be used to deal extra 5 + 2 × (Cleric level) Necrotic damage.

channel divinity: war god's blessing.name: Channel Divinity: War God's Blessing
channel divinity: war god's blessing.description: Endow a nearby ally with the glory of your god to grant them a +10 bonus to their Attack Roll.

chaos.name: Chaos
chaos.description: On dealing damage with this weapon, regain 1d6 Hit Points . [See Notes]

charger.name: Charger
charger.description: Let your speed intensify your onslaught. You can Shove or deal additional Weapon Damage when you attack.

charm.name: Charm
charm.description: Channel the dark allure of the tadpole to Charm an enemy that attacks you, preventing them from attacking you until their next turn.

cheeky tipple.name: Cheeky Tipple
cheeky tipple.description: You are Immune to the negative effects of being Drunk. Once per day, when you drink alcohol, you regain half your Ki Points (rounded down).

child of the moonmaiden.name: Child of the Moonmaiden
child of the moonmaiden.description: Blessed with the favour of a goddess, Nightsong cannot be permanently killed. When unconscious, the start of her turn she recovers 1 hit point.

chilling counter.name: Chilling Counter
chilling counter.description: When a creature misses you with an attack, it receives Chilled for 2 turns. [See: Bugs]

chilling grace.name: Chilling Grace
chilling grace.description: When the wearer has 50% Hit Points or less, they have Resistance to Fire damage.

chilling strike.name: Chilling Strike
chilling strike.description: Your unarmed attacks deal an additional 1d4 Cold damage.

chilling strikes.name: Chilling Strikes
chilling strikes.description: Your strikes Bone Chill your target. They cannot regain hit points and if they are undead they have disadvantage on attack rolls.

cinders.name: Cinders
cinders.description: Whenever you Burn an enemy, you gain 2 turns of Heat.

civil militia.name: Civil Militia
civil militia.description:
You have weapon proficiency with:
* Spears
* Pikes
* Halberds
* Glaives
* Light armour
* Shields

cleansing touch.name: Cleansing Touch
cleansing touch.description: If the wearer heals a Poisoned creature, it is no longer poisoned.

cloud of jellyfish.name: Cloud of Jellyfish
cloud of jellyfish.description: You gain a swarm of jellyfish that fights on your side. Once per round, the swarm can assist you in one of three ways after you attack an enemy: it can attack and deal additional Lightning damage, Shock your enemy, or teleport you to a safer location.

coast.name: Coast
coast.description: You can cast Mirror Image and Misty Step.

coin armour.name: Coin Armour
coin armour.description: Armoured in enchanted coins, this creature is a clinking emblem of golden greed. Could there be a method of removing the armour without destroying the coins?

coldbrim chill.name: Coldbrim Chill
coldbrim chill.description: Once per turn, any condition inflicted on a target, also applies 2 turns of Encrusted with Frost. [See: Bugs]

colossus slayer.name: Colossus Slayer
colossus slayer.description: Once per turn, your weapon attack deals an extra 1d8 Physical DRS damage if the target is below its hit point maximum.

combat regeneration.name: Combat Regeneration
combat regeneration.description: At the beginning of your turn, the ring activates and heals you 1d4 Hit Points .

companion's bond.name: Companion's Bond
companion's bond.description: Your Ranger's Companions receive a bonus to Armour Class and damage equal to its Proficiency Bonus.

conductive strikes.name: Conductive Strikes
conductive strikes.description: On a hit with an unarmed attack, the wearer gains 2 Lightning Charges.

consume life essence.name: Consume Life Essence
consume life essence.description: Consume the life essence that you have collected to cast any Necromancy spell without consuming a spell slot.

consume the faithful.name: Consume the Faithful
consume the faithful.description:
Consume a necromite's soul to gain the ability to cast Finger of Death.
Tactician and above:
Also heals the caster for 8d8 Hit Points .

consumed shadow weave.name: Consumed Shadow Weave
consumed shadow weave.description: Gale has gained a level 3 spell slot. It restores on a Long Rest.

controlled chaos.name: Controlled Chaos
controlled chaos.description: Foes may suffer a Wild Magic Surge while casting spells near your fluctuating magic.

corellon's guiding hand.name: Corellon's Guiding Hand
corellon's guiding hand.description: You gain Proficiency with Longbows and Shortbows. In addition, your ranged weapon attacks deal an additional 2 damage.

cosmic omen.name: Cosmic Omen
cosmic omen.description: Whenever you Long Rest, you consult the stars for a Cosmic Omen of Weal or of Woe. The omen grants you the ability to increase (Weal) or decrease (Woe) Attack Rolls or Saving Throws, or (Weal only) to increase your allies' Ability Checks.

countershock.name: Countershock
countershock.description: When the wearer takes damage while having Lightning Charges, the attacker must succeed a Dexterity Saving Throw or become Shocked.

covert critical.name: Covert Critical
covert critical.description: While obscured, the number you need to roll a Critical Hit while attacking is reduced by 1. This effect can stack.

crackling resonance.name: Crackling Resonance
crackling resonance.description: When the wearer deals damage with a ranged Spell Attack, inflict 2 turns of Reverberation on the target(s).

craterous wounds.name: Craterous Wounds
craterous wounds.description: Whenever you score a Critical Hit, deal an additional 1d6 Force DRS damage.

crimson weapon.name: Crimson Weapon
crimson weapon.description: When you make an attack with your off-hand weapon, you can add your Ability Modifier to the damage of the attack.

critical swiftness.name: Critical Swiftness
critical swiftness.description: After scoring a Critical Hit or killing a hostile creature, movement speed is restored to maximum.

critical virtuoso.name: Critical Virtuoso
critical virtuoso.description: When you score a Critical Hit you can spend a Bonus Action to make an additional attack.

crossbow expert: point-blank.name: Crossbow Expert: Point-Blank
crossbow expert: point-blank.description: When you make crossbow attacks within melee range, the Attack Rolls do not have Disadvantage.

crossbow expert: wounding.name: Crossbow Expert: Wounding
crossbow expert: wounding.description: Your Piercing Shot inflicts Gaping Wounds for twice as long.

crowning glory.name: Crowning Glory
crowning glory.description: When healing another, the wearer regains 1d6 Hit Points .

crude frenzy.name: Crude Frenzy
crude frenzy.description: This goblin can make an additional free attack after making a Main Hand Attack, but the second attack has Disadvantage on its Attack Roll.

cruel shove.name: Cruel Shove
cruel shove.description: You deal 1d4 Force damage when you Shove a creature.

crushing blows.name: Crushing Blows
crushing blows.description: The wearer gains a +1 bonus to unarmed Attack Rolls and their unarmed attacks deal an additional 2 Bludgeoning damage.

cull the weak.name: Cull the Weak
cull the weak.description: When you bring a creature down to fewer hit points than your number of evolved illithid powers, it dies and all nearby creatures take 1~4 Psychic damage.

culling strikes.name: Culling Strikes
culling strikes.description: The Mental Image creates a new Mental Image each time it hits a character with an attack.

cunning brume.name: Cunning Brume
cunning brume.description: When the wearer Disengages, they also create a foggy cloud with 2 m (7 ft) radius that lasts for 1 turn.

cunning combo.name: Cunning Combo
cunning combo.description: When you shoot a target at close range, you can make an additional melee attack against it as a Reaction.

cursed vengeance.name: Cursed Vengeance
cursed vengeance.description: Oliver's Nightdome won't allow for you to hurt him. Any damage done to the dome will be reflected in twofold to its attacker.

curving shot.name: Curving Shot
curving shot.description: When you miss with any magical ranged attack, use a Bonus Action to attack the next closest target with the same attack.

cutting words.name: Cutting Words
cutting words.description: Use your wit to distract a creature and sap its confidence.

dagger specialist.name: Dagger Specialist
dagger specialist.description: This creature can throw up to 3 daggers per round.

dagger thrower.name: Dagger Thrower
dagger thrower.description: This creature adds double their Proficiency Bonus to the damage they deal on ranged attacks made with daggers.

damp aegis.name: Damp Aegis
damp aegis.description: During Combat, once per turn, the cloak grants the wearer Water Layer Protection [See: Bugs] until the wearer takes damage.

dampen elements.name: Dampen Elements
dampen elements.description: When you or an ally gets hit with Acid , Cold , Fire , Lightning , or Thunder damage, you can use your reaction to halve the attack's damage.

danger sense.name: Danger Sense
danger sense.description:
You sense when things aren't as they should be.
You have Advantage on Dexterity Saving Throws, such as against traps, spells, and surfaces.
To gain this benefit, you can't be Blinded or Incapacitated.

daredevil proximity.name: Daredevil Proximity
daredevil proximity.description: Your Ranged Spell Attacks are made as melee spell attacks when you are adjacent to a hostile creature. This effect can be toggled off.

dark devotion.name: Dark Devotion
dark devotion.description: Grants Advantage on saving throws against being Charmed or Frightened.

dark one's blessing.name: Dark One's Blessing
dark one's blessing.description: Whenever you reduce a hostile creature to 0 Hit Points, this gift from your patron grants you Charisma modifier + Warlock level temporary hit points.

dark one's own luck.name: Dark One's Own Luck
dark one's own luck.description: Call on your patron to change your fate and add a 1d10 to an Ability Check.

dark vengeance.name: Dark Vengeance
dark vengeance.description: The Justiciar has advantage against targets standing in darkness.

darkveil precision.name: Darkveil Precision
darkveil precision.description: While obscured in shadow, the wielder has a +1d4 bonus to their ranged weapon attacks.

darkvision.name: Darkvision
darkvision.description: Can see in the dark up to 12 m (40 ft).

dauntless.name: Dauntless
dauntless.description: You can't be Frightened or afflicted with other emotion-altering conditions.

dazing echo.name: Dazing Echo
dazing echo.description: When a creature with Reverberation deals damage to the wearer, the creature needs to make a DC 13 Constitution Saving Throw or become Dazed.

dazing smite.name: Dazing Smite
dazing smite.description: On a hit infused with one of your Smites, the target must succeed a Constitution Saving Throw or become Dazed.

dazzling blows.name: Dazzling Blows
dazzling blows.description: Attacks from this creature can possibly Blind the target.

deadly derivation.name: Deadly Derivation
deadly derivation.description: When you Poison a foe, heal yourself for 1d4 Hit Points .

death burst: cold.name: Death Burst: Cold
death burst: cold.description: When the mephit dies, it explodes in a burst of ice that deals 2d6 Cold damage to all creatures within 2 m (7 ft).

death burst: fire.name: Death Burst: Fire
death burst: fire.description: When the mephit dies, it explodes in a burst of lava that deals 2d6 Fire damage to all creatures within 2 m (7 ft).

death burst: force.name: Death Burst: Force
death burst: force.description: When the mephit dies, it explodes with a force that deals 2d6 Force damage to all creatures within 2 m (7 ft).

death drinker.name: Death Drinker
death drinker.description: Gain 2d10 temporary hit points when landing a killing blow on an enemy with this weapon.

death's promise.name: Death's Promise
death's promise.description: When the spear misses its target, the wielder's next Attack Roll against that target gains True Strike.

deathbringer's sight.name: Deathbringer's Sight
deathbringer's sight.description: You can see in the dark up to 3 m (10 ft). The number you need to roll a Critical Hit while attacking is reduced by one. This effect can stack.

deathly slumber.name: Deathly Slumber
deathly slumber.description: Deals an additional 1d4 Necrotic to creatures that are Knocked Out or Sleeping.

deepen the wound.name: Deepen the Wound
deepen the wound.description: The wielder gains a +1d4 bonus to Attack Rolls with this weapon when attacking creatures that have already taken damage.

deepened pact.name: Deepened Pact
deepened pact.description: Pleased with your service, your otherworldly patron added new boons to the terms of your pact.

deepflesh slice.name: Deepflesh Slice
deepflesh slice.description: When the wielder attacks with Advantage, the attack inflicts Bleeding.

defence.name: Defence
defence.description: You gain a +1 bonus to Armour Class while wearing armour.

defensive attack.name: Defensive Attack
defensive attack.description: When making your first attack of the round, you can reduce this weapon's enchantment by 1 to increase your Armour Class and Saving Throw bonus by 1.

defensive duellist.name: Defensive Duellist
defensive duellist.description: When attacked while wielding a Finesse Weapon you're Proficient with, you can use a Reaction to add your Proficiency Bonus to your Armour Class, possibly causing the attack to miss.

defier's rejuvenation.name: Defier's Rejuvenation
defier's rejuvenation.description: Whenever the wearer succeeds on a Saving Throw against a Spell, they regain 1d4 Hit Points .

deflect missiles.name: Deflect Missiles
deflect missiles.description: Use your reaction to reduce the damage from a ranged weapon attack by 1d10 + your Dexterity Modifier + your monk level.

defy villainy.name: Defy Villainy
defy villainy.description: When the wearer becomes Blinded, Paralysed or Poisoned, they automatically cast Lesser Restoration on themselves.

demonspirit aura.name: Demonspirit Aura
demonspirit aura.description:
The wearer's summoned creatures have resistance to all damage except Psychic damage.
At the start of the summoned creatures turn, it must succeed a Wisdom Saving Throw or be driven Mad.

desert.name: Desert
desert.description: You can cast Blur and Silence.

destroy undead.name: Destroy Undead
destroy undead.description: When you successfully Turn an Undead creature, it also takes 4d6 Radiant .

destructive wrath.name: Destructive Wrath
destructive wrath.description: When you roll Thunder or Lightning damage, you can use your Channel Divinity to deal maximum damage instead.

devil's sight.name: Devil's Sight
devil's sight.description: You can see normally in darkness, both magical and non-magical, to a distance of 24 m (80 ft).

dextrous evasion.name: Dextrous Evasion
dextrous evasion.description: When you fail a Dexterity Saving Throw, you can use your Reaction to succeed instead.

diamondsbane.name: Diamondsbane
diamondsbane.description: If an adamantine weapon hits an object, the hit is always critical.

disciple of life.name: Disciple of Life
disciple of life.description: Your devotion empowers your healing Spells. When casting a healing spell, the target regains additional hit points equal to 2 + the spell's level Hit Points .

displace.name: Displace
displace.description: Creatures suffering Falling damage because of your actions take an additional 1d8 Psychic damage.

displacement.name: Displacement
displacement.description: At the beginning of the wearer's turn, the cloak activates, granting enemies Disadvantage on Attack Rolls that target the wearer. This effect lasts until the wearer takes damage.

divine allegiance.name: Divine Allegiance
divine allegiance.description: When an ally within 1.5 m (5 ft) of you takes damage, you can use your Reaction to magically substitute your own health for your ally's, healing them by 2 × (Paladin level) Hit Points at the cost of taking 2 × (Paladin level) Radiant damage yourself.

divine health.name: Divine Health
divine health.description: The divine magic flowing within you prevents disease from affecting you.

dolor amarus.name: Dolor Amarus
dolor amarus.description: When you land a Critical Hit with a weapon or unarmed attack, [See: Bugs] it deals an additional 7 damage.

domain spells.name: Domain Spells
domain spells.description: You gain spells from your domain. They are Always Prepared.

doom lobber.name: Doom Lobber
doom lobber.description: The wearer gains a +1 bonus to Spell Attack Rolls.

draconic ancestry.name: Draconic Ancestry
draconic ancestry.description: The blood of ancient dragons flow through your veins. You are Resistant to Acid damage.

draconic ancestry: black (acid).name: Draconic Ancestry: Black (Acid)
draconic ancestry: black (acid).description: Starting at Level 6, spells that deal Acid damage deal additional damage equal to your Charisma modifier, and you can become resistant to acid via Elemental Affinity: Resistance.

draconic ancestry: blue (lightning).name: Draconic Ancestry: Blue (Lightning)
draconic ancestry: blue (lightning).description: Starting at Level 6, spells that deal Lightning damage deal additional damage equal to your Charisma modifier, and you can become resistant to lightning via Elemental Affinity: Resistance.

draconic ancestry: brass (fire).name: Draconic Ancestry: Brass (Fire)
draconic ancestry: brass (fire).description: Starting at Level 6, spells that deal Fire damage deal additional damage equal to your Charisma modifier, and you can become resistant to fire via Elemental Affinity: Resistance.

draconic ancestry: bronze (lightning).name: Draconic Ancestry: Bronze (Lightning)
draconic ancestry: bronze (lightning).description: Starting at Level 6, spells that deal Lightning damage deal additional damage equal to your Charisma modifier, and you can become resistant to lightning via Elemental Affinity: Resistance.

draconic ancestry: copper (acid).name: Draconic Ancestry: Copper (Acid)
draconic ancestry: copper (acid).description: Starting at Level 6, spells that deal Acid damage deal additional damage equal to your Charisma modifier, and you can become resistant to acid via Elemental Affinity: Resistance.

draconic ancestry: gold (fire).name: Draconic Ancestry: Gold (Fire)
draconic ancestry: gold (fire).description: Starting at Level 6, spells that deal Fire damage deal additional damage equal to your Charisma modifier, and you can become resistant to fire via Elemental Affinity: Resistance.

draconic ancestry: green (poison).name: Draconic Ancestry: Green (Poison)
draconic ancestry: green (poison).description: Starting at Level 6, spells that deal Poison damage deal additional damage equal to your Charisma modifier, and you can become resistant to poison via Elemental Affinity: Resistance.

draconic ancestry: red (fire).name: Draconic Ancestry: Red (Fire)
draconic ancestry: red (fire).description: Starting at Level 6, spells that deal Fire damage deal additional damage equal to your Charisma modifier, and you can become resistant to fire via Elemental Affinity: Resistance.

draconic ancestry: silver (cold).name: Draconic Ancestry: Silver (Cold)
draconic ancestry: silver (cold).description: Starting at Level 6, spells that deal Cold damage deal additional damage equal to your Charisma modifier, and you can become resistant to cold via Elemental Affinity: Resistance.

draconic ancestry: white (cold).name: Draconic Ancestry: White (Cold)
draconic ancestry: white (cold).description: Starting at Level 6, spells that deal Cold damage deal additional damage equal to your Charisma modifier, and you can become resistant to cold via Elemental Affinity: Resistance.

draconic resilience.name: Draconic Resilience
draconic resilience.description: Dragon-like scales cover parts of your skin. When you aren't wearing armour, your base Armour Class is 13.

dragonfire fists.name: Dragonfire Fists
dragonfire fists.description: Your unarmed attacks deal an additional 1d4 Fire .

dread ambusher.name: Dread Ambusher
dread ambusher.description:
You specialise in taking out foes swiftly and ruthlessly.
You gain a +3 bonus to Initiative.
On the first turn of combat, your Movement Speed increases by 3 m (10 ft), and you can also make an extra weapon attack that deals an additional 1d8 damage

dread iron ambush.name: Dread Iron Ambush
dread iron ambush.description: While its wielder is hidden, this weapon deals an extra 1d6 Necrotic .

dreadful hewer.name: Dreadful Hewer
dreadful hewer.description: Your foes have Disadvantage on Saving Throws to resist your spells or actions that inflict Fear.

dreadful word.name: Dreadful Word
dreadful word.description: You can cast Confusion with a Warlock spell slot.

dreamlike aura: acid.name: Dreamlike Aura: Acid
dreamlike aura: acid.description: Staying close to this creature grants Resistance to Acid damage.

dreamlike aura: cold.name: Dreamlike Aura: Cold
dreamlike aura: cold.description: Staying close to this creature grants Resistance to Cold damage.

dreamlike aura: fire.name: Dreamlike Aura: Fire
dreamlike aura: fire.description: Staying close to this creature grants Resistance to Fire damage.

dreamlike aura: lightning.name: Dreamlike Aura: Lightning
dreamlike aura: lightning.description: Staying close to this creature grants Resistance to Lightning damage.

dreamlike aura: poison.name: Dreamlike Aura: Poison
dreamlike aura: poison.description: Staying close to this creature grants Resistance to Poison damage.

drow weapon training.name: Drow Weapon Training
drow weapon training.description: You have proficiency with Rapiers, Shortswords, and Hand Crossbows.

drunkard's luck.name: Drunkard's Luck
drunkard's luck.description: When you make an Ability Check, Attack Roll, or Saving Throw and have Disadvantage on the roll, you can spend 2 Ki Points to negate the Disadvantage for that roll.

dual wielder.name: Dual Wielder
dual wielder.description: You can use Two-Weapon Fighting even if the weapons you are wielding aren't Light. You cannot dual wield Two-Handed weapons.

dual wielder: bonus armour class.name: Dual Wielder: Bonus Armour Class
dual wielder: bonus armour class.description: You have a +1 bonus to Armour Class while wielding a melee weapon in each hand.

duelling.name: Duelling
duelling.description: When you are wielding a melee weapon that is not Two-Handed in one hand, and no weapon in the other, you deal an additional 2 damage with that weapon.

duelling gloves.name: Duelling Gloves
duelling gloves.description: While only holding one weapon in your main hand and nothing in your free hand, gain a +2 bonus to melee weapon Attack Rolls.

duergar resilience.name: Duergar Resilience
duergar resilience.description: An affected creature has Advantage on Saving Throws against Illusions and against being Charmed or Paralysed.

dungeon delver: perception.name: Dungeon Delver: Perception
dungeon delver: perception.description: You have Advantage on Perception Checks made to detect hidden objects.

dungeon delver: resist traps.name: Dungeon Delver: Resist Traps
dungeon delver: resist traps.description: You have Advantage on Saving Throws made to avoid traps and Resistance to trap damage.

durable.name: Durable
durable.description: Regain full Hit Points every time you take a Short Rest.

dwarven armour training.name: Dwarven Armour Training
dwarven armour training.description: You have Armour Proficiency with Light armour and Medium armour.

dwarven combat training.name: Dwarven Combat Training
dwarven combat training.description: You have Proficiency with Battleaxes, Handaxes, Light Hammers, and Warhammers.

dwarven resilience.name: Dwarven Resilience
dwarven resilience.description: You have Advantage on Saving Throws against being Poisoned and you have Resistance against Poison damage.

dwarven thrower.name: Dwarven Thrower
dwarven thrower.description: A dwarf throwing this warhammer deals an extra 1d8 Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large, Huge or Gargantuan creature, the strike deals an additional 2d8 Bludgeoning damage.

dwarven toughness.name: Dwarven Toughness
dwarven toughness.description: You have 1 extra maximum Hit Point per level.

eagle heart.name: Eagle Heart
eagle heart.description: While Raging, you can use Diving Strike. Foes also have Disadvantage on Opportunity Attacks against you, and you can use Dash as a bonus action.

edge of terror.name: Edge of Terror
edge of terror.description: Each strike fills the target with a chilling dread that prevents it from regaining hit points. Undead creatures also get Disadvantage on Attack Rolls.

effective transmitter.name: Effective Transmitter
effective transmitter.description: While imbued with Lightning Charges, attacks against metal constructs and foes wearing metal armour gain Advantage.

eight legged waltz.name: Eight Legged Waltz
eight legged waltz.description: Whenever you start your turn on a web surface, you now gain extra Movement Speed and become Resistant to Poison .

eldritch spear.name: Eldritch Spear
eldritch spear.description: The range of your Eldritch Blast increases by half.

eldritch strike.name: Eldritch Strike
eldritch strike.description: When you hit a creature with a weapon attack, it has Disadvantage on its next Saving Throw against a spell you cast before the end of your next turn.

electric blood.name: Electric Blood
electric blood.description: When the wielder deals damage using this weapon, they gain 2 Lightning Charges.

electric veins.name: Electric Veins
electric veins.description: When the wielder deals damage with a spell or cantrip, they gain 2 Lightning Charges.

electrify water.name: Electrify Water
electrify water.description: When the wearer stands in Water during combat, it becomes Electrified Water.

electrocution immunity.name: Electrocution Immunity
electrocution immunity.description: Years of ambushing ships during lightning storms means that this creature cannot be Electrocuted.

elegant.name: Elegant
elegant.description: Gain a +1 bonus to Charisma Saving Throws and Ability Checks.

elegant duellist.name: Elegant Duellist
elegant duellist.description: While your off-hand is empty, you score a Critical Hit when rolling a 19. Moreover, you gain an additional Reaction per turn.

elemental adept: acid.name: Elemental Adept: Acid
elemental adept: acid.description: Spells you cast and attacks you make ignore Resistance to Acid damage. In addition, when you deal Acid damage with a spell, you cannot roll a 1.

elemental adept: cold.name: Elemental Adept: Cold
elemental adept: cold.description: Spells you cast and attacks you make ignore Resistance to Cold damage. In addition, when you deal Cold damage with a spell, you cannot roll a 1.

elemental adept: fire.name: Elemental Adept: Fire
elemental adept: fire.description: Spells you cast and attacks you make ignore Resistance to Fire damage. In addition, when you deal Fire damage with a spell, you cannot roll a 1.

elemental adept: lightning.name: Elemental Adept: Lightning
elemental adept: lightning.description: Spells you cast and attacks you make ignore Resistance to Lightning damage. In addition, when you deal Lightning damage with a spell, you cannot roll a 1.

elemental adept: thunder.name: Elemental Adept: Thunder
elemental adept: thunder.description: Spells you cast and attacks you make ignore Resistance to Thunder damage. In addition, when you deal Thunder damage with a spell, you cannot roll a 1.

elemental affinity: damage.name: Elemental Affinity: Damage
elemental affinity: damage.description: When you cast a spell that deals damage of the type associated with your draconic ancestry, you add your Charisma Modifier to the damage.

elemental affinity: resistance.name: Elemental Affinity: Resistance
elemental affinity: resistance.description: When you cast a spell that deals damage matching your draconic ancestry, you can spend a Sorcery Point to gain Resistance to that damage type.

elemental augmentation.name: Elemental Augmentation
elemental augmentation.description: When one of your cantrips deals Acid , Cold , Fire , Lightning , or Thunder damage, add your Spellcasting Modifier to the damage dealt.

elemental infusion.name: Elemental Infusion
elemental infusion.description:
When you deal Acid , Cold , Fire , Lightning , or Thunder damage using a Spell or a Cantrip, that element infuses your weapon.
Until the end of your next turn, you deal an additional 1d4 damage of that element on your first successful weapon attack.

elemental momentum.name: Elemental Momentum
elemental momentum.description: Whenever the wearer deals Acid , Cold , Fire , Lightning or Thunder damage with Spells or Cantrip, they gain Momentum for 2 turns.

elemental resonance.name: Elemental Resonance
elemental resonance.description: If the wielder deals Acid , Fire , Lightning , Radiant , or Necrotic damage, it becomes resistant to that damage type for 2 turns.

elemental retort.name: Elemental Retort
elemental retort.description: When attacked, the affected entity can draw on Siphoned magic to cast Elemental Retort.

elemental siphon.name: Elemental Siphon
elemental siphon.description: The affected entity draws elemental power from any myrmidons within Range: 30 m (100 ft)

elements of an epoch.name: Elements of an Epoch
elements of an epoch.description: Depending on what kind of damage this weapon does, it also inflicts: Acid condition, Chilled condition, or Burning condition.

elk heart.name: Elk Heart
elk heart.description: While Raging, you can use Primal Stampede, and your movement speed increases by 4.5 m (15 ft).

elven agility.name: Elven Agility
elven agility.description: The wearer has a +2 bonus to Initiative Rolls and Advantage on Dexterity Saving Throws.

elven chain.name: Elven Chain
elven chain.description: You are considered Proficient with this armour while wearing it.

elven weapon training.name: Elven Weapon Training
elven weapon training.description: You have Proficiency with Longswords, Shortswords, Longbows, and Shortbows.

empowered evocation.name: Empowered Evocation
empowered evocation.description: Your grasp of Evocation magic has tightened, and you can add your Intelligence Modifier to damage rolls with any Evocation spells.

endurance by fire.name: Endurance by Fire
endurance by fire.description: You have Resistance to Fire damage and a +2 bonus to Saving Throws.

enervating suffusion.name: Enervating Suffusion
enervating suffusion.description: Your unarmed attacks deal an additional 1d4 Force damage.

ensnaring shock.name: Ensnaring Shock
ensnaring shock.description: When the target moves, create a Lightning explosion with 2 m (7 ft) radius that deals 1d4 Lightning .

entropic ward.name: Entropic Ward
entropic ward.description:
As a reaction, you can impose Disadvantage on an Attack Roll against you.
If the attack misses, you gain Advantage on your next Attack Roll against your attacker for 1 turn.

envenom.name: Envenom
envenom.description: Whenever you deal Poison damage, the target needs to succeed a Constitution Saving Throw or become Poisoned.

escape the horde.name: Escape the Horde
escape the horde.description: Opportunity Attacks against you have Disadvantage.

ethel's twisted blessing.name: Ethel's Twisted Blessing
ethel's twisted blessing.description: As one of Ethel's loyal servants, this redcap has an additional 40 hit points, their Strength and Constitution scores are increased +2, and their attacks deal an additional 1~12 Slashing damage.

ethereal.name: Ethereal
ethereal.description: Affected entity is incorporeal and can't be Shoved, Thrown, or used as an Improvised Melee Weapon

ethereal escape.name: Ethereal Escape
ethereal escape.description: When damaged, the Incubus escapes to the Ethereal Plane. He returns to the battlefield at the start of his next turn.

ethereal form.name: Ethereal Form
ethereal form.description: All incoming damage is reduced by 8.

evasion.name: Evasion
evasion.description: Your agility lets you dodge out of the way of certain spells. When a spell or effect would deal half damage on a successful Dexterity Saving Throw, it deals no damage if you succeed, and only half damage if you fail.

evasive instinct.name: Evasive Instinct
evasive instinct.description: You have a +1 bonus to Armour Class and Saving Throws as long as you are not wearing armour or holding a shield.

ever vigilant.name: Ever Vigilant
ever vigilant.description: When the wearer chooses to End their Rage, they gain 15 temporary hit points.

exceptional plate.name: Exceptional Plate
exceptional plate.description: You take 2 less damage from Slashing , Piercing and Bludgeoning sources.

exceptional training.name: Exceptional Training
exceptional training.description: Your summoned companions can now Dash, Disengage, and Help as a Bonus Action.

executioner.name: Executioner
executioner.description: When you kill a creature, your next Attack Roll will be a Critical Hit. Once spent, this effect refreshes after a Long Rest.

exoskeletal endurance.name: Exoskeletal Endurance
exoskeletal endurance.description: Reduce all incoming damage by 2. When the wearer is struck by a melee attack, the attacker takes Constitution modifier Piercing damage.

exoskeletal reinforcement.name: Exoskeletal Reinforcement
exoskeletal reinforcement.description: Your attacks ignore Resistance to Slashing , Piercing , and Bludgeoning damage.

exotic material.name: Exotic Material
exotic material.description: Add your full Dexterity Modifier to your Armour Class. Additionally, this armour does not impose Disadvantage on Stealth Ability Checks.

experienced and deadly.name: Experienced And Deadly
experienced and deadly.description: The wearer deals additional damage equal to their Wisdom Modifier with unarmed strikes.

experimental alchemy.name: Experimental Alchemy
experimental alchemy.description: You brew two Alchemical Solutions instead of one when combining extracts, if you succeed a Difficulty Class 15 Medicine Check.

expert climber.name: Expert Climber
expert climber.description: You have conquered mountains and scaled towering trees. Climbing does not cost you movement speed.

expert divination.name: Expert Divination
expert divination.description: You gain an additional Portent Die. When taking a Short Rest you receive a set of Prophecies. Complete them to regain missing Portent Dice.

expertise.name: Expertise
expertise.description: Choose two Skills you are Proficient in. Your Proficiency Bonus is doubled for any Ability Check you make that uses either Skill.

exploit weakness.name: Exploit Weakness
exploit weakness.description: Creatures hit with this weapon receive Vulnerability to Piercing damage.

exquisite focus.name: Exquisite Focus
exquisite focus.description: While concentrating, you add your Spellcasting Modifier to your Saving Throws and gain a +1 bonus to your Armour Class.

external digestion.name: External Digestion
external digestion.description: Can Devour any creature that is Restrained and steeping in its Digestive Juices.

extinguishing malice.name: Extinguishing Malice
extinguishing malice.description: Nearby lights are extinguished in the presence of this creature's roiling darkness.

extra attack.name: Extra Attack
extra attack.description: You can make an additional free attack after making an unarmed or weapon attack.

eyes of the dark.name: Eyes of the Dark
eyes of the dark.description: You can see in the dark up to 24 m (80 ft).

faceless masquerade.name: Faceless Masquerade
faceless masquerade.description: You have Advantage on Deception Checks and Persuasion Checks.

failsafe protocol.name: Failsafe Protocol
failsafe protocol.description: After losing a significant amount of Hit Points, this creature will begin a Self-Detonation Protocol to eliminate all nearby threats. If it dies, it instantly Detonates.

faithwarden's stride.name: Faithwarden's Stride
faithwarden's stride.description: Druidic vines cannot Entangled you and do not count as difficult terrain.

famed hag killer boon.name: Famed Hag Killer Boon
famed hag killer boon.description: Andraxo's songs have cloaked you with fame, granting you a permanent bonus to Charisma.

fancy footwork.name: Fancy Footwork
fancy footwork.description: If you make a melee attack against a target, that target can't make Opportunity Attacks against you for the rest of your turn.

fast hands.name: Fast Hands
fast hands.description: You gain an extra Bonus Action, which you can use with any of your existing Bonus Actions.

fast movement.name: Fast Movement
fast movement.description: Your Movement Speed increases by 3 m (10 ft) while not wearing Heavy Armour.

favourable beginnings.name: Favourable Beginnings
favourable beginnings.description: The first Attack Roll or Ability Check you make against any target gains a bonus equal to your Proficiency Bonus.

favoured weapon.name: Favoured Weapon
favoured weapon.description: This weapon has a +1 bonus to damage and Attack Rolls.

fear of wolves.name: Fear of Wolves
fear of wolves.description: Shadowheart's scalp prickles with fear when she encounters wolves. If she steps within 9 m (30 ft) of a lupine creature, she must make a DC 15 Wisdom Saving Throw or become Frightened.

feline fall.name: Feline Fall
feline fall.description: Due to their natural feline grace, cats are Resistant to Falling damage.

feller of monsters.name: Feller of Monsters
feller of monsters.description: You have Advantage against Monstrosity type enemies.

feral instinct.name: Feral Instinct
feral instinct.description:
You have honed your instincts to the utmost degree.
You gain a +3 to Initiative and can't be Surprised.

fervent flames.name: Fervent Flames
fervent flames.description: Whenever you take Fire damage dealt by another creature, you gain 2 turns of Heat.

fey ancestry.name: Fey Ancestry
fey ancestry.description: The Feywild casts a veil over your mind. You have Advantage on Saving Throws against being Charmed, and magic can't put you to Sleep.

fey life.name: Fey Life
fey life.description: Makes it easier for the wearer to succeed on death saving throws.

feywild sparks.name: Feywild Sparks
feywild sparks.description: While your sorcerous Tides of Chaos feature is active, you will always trigger Wild Magic when casting spells.

fiendish blessing.name: Fiendish Blessing
fiendish blessing.description: Protected by the blood of their fiendish ancestors, cambions have a +2 bonus to their Armour Class.

fiendish fire.name: Fiendish Fire
fiendish fire.description: Once per turn, a creature hit by this weapon will possibly be afflicted with Faerie Fire.

fiendish vigour.name: Fiendish Vigour
fiendish vigour.description: You can cast False Life on yourself at will as a 1st-level spell, without expending a Spell Slot.

fiery return.name: Fiery Return
fiery return.description: When you deal Fire damage with a levelled spell, you Burn yourself and gain an additional Bonus Action this round.

fire acuity.name: Fire Acuity
fire acuity.description: Whenever you deal Fire damage, you gain Arcane Acuity for 2 turns.

first blood.name: First Blood
first blood.description: On a hit, inflict Bleeding upon targets that have maximum Hit Points.

fishfolk faithful.name: Fishfolk Faithful
fishfolk faithful.description: Chance to apply Bleeding to targets.

fit to burst.name: Fit to Burst
fit to burst.description: When the intellect glutton dies, it bursts in a Morphic Brine Explosion.

flames of avernus.name: Flames of Avernus
flames of avernus.description: This merregon's attacks make a target Flame-Feeble.

flaming revenge.name: Flaming Revenge
flaming revenge.description: On a successful Saving Throw against a foe's spell, deal 1d4 + proficiency bonus Fire damage to them.

flaming shroud.name: Flaming Shroud
flaming shroud.description: A creature that damages the wearer within 2 m (7 ft) receives Burning.

flurry of moths.name: Flurry of Moths
flurry of moths.description: You gain a swarm of moths that fights on your side. Once per round, the swarm can assist you in one of three ways after you attack an enemy: it can attack and deal additional Psychic damage, Blind your enemy, or teleport you to a safer location.

fly trap.name: Fly Trap
fly trap.description: Chance to Ensnare target if it is not a plant or a beast.

flying strike.name: Flying Strike
flying strike.description: When a githyanki casts Fly, their next melee weapon attack deals an additional 1d4 Psychic damage.

focused conjuration.name: Focused Conjuration
focused conjuration.description: Damage taken while you are Concentrating on a Conjuration spell will not break your Concentration.

focused stride.name: Focused Stride
focused stride.description: When you cast a spell that requires Concentration, you gain Momentum for 1 turn. While you are concentrating, you cannot be knocked Prone or moved against your will.

fond caress.name: Fond Caress
fond caress.description: One of a magical pair of rings, this allows the wearer to receive Warding Bond from a creature wearing the matching ring.

font of inspiration.name: Font of Inspiration
font of inspiration.description: You regain all of your Bardic Inspirations after a Long or Short Rest.

forbidden knowledge.name: Forbidden Knowledge
forbidden knowledge.description: From partially deciphering the Necromancy of Thay, you gain a +1 bonus to Wisdom Saving Throws and Ability Checks.

force absorption.name: Force Absorption
force absorption.description: Gain 2 turns of Force Conduit when taking Slashing , Piercing , or Bludgeoning damage.

force bravado.name: Force Bravado
force bravado.description: At the end of your turn, generate Force Conduit while surrounded by 2 or more enemies.

forest.name: Forest
forest.description: You can cast Barkskin and Hold Person.

forest aegis.name: Forest Aegis
forest aegis.description: You are invested with the power of the meadows and woods of the land, and have the effect of Barkskin, increasing your Armour Class to 16.

forever indebted.name: Forever Indebted
forever indebted.description: A debt to Raphael must be paid - even in death. Upon dying, the debtor explodes in damaging flames and is reincarnated as a fiendish creature bound to Raphael.

formless slaughter.name: Formless Slaughter
formless slaughter.description: You gain a +1 to Attack and Damage rolls while shapeshifting or disguised.

frantic urgency.name: Frantic Urgency
frantic urgency.description: During combat, when the wearer starts their turn with 50% Hit Points or less, they gain Momentum for 1 turn.

freecast.name: Freecast
freecast.description: You have discovered a marvellous adaptability within yourself. Spell slots, charges, and similar resource costs for your next action or spell are removed. Refreshes after a Long Rest.

fungal resistance.name: Fungal Resistance
fungal resistance.description: A Pearlspore Bell grants the hag +5 bonus to all Saving Throws.

fury in the marrow.name: Fury In The Marrow
fury in the marrow.description: When you Rage, hostile creatures in a 3 m (10 ft) radius must succeed a Weapon Action DC Wisdom Saving Throw or take 2d4 Psychic damage. The targets receive half damage on a save. [See: Bugs]

fury of the small.name: Fury of the Small
fury of the small.description: When you damage a creature larger than you, you can choose to deal 1d6 Physical extra. Limited to once per combat.

galvanic currents.name: Galvanic Currents
galvanic currents.description: This weapon deals an additional 1d6 Lightning damage.

genial strider.name: Genial Strider
genial strider.description: The wearer's Movement Speed is unimpeded by Difficult Terrain.

giant killer.name: Giant Killer
giant killer.description: If a Large or bigger creature attacks you, you can use your reaction to make a melee attack.

giantslayer.name: Giantslayer
giantslayer.description: On a hit, double the damage from your Strength modifier. This weapon grants you Advantage on Attack Rolls against Large, Huge or Gargantuan creatures.

githborn psionic resistance.name: Githborn Psionic Resistance
githborn psionic resistance.description: A githyanki holding this weapon has Advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma Saving Throws, resistance to Psychic damage, and cannot be Charmed.

githborn psionic weapon.name: Githborn Psionic Weapon
githborn psionic weapon.description: When wielded by a githyanki this weapon deals an additional 1d4 Psychic damage.

githyanki parry.name: Githyanki Parry
githyanki parry.description: Parry unarmed and weapon attacks to reduce their damage by 10.

githyanki war magic.name: Githyanki War Magic
githyanki war magic.description: After the githyanki casts a spell or cantrip, they can make a weapon attack using a Bonus Action.

gleamdance dagger: glowing.name: Gleamdance Dagger: Glowing
gleamdance dagger: glowing.description: This object shines with a glowing light in a radius of 6 m (20 ft).

gleamdancer.name: Gleamdancer
gleamdancer.description: When this dagger is wielded in the off-hand, the wielder gains a +1 bonus to Armour Class.

gloom step.name: Gloom Step
gloom step.description: Movement is increased by 3 m (10 ft) when starting a turn in darkness.

glorious pointy hat.name: Glorious Pointy Hat
glorious pointy hat.description: You gain a bonus to your Persuasion Checks equal to your Intelligence Modifier.

gnome cunning.name: Gnome Cunning
gnome cunning.description: You have Advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma Saving Throws.

goblin's undoing.name: Goblin's Undoing
goblin's undoing.description: Goblins have Disadvantage on Attack Rolls against the wielder.

godswill.name: Godswill
godswill.description: You gain an additional use of Channel Divinity Charge. Once used, it is restored upon taking a Long Rest. [See: Bugs]

gold plating.name: Gold Plating
gold plating.description: This creature has been blessed by Mammon, giving them a second skin of gold that increases their Constitution to 20 and their base Armour Class to 15, and grants an additional 66 hit points Hit Points .

gontr mael: glowing.name: Gontr Mael: Glowing
gontr mael: glowing.description: This object shines with a glowing light in a radius of 6 m (20 ft). Toggle this to douse and rekindle the light.

grasp of the forest.name: Grasp of the Forest
grasp of the forest.description: Weapon attacks can Entangle the target.

grassland.name: Grassland
grassland.description: You can cast Invisibility and Pass Without Trace.

grave magic.name: Grave Magic
grave magic.description: Whenever you deal damage with a spell, deal an additional 1d8 Necrotic damage.

great weapon fighting.name: Great Weapon Fighting
great weapon fighting.description: When you roll a 1 or 2 on a damage die for an attack with a Two-Handed melee weapon, that die is rerolled once.

great weapon master: all in.name: Great Weapon Master: All In
great weapon master: all in.description: When attacking with a melee weapon you are Proficient with and are wielding in both hands, Attack Rolls take a -5 penalty, but their damage increases by 10.

great weapon master: bonus attack.name: Great Weapon Master: Bonus Attack
great weapon master: bonus attack.description: When you land a Critical Hit or kill a target with a melee weapon attack, you can make another melee weapon attack as a Bonus Action that turn.

great wyrm's scales.name: Great Wyrm's Scales
great wyrm's scales.description: All incoming damage is reduced by 2.

greater kushigo counter.name: Greater Kushigo Counter
greater kushigo counter.description: The wearer can use a Reaction to make an Unarmed Strike against any attacker that misses.

greater wyrm's scales.name: Greater Wyrm's Scales
greater wyrm's scales.description: All incoming damage is reduced by 4.

green bed regeneration.name: Green Bed Regeneration
green bed regeneration.description: When starting your turn on Plant Growth Surface or Vine Surface regain 1d4 Hit Points .

gregarious caster.name: Gregarious Caster
gregarious caster.description: Your cantrips deal additional damage equal to your Charisma Modifier.

grievous retribution.name: Grievous Retribution
grievous retribution.description: When an enemy damages the wearer, the wearer gains Wrath for 2 turns.

grim harvest.name: Grim Harvest
grim harvest.description: Once per turn, if you kill a creature with a spell, you regain Hit Points equal to twice the Spell Slot level used - thrice if it's a Necromancy spell. Undead and Constructs are unaffected.

grim irony.name: Grim Irony
grim irony.description: Whenever this weapon lands a critical hit, both target and attacker must succeed a Wisdom Saving Throw, or be affected by fits of laughter.

grip of shadows.name: Grip of Shadows
grip of shadows.description: Deals an additional 1d6 Necrotic damage if the target is not standing in sunlight.

grit.name: Grit
grit.description: When the wearer has 50% Hit Points or less, they have an additional Bonus Action.

guardian of faith.name: Guardian of Faith
guardian of faith.description: When an enemy enters your attack range, you can strike them.

halfling luck.name: Halfling Luck
halfling luck.description: When you roll a 1 for an Attack Roll, Ability Check, or Saving Throw, you can reroll the dice and must use the new roll.

haroldish doom.name: Haroldish Doom
haroldish doom.description: When dealing damage to a target with a ranged weapon, the target must succeed a Charisma Saving Throw or be Baned for 2 turns.

harrowing presence.name: Harrowing Presence
harrowing presence.description:
* Mortal will frays and breaks around this powerful spirit. Creatures within 10 m (33 ft) are Harrowed.
* Undead creatures ignore this effect.

heart ablaze.name: Heart Ablaze
heart ablaze.description:
Infernal iron has anchored the war machine that is Karlach's heart.
She can touch others without burning them, and can no longer be Charmed.

heart of ice.name: Heart of Ice
heart of ice.description: When dealing Cold damage, the wielder deals an additional 1 Cold .

heart of iron.name: Heart of Iron
heart of iron.description:
The infernal engine that is Karlach's heart is burning more evenly.
She has Advantage on Saving Throws against being Charmed.

heart of the storm.name: Heart of the Storm
heart of the storm.description: When you cast a Spell of Level 1 or higher that deals Lightning or Thunder damage, you cause a small, local storm. All enemies within 6 m (20 ft) take (Sorcerer Level / 2) Lightning or (Sorcerer Level / 2) Thunder .

heart of the storm: resistance.name: Heart of the Storm: Resistance
heart of the storm: resistance.description: You are Resistant to Lightning and Thunder damage

heat convergence.name: Heat Convergence
heat convergence.description: Consume your Heat to fuel a powerful attack.

heavily armoured.name: Heavily Armoured
heavily armoured.description: You gain Proficiency with Heavy Armour and your Strength increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.

heavy armour master.name: Heavy Armour Master
heavy armour master.description:
Your Strength increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.
Incoming damage from non-magical attacks also decreases by 3 while you're wearing heavy armour.

heavy hitter.name: Heavy Hitter
heavy hitter.description: Your weapon hits hard enough to send your target Reeling for 2 turns.

heightened awareness.name: Heightened Awareness
heightened awareness.description: Gain a +3 bonus to Initiative rolls and Advantage on Perception Checks.

heightened manoeuvre.name: Heightened Manoeuvre
heightened manoeuvre.description: Targets have Disadvantage on Saving Throws against your Manoeuvre and Weapon Actions.

heightened necromancy.name: Heightened Necromancy
heightened necromancy.description: Creatures have Disadvantage on Saving Throws against your necromancy spells.

helldusk armour.name: Helldusk Armour
helldusk armour.description: You are considered Proficient with this armour while wearing it.

hellish rebuke.name: Hellish Rebuke
hellish rebuke.description: React to your next attacker with flames that deal 2d10 Fire .

hellish resistance.name: Hellish Resistance
hellish resistance.description: Your blood protects you from flame, abyssal or otherwise. Gain Resistance to Fire damage, taking only half damage from it.

hellstalker.name: Hellstalker
hellstalker.description: Possibly inflict Burning when attacking while Hiding or Invisible.

helm's protection.name: Helm's Protection
helm's protection.description: When you heal another creature, it gains Resistance to Bludgeoning , Piercing , and Slashing damage dealt by weapon attacks [See: Bugs] for 2 turns.

hex warrior.name: Hex Warrior
hex warrior.description:
You gain proficiency with Medium armour, Shields, and Martial weapons.
You gain Bind Hexed Weapon, which lets you use your Charisma modifier instead of Strength or Dexterity when attacking with weapons that you are proficient with.

high spellcasting.name: High Spellcasting
high spellcasting.description: You gain a +1 bonus to Spell Save DC.

hoarfrost balance.name: Hoarfrost Balance
hoarfrost balance.description: You cannot fall Prone while traversing Icy terrain.

holy rebuke.name: Holy Rebuke
holy rebuke.description: Affected entity is surrounded by a vengeful aura that deals 1d4 Radiant to anyone who hits it with a melee attack.

homing weapon.name: Homing Weapon
homing weapon.description: This weapon will return to its owner when thrown.

horde breaker.name: Horde Breaker
horde breaker.description: Target two creatures standing close to each other, attacking them in quick succession.

hot little hands.name: Hot Little Hands
hot little hands.description: When the wearer deals Fire damage, the target has to succeed a Constitution Saving Throw or start Burning.

human versatility.name: Human Versatility
human versatility.description: Select an additional Skill to be Proficient in. Your carrying capacity is increased by a quarter.

hunter's camouflage.name: Hunter's Camouflage
hunter's camouflage.description: After receiving damage, the creature immediately uses their reaction to Blur

hunter's eye.name: Hunter's Eye
hunter's eye.description: You gain a +1d4 bonus to Attack Rolls against creatures marked by Hunter's Mark, True Strike, Faerie Fire, or Guiding Bolt.

hunter's mark (passive feature).name: Hunter's Mark (passive feature)
hunter's mark (passive feature).description: When you attack your quarry, you deal an additional 1d6 Weapon .

ichorous corrosion.name: Ichorous Corrosion
ichorous corrosion.description: When the wearer deals Acid damage, they also inflict Noxious Fumes on the target(s).

illithid euphoria.name: Illithid Euphoria
illithid euphoria.description: Charm or Frighten a creature to gain a 1d4 bonus to Attack Rolls and Saving Throws.

illithid expertise.name: Illithid Expertise
illithid expertise.description: You have deepened your sense of self, gaining Expertise in Persuasion, Deception, and Intimidation Checks.

illithid persuasion.name: Illithid Persuasion
illithid persuasion.description: Impose your authority onto those with the Brand of the Absolute.

illithid protection.name: Illithid Protection
illithid protection.description: If the wearer is infested by a mind flayer tadpole, they gain +1 to Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma Saving Throws.

illusion quickening.name: Illusion Quickening
illusion quickening.description: After hitting a creature with a weapon attack, you can cast illusion or enchantment spells as a Bonus Action.

illusory self.name: Illusory Self
illusory self.description: Interpose an illusory duplicate of yourself between you and an attacker's strike, making them miss their attack.

immune to control undead.name: Immune to Control Undead
immune to control undead.description: This creature is so powerful, it simply cannot be controlled by the magical whim of others.

immutable existence.name: Immutable Existence
immutable existence.description: Spells that alter someone's form have no effect on the affected entity, and it cannot be removed from this plane of existence.

immutable form.name: Immutable Form
immutable form.description: Spells that alter someone's form have no effect on the affected entity, and it has a +5 bonus to Saving Throws against spells that would remove it from this plane. [See: Bugs]

impenetrable shadow.name: Impenetrable Shadow
impenetrable shadow.description: If Viconia ends her turn in darkness, she receives Sanctuary of Loss.

imperial retaliation.name: Imperial Retaliation
imperial retaliation.description: When the wielder succeeds a Saving Throw, the foe that caused the throw needs to make an Intelligence Saving Throw or be Stunned for 1 turn.

improved abjuration.name: Improved Abjuration
improved abjuration.description: Each time you take a Short Rest, the intensity of your Arcane Ward increases by an amount equal to your wizard level.

improved bardic inspiration.name: Improved Bardic Inspiration
improved bardic inspiration.description: The bonus gained from Bardic Inspiration increases to +1d8.

improved bardic inspiration: attack roll.name: Improved Bardic Inspiration: Attack Roll or Ability Check
improved bardic inspiration: attack roll.description: Add a +1d12 bonus to your next Attack Roll or Ability Check.

improved bardic inspiration: saving thro.name: Improved Bardic Inspiration: Saving Throw
improved bardic inspiration: saving thro.description: Add a +1d12 bonus to your next Saving Throw.

improved combat superiority.name: Improved Combat Superiority
improved combat superiority.description: The size of your Superiority Die increases to a d10

improved critical.name: Improved Critical
improved critical.description: The number you need to roll a Critical Hit while attacking is reduced by 1. This effect can stack.

improved critical hit.name: Improved Critical Hit
improved critical hit.description: The number you need to roll a Critical Hit while attacking is reduced by 1. This effect can stack.

improved divine smite.name: Improved Divine Smite
improved divine smite.description: Your attacks are suffused with divine might. Melee weapon attacks deal an additional 1d8 Radiant damage.

improved elemental casting.name: Improved Elemental Casting
