improved elemental casting.description: Your affinity with elemental ki deepens. Several of your offensive Four Elements features deal an additional dice of damage, your Clench of the North Wind can hold an additional creature, and your Embrace of the Inferno fires an extra ray.

improved extra attack.name: Improved Extra Attack
improved extra attack.description: You can make two additional attacks after attacking with your main-hand weapon.

improved minor illusion.name: Improved Minor Illusion
improved minor illusion.description: You can cast Minor Illusion as a bonus action.

improved warding flare.name: Improved Warding Flare
improved warding flare.description: When an enemy attacks an ally, you can use your Reaction to impose Disadvantage on the Attack Roll, possibly causing their attack to miss.

improved wild strike.name: Improved Wild Strike
improved wild strike.description: You can make 2 additional Attack Rolls after making an Unarmed Strike while in an animal Wild Shape.

impulse blast.name: Impulse Blast
impulse blast.description: Knocks nearby creatures Prone after killing a target or landing a Critical Hit.

incorporeal movement.name: Incorporeal Movement
incorporeal movement.description: Opportunity attacks against you have Disadvantage.

indomitable.name: Indomitable
indomitable.description: Whenever you fail a Saving Throw, you can roll again, using the new result instead.

inescapable destruction.name: Inescapable Destruction
inescapable destruction.description: Damage you deal ignores Resistance to Necrotic damage.

inevitable resolve.name: Inevitable Resolve
inevitable resolve.description: Effects that control or incapacitate creatures only last 1 turn against this being of pure infernal ambition.

infectious greed.name: Infectious Greed
infectious greed.description: Tempted by the riches that Mammon offers to those most faithful to him, all allies in the presence of this creature are affected by Infectious Greed

infectious madness.name: Infectious Madness
infectious madness.description: After the cranium rat takes damage, the attacker must make an Intelligence Saving Throw or become Confused.

infernal acuity.name: Infernal Acuity
infernal acuity.description: You gain +1 bonus to Spell Attack Rolls and Spell Save DC.

infernal evasion.name: Infernal Evasion
infernal evasion.description: When you fail a Saving Throw, you may use your Reaction to succeed instead.

infernal legion.name: Infernal Legion
infernal legion.description: Grants the Infernal Legion condition while worn.

infernal retribution.name: Infernal Retribution
infernal retribution.description: When you succeed a Saving Throw, the caster receives Burning (Orthonic) for 3 turns.

infernal sight.name: Infernal Sight
infernal sight.description: You can see in magical [See: Bugs] and ordinary darkness up to a range of 12 m (40 ft). You cannot be Blinded.

infernal touch.name: Infernal Touch
infernal touch.description: Your weapon attacks deal an additional 1d6 Fire damage. Your unarmed attacks deal an additional 1d6 Necrotic damage, and can possibly inflict Bleeding.

infernal weapon.name: Infernal Weapon
infernal weapon.description: On a hit, this weapon deals an additional 3 Poison damage and can possibly Poison its target.

infested.name: Infested
infested.description:
Crawling with tiny spiders that deal 1~4 Piercing and 1~4 Poison each turn.
When hit with a melee attack, the infestation spreads to the attacker. Upon death, the infestation spreads to all nearby creatures.
Removed by fire or acid.
Doesn't harm ettercaps or spiders.

innate fortitude.name: Innate Fortitude
innate fortitude.description: Once per Long Rest, you can use a Reaction to make an Attack Roll or Saving Throw with Advantage.

innate invisibility.name: Innate Invisibility
innate invisibility.description: Invisible by nature, this creature can only be seen through magical means.

inquisitor's might.name: Inquisitor's Might
inquisitor's might.description: Weapon deals an additional Charisma modifier Radiant damage and may possibly inflict Dazed.

insidious cold.name: Insidious Cold
insidious cold.description: Dealing Cold damage with a spell possibly inflicts Chilled upon the target.

instinctive charm.name: Instinctive Charm
instinctive charm.description: Charm an enemy attacking you. They will attack a new target if possible as a Reaction. [See Notes]

intense adamantine backlash.name: Intense Adamantine Backlash
intense adamantine backlash.description: When a melee attack hits you, the Attacker is sent Reeling for 3 turns.

interplanar slayer.name: Interplanar Slayer
interplanar slayer.description: This weapon grants a +1d4 bonus to damage and Attack Rolls against githyanki, aberrations, fiends, and elementals.

intimate embrace.name: Intimate Embrace
intimate embrace.description: One of a magical pair of rings, this allows the wearer to cast Warding Bond once per Long Rest on a creature wearing the matching ring.

inured to undeath.name: Inured to Undeath
inured to undeath.description: You have steeped yourself so completely in death that you are Resistant to Necrotic damage, and moreover your hit point maximum cannot be reduced.

invisible weapon.name: Invisible Weapon
invisible weapon.description: This weapon is Invisible while equipped. It has Advantage on Attack Rolls. It loses this property for 2 rounds on a missed Attack Roll. The weapon also scores a critical hit when rolling a 19.

iron mind.name: Iron Mind
iron mind.description: You gain Proficiency in Wisdom and Intelligence Saving Throws.

ironvine.name: Ironvine
ironvine.description: While the wielder is holding a weapon empowered with Shillelagh, and when they are hit by a melee attack, the attacker takes Piercing Damage equal to the wielder's Wisdom modifier.

isolated prey.name: Isolated Prey
isolated prey.description: This creature has Advantage on Attack Rolls against targets that do not have allies within 5m.

it's all in the wrists.name: It's All In The Wrists
it's all in the wrists.description: This weapon has the Thrown property and deals an additional 1d4 Thunder damage when thrown.

jack of all trades.name: Jack of All Trades
jack of all trades.description: Your vast experiences make you more likely to succeed in any undertaking. Add half of your Proficiency Bonus (rounded down) to Ability Checks that you are not Proficient in.

keen attack.name: Keen Attack
keen attack.description: The wielder doubles their Proficiency Bonus when rolling ranged attacks with this weapon, unless they have Disadvantage.

keeper of the veil.name: Keeper of the Veil
keeper of the veil.description: You specialise in hunting creatures from other planes of existence. You gain Proficiency in Arcana and can grant protection against aberrations, celestials, elementals, fey, fiends, and undead.

ki-empowered strikes.name: Ki-Empowered Strikes
ki-empowered strikes.description: Your unarmed attacks count as magical for the purpose of overcoming enemies' Resistance and Immunity to non-magical damage.

knockdown jaws.name: Knockdown Jaws
knockdown jaws.description: Bite attacks from this creature can possibly knock the target Prone.

kushigo counter.name: Kushigo Counter
kushigo counter.description: While Patient Defence is active: the wearer can use their reaction to make an unarmed strike against any attacker that misses.

kushigo's might.name: Kushigo's Might
kushigo's might.description: The wearer deals an additional 1d4 damage with Throw Attacks and attacks made with Improvised Weapons.

land's stride: advantage.name: Land's Stride: Advantage
land's stride: advantage.description:
You have become an expert at moving through the wilderness.
You have Advantage on Saving Throws against plants that are magically created to impede your movement.

land's stride: difficult terrain.name: Land's Stride: Difficult Terrain
land's stride: difficult terrain.description: You have become an expert at moving through the wilderness. Difficult Terrain no longer slows you down.

land's stride: plants.name: Land's Stride: Plants
land's stride: plants.description:
You have become an expert at moving through the wilderness.
Plant-based surfaces with thorns, spines, or similar hazards no longer harm you.

last hope.name: Last Hope
last hope.description: Hope always begins combat under the effects of Death Ward.

last stand.name: Last Stand
last stand.description: During combat, when the wearer starts their turn with 50% Hit Points or less, they gain Wrath for 2 turns.

lathander's blessing.name: Lathander's Blessing
lathander's blessing.description: Once per Long Rest, when your hit points are reduced to 0, you regain 2d6 Hit Points . Allies within 9 m (30 ft) also regain 1d6 Hit Points .

lathander's light.name: Lathander's Light
lathander's light.description: Sheds holy light in a 6 m (20 ft) radius. In combat, fiends and undead standing in the light are Blinded if they fail a DC 14 Constitution throw.

lay bare their weakness.name: Lay Bare Their Weakness
lay bare their weakness.description: After dealing damage with an unarmed attack, the wearer gains a +1 bonus to their spell save DC until the end of their turn.

leap to your feet.name: Leap to Your Feet
leap to your feet.description: When you are Prone, standing up uses only 1.5 m (5 ft) of your Movement Speed speed.

legendary action: adamantine reverberati.name: Legendary Action: Adamantine Reverberation
legendary action: adamantine reverberati.description: Once per round, Grym can use its Legendary Action to Reverberate when it is struck, doubling its movement and granting it 10 temporary hit points.

legendary action: beguiling rebuke.name: Legendary Action: Beguiling Rebuke
legendary action: beguiling rebuke.description: Beguile your attacker and its nearby allies, possibly preventing them from attacking you again.

legendary action: bhaal's edict.name: Legendary Action: Bhaal's Edict
legendary action: bhaal's edict.description: If Orin has not used her Legendary Action by the end of a round, and Orin is not duelling her opponent alone, the Dread Lord places a creature under Bhaal's Edict.

legendary action: blinding ambush.name: Legendary Action: Blinding Ambush
legendary action: blinding ambush.description: Once per round, Yurgir can spend a Legendary Action to Blinding Ambush a Hunted creature when it attempts to attack or cast a spell.

legendary action: call consort.name: Legendary Action: Call Consort
legendary action: call consort.description: Once per combat, the Owlbear mother can spend a Legendary Action to summon her mate when she is attacked.

legendary action: devoted galvanism.name: Legendary Action: Devoted Galvanism
legendary action: devoted galvanism.description: Once per round when an enemy targets their ally with an ability, Dror Ragzlin can use a Legendary Action to Galvanise Absolutists within 5 m (17 ft), granting them Action Surge.

legendary action: draconic fury.name: Legendary Action: Draconic Fury
legendary action: draconic fury.description: The dragon can retaliate against an attacker with its breath weapon once per round.

legendary action: draconic wrath.name: Legendary Action: Draconic Wrath
legendary action: draconic wrath.description: The dragon can retaliate against an attacker with its breath weapon once per round.

legendary action: fanatic retaliation.name: Legendary Action: Fanatic Retaliation
legendary action: fanatic retaliation.description: Once per round when a Spindleweb Fanatic is killed, Kar'niss can use a Legendary Action to possibly deal 6d10 Psychic and Silence the attacker.

legendary action: gaze of the dead.name: Legendary Action: Gaze of the Dead
legendary action: gaze of the dead.description: Once per round, Myrkul's Apostle can spend a Legendary Action to cast Gaze of the Dead on a creature when attacked.

legendary action: gossamer tomb.name: Legendary Action: Gossamer Tomb
legendary action: gossamer tomb.description: Once per round if her offspring is attacked, the Phase Spider Matriarch can spend a Legendary Action to use Gossamer Tomb.

legendary action: grasping appendage.name: Legendary Action: Grasping Appendage
legendary action: grasping appendage.description: Once per round, Malus Thorm can use his Legendary Action to Grasp a creature and pull it closer.

legendary action: heartwrench.name: Legendary Action: Heartwrench
legendary action: heartwrench.description: Once per round, Viconia can use a Legendary Action to Heartwrench a Heartform Mapped creature after it strikes her or her allies.

legendary action: hordestrike.name: Legendary Action: Hordestrike
legendary action: hordestrike.description: Once per round, Ketheric can spend a Legendary Action to Hordestrike an enemy when it is attacked by one of his minions following Deadly Orders.

legendary action: leaping static.name: Legendary Action: Leaping Static
legendary action: leaping static.description: Once per round, Bernard can spend a Legendary Action to immediately launch Leaping Static at a foe after being attacked.

legendary action: mind-claw of tu'narath.name: Legendary Action: Mind-Claw of Tu'narath
legendary action: mind-claw of tu'narath.description: Twice per round, Inquisitor W'wargaz can spend a Legendary Action to summon a Mind-Claw of Tu'narath after he or his allies are struck.

legendary action: murderous retort.name: Legendary Action: Murderous Retort
legendary action: murderous retort.description: Once per round, Orin or Sarevok can use their Legendary Action to immediately strike back at their attacker.

legendary action: ocular nightmare.name: Legendary Action: Ocular Nightmare
legendary action: ocular nightmare.description: After accumulating five Paranoid Dreams, the Spectator will spend a Legendary Action to cast Ocular Nightmare.

legendary action: overflowing brew.name: Legendary Action: Overflowing Brew
legendary action: overflowing brew.description: Once per round, Thisobald Thorm can use his Legendary Action when his brew is changed by a foe's attack to make it overflow, dealing 3d6 of the corresponding damage type.

legendary action: psionic visage.name: Legendary Action: Psionic Visage
legendary action: psionic visage.description: Once per round, Nere can use his Legendary Action to cast Psionic Visage on himself when attacked.

legendary action: ptarian dogma.name: Legendary Action: Ptarian Dogma
legendary action: ptarian dogma.description: Once per round, after being hit, Ptaris can spend a Legendary Action to surround his attacker in Ptarian Pacifism.

legendary action: sanctuary of loss.name: Legendary Action: Sanctuary of Loss
legendary action: sanctuary of loss.description: Once per round, Viconia can use a Legendary Action to cast Sanctuary of Loss when an ally is struck.

legendary action: sanguine lash.name: Legendary Action: Sanguine Lash
legendary action: sanguine lash.description: Once per round, Orin can use her Legendary Action to Sanguine Lash after being attacked.

legendary action: shredding scales.name: Legendary Action: Shredding Scales
legendary action: shredding scales.description: Once per turn, the Bulette can spend a Legendary Action to use Shredding Scales after being hit if its Diamond Scales are active.

legendary action: soul ascension.name: Legendary Action: Soul Ascension
legendary action: soul ascension.description: Raphael can spend a Legendary Action to immediately cast Soul Ascension when he or his allies are attacked.

legendary action: soul sacrifice.name: Legendary Action: Soul Sacrifice
legendary action: soul sacrifice.description: Once per round when a humanoid dies, the Ch'r'ai can spend a legendary action to Sacrifice its soul to Vlaakith in return for great power. Once 3 souls have been sacrificed, the Ch'r'ai takes on Vlaakith's Undying Aspect.

legendary action: spectral aspect.name: Legendary Action: Spectral Aspect
legendary action: spectral aspect.description: Once per round, Balthazar can use his Legendary Action to adopt a Spectral Aspect after being struck.

legendary action: sublimation.name: Legendary Action: Sublimation
legendary action: sublimation.description: Once per round, if she loses a piece of armour, Gerringothe Thorm can spend a Legendary Action to try and turn her enemies into gold, incapacitating them for 4 turns.

legendary action: the dead wastes.name: Legendary Action: The Dead Wastes
legendary action: the dead wastes.description: Once per round when a creature dies, Balthazar can use his Legendary Action to create a necrotic miasma where it fell that heals Undead 4d6 Hit Points and deals 4d6 Necrotic to living creatures at the start of their turns.

legendary action: torrential undeath.name: Legendary Action: Torrential Undeath
legendary action: torrential undeath.description: Once per turn, Mystic Carrion can use his Legendary Action to release Torrential Undeath at his foes when hit.

legendary action: tu'narath's embrace.name: Legendary Action: Tu'narath's Embrace
legendary action: tu'narath's embrace.description: Once per round, Ch'r'ai Har'rak can spend a Legendary Action to cast Tu'narath's Embrace on an ally to prevent an Incapacitating Condition.

legendary action: tyrannical branding.name: Legendary Action: Tyrannical Branding
legendary action: tyrannical branding.description: Once per round, Gortash can use his Legendary Action to immediately Brand his attacker after being struck.

legendary action: vampiric swarm.name: Legendary Action: Vampiric Swarm
legendary action: vampiric swarm.description: Once per round, Cazador can spend a Legendary Action to conjure a Vampiric Swarm.

legendary action: vengeful playmate.name: Legendary Action: Vengeful Playmate
legendary action: vengeful playmate.description: Once per round, Oliver can spend a Legendary Action to summon The Wasting Quiet in an area after a summoned shadow is slain.

legendary action: wail of loss.name: Legendary Action: Wail of Loss
legendary action: wail of loss.description: Once per round, Malus Thorm can use his Legendary Action after being attacked to make every assistant cast Wail of Loss simultaneously.

legendary action: weird magic surge.name: Legendary Action: Weird Magic Surge
legendary action: weird magic surge.description: Once per round, Auntie Ethel can spend a Legendary Action to summon more illusory duplicates and shuffle herself among them after a spell is cast.

legendary action: wretched growth.name: Legendary Action: Wretched Growth
legendary action: wretched growth.description: If a creature ends its turn within 5 m (17 ft) of the Shambling Mound, it will take 3d10 Necrotic and Shadow-Cursed Vines will grow at its feet, possibly Entangling it.

legendary mobility.name: Legendary Mobility
legendary mobility.description: You gain Freedom of Movement and Longstrider.

legendary persistence.name: Legendary Persistence
legendary persistence.description: You gain Resistance and Blade Ward.

legion of bees.name: Legion of Bees
legion of bees.description: You gain a swarm of bees that fights on your side. Once per round, the swarm can assist you in one of three ways after you attack an enemy: it can attack and deal additional Piercing damage, push the enemy away from you, or teleport you to a safer location.

lesser infernal retribution.name: Lesser Infernal Retribution
lesser infernal retribution.description: When you are hit by a foe within 2 m (7 ft), it might take 1d4 Fire damage.

lesser infernal touch.name: Lesser Infernal Touch
lesser infernal touch.description: Your weapon attacks deal an additional 1d4 Fire damage. Your unarmed attacks deal an additional 1d4 Necrotic damage, and can possibly inflict Bleeding.

let the undead blanch with fear.name: Let The Undead Blanch With Fear
let the undead blanch with fear.description: Undead have Disadvantage on attack rolls against you, and you have Advantage on Saving Throws against their actions and spells.

lethal weapon.name: Lethal Weapon
lethal weapon.description: This weapon ignores resistance to Bludgeoning damage.

liberated spellcasting.name: Liberated Spellcasting
liberated spellcasting.description: When you kill a creature, you can cast a Level 1 spell without expending a spell slot.

lickspittle's alertness.name: Lickspittle's Alertness
lickspittle's alertness.description: At the start of combat, the wearer gains Momentum equal to their Charisma Modifier.

life essence harvest.name: Life Essence Harvest
life essence harvest.description: When the wielder kills a hostile creature with a spell, they greedily absorb its energy and gain Life Essence until their next Long Rest.

life of the party.name: Life of the Party
life of the party.description: Every time Intoxicating Strike hits, the monk gains Life of the Party, which increases Armour Class and Attack Rolls against Drunk targets.

life stealing critical.name: Life Stealing Critical
life stealing critical.description: On a Critical Hit, the target takes an extra 10 Necrotic DRS damage as long as it isn't a construct or an undead. You also gain 10 temporary hit points.

lifecharger.name: Lifecharger
lifecharger.description: When the wearer gains Lightning Charges, they also gain 3 Temporary Hit Points. The temporary hit points disappear if the wearer runs out of Lightning Charges.

lifedrinker.name: Lifedrinker
lifedrinker.description: Attacks made with your melee weapon deal additional necrotic damage equal to your Charisma modifier.

light sensitivity.name: Light Sensitivity
light sensitivity.description: While in bright light, this creature has Disadvantage on Attack Rolls and Perception Checks that rely on sight.

lightly armoured.name: Lightly Armoured
lightly armoured.description: You gain Armour Proficiency with Light armour and your Strength or Dexterity increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.

lightning absorption.name: Lightning Absorption
lightning absorption.description: When this entity is subjected to Lightning damage, it takes no damage and instead regains hit points equal to the Lightning damage dealt.

lightning strikes.name: Lightning Strikes
lightning strikes.description: Your unarmed attacks deal an additional 1d4 Lightning .

living shadow.name: Living Shadow
living shadow.description: While Lightly or Heavily Obscured, this character has Resistance to all damage except Force , Psychic or Radiant .

lofty sorcery.name: Lofty Sorcery
lofty sorcery.description: Grants an additional sorcery point to the wearer, which is restored on long rest along with your normal sorcery points.

loving protection.name: Loving Protection
loving protection.description: Once per Short Rest, if you are below 50% Hit Points and take damage, you gain 8 temporary hit points.

luck of the far realms.name: Luck of the Far Realms
luck of the far realms.description: Once per Long Rest, you can change a successful Attack Roll against a foe into a Critical Hit.

lucky.name: Lucky
lucky.description: You gain 3 Luck Points, which you can use to gain Advantage on Attack Rolls, Ability Checks, or Saving Throws, or to make an enemy reroll their Attack Rolls.

lunar bestial fortitude.name: Lunar Bestial Fortitude
lunar bestial fortitude.description: You have a +2 bonus to Armour Class. You also have Advantage on Saving Throws against spells. This effect persists while using your druidic Wild Shape ability.

lunar bestial vitality.name: Lunar Bestial Vitality
lunar bestial vitality.description: You gain 22 temporary hit points after casting Wild Shape. While those temporary hit points are active reduce all incoming damage by 1.

mage breaker.name: Mage Breaker
mage breaker.description: You have a history of battling spellcasters. You gain Proficiency in Arcana and can cast True Strike.

mage hand legerdemain.name: Mage Hand Legerdemain
mage hand legerdemain.description: When you cast Mage Hand, the spectral hand is invisible and permanent.

mage slayer: attack caster.name: Mage Slayer: Attack Caster
mage slayer: attack caster.description: You can use a Reaction to make an attack against an enemy after it casts a spell within 1.5 m (5 ft) of you.

mage slayer: break concentration.name: Mage Slayer: Break Concentration
mage slayer: break concentration.description: Enemies you hit have Disadvantage when making Saving Throws to maintain their Concentration. [See Notes]

mage slayer: saving throw advantage.name: Mage Slayer: Saving Throw Advantage
mage slayer: saving throw advantage.description: When a creature casts a spell within melee range of you, you have Advantage on any Saving Throws against it.

magic arrow.name: Magic Arrow
magic arrow.description: All of your ranged attacks are considered magical to overcome Resistance.

magic club.name: Magic Club
magic club.description: In the Wood Woad's hand, a common club becomes magical and deals 3d4 Bludgeoning DRS damage extra.

magic initiate: bard.name: Magic Initiate: Bard
magic initiate: bard.description: You have learnt 2 cantrips and a Level 1 spell from the Bard spell list.

magic initiate: cleric.name: Magic Initiate: Cleric
magic initiate: cleric.description: You have learnt 2 cantrips and a Level 1 spell from the Cleric spell list.

magic initiate: druid.name: Magic Initiate: Druid
magic initiate: druid.description: You have learnt 2 cantrips and a Level 1 spell from the Druid spell list.

magic initiate: sorcerer.name: Magic Initiate: Sorcerer
magic initiate: sorcerer.description: You have learnt 2 cantrips and a Level 1 spell from the Sorcerer spell list.

magic initiate: warlock.name: Magic Initiate: Warlock
magic initiate: warlock.description: You have learnt 2 cantrips and a Level 1 spell from the Warlock spell list. These spells cannot be upcast.

magic initiate: wizard.name: Magic Initiate: Wizard
magic initiate: wizard.description: You have learnt 2 cantrips and a Level 1 spell from the Wizard spell list.

magic resistance.name: Magic Resistance
magic resistance.description: Has Advantage on Saving Throws against Spells and other magical effects.

magical ambush.name: Magical Ambush
magical ambush.description: While you are Hiding, your targets have Disadvantage on Saving Throws against your Spells.

magical durability.name: Magical Durability
magical durability.description: The wielder has a +1 bonus to Saving Throws against spells.

magical plate.name: Magical Plate
magical plate.description: All incoming damage is reduced by 1

malefic excretion.name: Malefic Excretion
malefic excretion.description: Your weapon attacks also deal 2 Acid damage.

malefic funghi.name: Malefic Funghi
malefic funghi.description: The wearer gains a +1 bonus to Spell Save DC and when dealing Necrotic damage, they deal an additional 1 Necrotic damage.

man's best friend.name: Man's Best Friend
man's best friend.description: This hunting dog's Armour Class and damage increase by an amount equal to the Proficiency Bonus of its houndmaster.

manifestation of body.name: Manifestation of Body
manifestation of body.description: Your hands sap the ki from your enemies' bodies. Your unarmed attacks deal an additional 1d4 + Wisdom Modifier Necrotic damage.

manifestation of mind.name: Manifestation of Mind
manifestation of mind.description: Your hands sap the ki from your enemies' bodies. Your unarmed attacks deal an additional 1d4 + Wisdom Modifier Psychic damage.

manifestation of soul.name: Manifestation of Soul
manifestation of soul.description: Your hands sap the ki from your enemies' bodies. Your unarmed attacks deal an additional 1d4 + Wisdom Modifier Radiant damage.

mantle of inspiration.name: Mantle of Inspiration
mantle of inspiration.description: Imbued with bardic vigour. When a creature hits you with a melee attack, they become Charmed.

marked.name: Marked
marked.description: Attacker has Advantage on its next attack against the Marked target.

marksmanship.name: Marksmanship
marksmanship.description: You gain a +1 bonus to Ranged Attack Rolls and Thrown Attack Rolls.

martial adept.name: Martial Adept
martial adept.description: Learn two manoeuvres from the Battle Master Fighter subclass and receive 1 (additional) Superiority Die to fuel them. You regain expended Superiority Dice after a Short or Long Rest.

martial advantage.name: Martial Advantage
martial advantage.description: Once per turn, the Hobgoblin can deal an extra 2d6 Physical damage to a creature it hits with a weapon attack. The hobgoblin must have an ally who is within 2 m (7 ft) of the target and isn't Incapacitated.

martial arts: bonus unarmed strike.name: Martial Arts: Bonus Unarmed Strike
martial arts: bonus unarmed strike.description: After making an attack with a melee Monk weapon or while unarmed, you can make another unarmed attack as a bonus action.

martial arts: deft strikes.name: Martial Arts: Deft Strikes
martial arts: deft strikes.description: Attacks with Monk Weapons and unarmed attacks deal 1d4 Bludgeoning damage, unless their normal damage is higher.

martial arts: dextrous attacks.name: Martial Arts: Dextrous Attacks
martial arts: dextrous attacks.description: Attacks with Monk weapons and unarmed attacks scale with your Dexterity instead of your Strength if your Dexterity is higher.

martial bravery.name: Martial Bravery
martial bravery.description: Your weapon and unarmed attacks deal an additional 2 damage while surrounded by 2 or more foes.

martial prodigy.name: Martial Prodigy
martial prodigy.description: A lifetime of relentless training gave you Armour proficiency with Light armour and Medium armour, as well as Proficiency with Shortswords, Longswords, and Greatswords.

mask of many faces.name: Mask of Many Faces
mask of many faces.description: You can cast Disguise Self on yourself at will, without expending a Spell Slot.

medium armour master.name: Medium Armour Master
medium armour master.description:
When you wear medium armour, it doesn't impose Disadvantage on Stealth checks. The bonus to Armour Class you can gain from your Dexterity modifier also becomes +3 instead of +2.
You must have Proficiency in Medium Armour to take this feat

melee caster.name: Melee Caster
melee caster.description: Instead of its Dexterity ability score modifier, the affected entity add its spellcasting modifier to attack rolls.

mental debilitation.name: Mental Debilitation
mental debilitation.description: When the wearer succeeds a Saving Throw against any foe's spells or actions, that foe gains Mental Fatigue.

mental inhibition.name: Mental Inhibition
mental inhibition.description: When a foe fails a Saving Throw against one of your spells or actions, they gain Mental Fatigue for 2 turns.

mental interference.name: Mental Interference
mental interference.description: When you deal Psychic damage, you also inflict Mental Fatigue for 2 turns.

merry revelry.name: Merry Revelry
merry revelry.description: This Redcap's Bloodlust is subdued when there are traces of alcohol in a target's blood, which means they will primarily target creatures who are sober.

metamagic: careful spell.name: Metamagic: Careful Spell
metamagic: careful spell.description: Allies automatically succeed Saving Throws against spells that required them.

metamagic: distant spell.name: Metamagic: Distant Spell
metamagic: distant spell.description: Increases the range of the spell by 50%. Melee spells are increased to 9 m (30 ft).

metamagic: empowered spell.name: Metamagic: Empowered Spell
metamagic: empowered spell.description:
Increase the cost of spells that deal direct damage by 1 Sorcery Point to roll their damage with Advantage.
You can use Empowered Spell in combination with other Metamagic.

metamagic: extended spell.name: Metamagic: Extended Spell
metamagic: extended spell.description: Double the duration of conditions, summons, and surfaces caused by spells.

metamagic: heightened spell.name: Metamagic: Heightened Spell
metamagic: heightened spell.description: Targets of spells that require saving throws have Disadvantage on their first saving throw.

metamagic: quickened spell.name: Metamagic: Quickened Spell
metamagic: quickened spell.description: Spells that take an Action take a Bonus Action instead.

metamagic: subtle spell.name: Metamagic: Subtle Spell
metamagic: subtle spell.description: You can cast spells while Silenced.

metamagic: twinned spell.name: Metamagic: Twinned Spell
metamagic: twinned spell.description:
Spells that only target 1 creature can target an additional creature.
Costs 1 Sorcery Point per Spell Slot level used. Cantrips also cost 1 Sorcery Point.

mighty cloud of jellyfish.name: Mighty Cloud of Jellyfish
mighty cloud of jellyfish.description: You gain a mighty swarm of jellyfish that fights on your side. Once per round, the swarm can assist you in one of three ways after you attack an enemy: it can attack and deal additional Lightning damage, Shock your enemy, or teleport you to a safer location.

mighty flurry of moths.name: Mighty Flurry of Moths
mighty flurry of moths.description: You gain a mighty swarm of moths that fights on your side. Once per round, the swarm can assist you in one of three ways after you attack an enemy: it can attack and deal additional Psychic damage, Blind and Slow your enemy, or teleport you to a safer location.

mighty legion of bees.name: Mighty Legion of Bees
mighty legion of bees.description: You gain a mighty swarm of bees that fights on your side. Once per round, the swarm can assist you in one of three ways after you attack an enemy: it can attack and deal additional Piercing damage, push the enemy away from you, or teleport you to a safer location.

mighty swarm.name: Mighty Swarm
mighty swarm.description: Your swarm has grown stronger. The swarm's regular attack now deals 1d8 damage, its special attack has one additional feature, and teleporting with your swarm now also increases your Armour Class for the rest of the round.

mindless rage.name: Mindless Rage
mindless rage.description:
Your rage becomes all-consuming, repelling outside influence.
While Frenzied, you can't be Charmed or Frightened , and Calm Emotions no longer ends your rage.

mindreader.name: Mindreader
mindreader.description: Ranged attacks have Disadvantage against this creature.

minions of chaos.name: Minions of Chaos
minions of chaos.description: You can cast Conjure Elemental with a Warlock spell slot.

mire the mind.name: Mire the Mind
mire the mind.description: You can cast Slow with a Warlock spell slot.

missile snaring.name: Missile Snaring
missile snaring.description: You can intercept missiles from ranged weapon attacks with a Reaction, reducing their damage by 1d10 + your Dexterity modifier.

misty escape.name: Misty Escape
misty escape.description: Upon taking damage, become Invisible by using Cloaking Mist. On your next turn, you can cast Misty Step, though this will break your invisibility.

misty presence.name: Misty Presence
misty presence.description: After taking damage this character may use Invisibility (Shadar-Kai) to turn Invisible.

mobile: evade difficult terrain.name: Mobile: Evade Difficult Terrain
mobile: evade difficult terrain.description: When you Dash, Difficult Terrain doesn't slow you down.

mobile: evade opportunity attack.name: Mobile: Evade Opportunity Attack
mobile: evade opportunity attack.description: If you move after making a melee attack, you don't provoke Opportunity Attacks from your target.

moderately armoured.name: Moderately Armoured
moderately armoured.description: You gain Proficiency with Medium Armour and Shields, and your Strength or Dexterity increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.

monsterslayer.name: Monsterslayer
monsterslayer.description: This weapon deals an additional 1d4 damage against Monstrosity type foes.

moonlight glaive: glowing.name: Moonlight Glaive: Glowing
moonlight glaive: glowing.description: This object shines with a glowing light in a radius of 6 m (20 ft).

morphic ambush.name: Morphic Ambush
morphic ambush.description: Any successful Attack Roll against a creature that has been Ambushed by a Doppelganger is a Critical Hit.

morphic evasion.name: Morphic Evasion
morphic evasion.description: Whenever you fail a Saving Throw against an attack from a non-hostile creature, you may succeed instead.

mortal reminder.name: Mortal Reminder
mortal reminder.description: When you land a Critical Hit against a creature, that creature and any nearby enemies must succeed a Wisdom Saving Throw or become Frightened until the end of their next turn.

mountain.name: Mountain
mountain.description: You can cast Mirror Image and Spike Growth.

mountainous poise.name: Mountainous Poise
mountainous poise.description: While using Patient Defence, you also benefit from the effect of Blade Ward.

multiattack.name: Multiattack
multiattack.description: Can Multiattack if the target is Frightened.

multiattack defence.name: Multiattack Defence
multiattack defence.description: When an enemy attacks you, they have a -4 penalty to additional Attack Rolls against you until the start of their next turn.

multiattack: bloodlust.name: Multiattack: Bloodlust
multiattack: bloodlust.description: The redcap can make a Multiattack while under the effects of Bloodlust.

multiattack: enraged.name: Multiattack: Enraged
multiattack: enraged.description: The owlbear can make a Multiattack while under the effects of Owlbear's Rage

multiattack: enwebbed.name: Multiattack: Enwebbed
multiattack: enwebbed.description: The ettercap can make a Multiattack if the target is Enwebbed.

multiattack: frightened.name: Multiattack: Frightened
multiattack: frightened.description: The Mummy can Multiattack if the target is Frightened.

multiattack: last resort.name: Multiattack: Last Resort
multiattack: last resort.description: Raphael can Multiattack in his Ascended Fiend form if all of his Soul Pillars have been destroyed and he has no Soul Charges.

multiattack: lured.name: Multiattack: Lured
multiattack: lured.description: The harpy can make a Multiattack if the target is Lured.

multiattack: morphic ambush.name: Multiattack: Morphic Ambush
multiattack: morphic ambush.description: Can Multiattack if the target is Ambushed.

multiattack: muddy.name: Multiattack: Muddy
multiattack: muddy.description: Can Multiattack if the target is Muddy or is standing in Mud.

multiattack: prone.name: Multiattack: Prone
multiattack: prone.description: Sovereign Glut can use Multiattack against a target that's Prone.

multiattack: prone restrained or maimed.name: Multiattack: Prone Restrained or Maimed
multiattack: prone restrained or maimed.description: This Steel Watcher can Multiattack any Prone, Maimed, or Restrained creature.

multiattack: spores.name: Multiattack: Spores
multiattack: spores.description: The sovereign myconid can use Multiattack against a target that's Befuddled or under the influence of either Noxious Fumes or Haste Spores.

multiattack: static discharge.name: Multiattack: Static Discharge
multiattack: static discharge.description: Benard can Multiattack while under the effects of his Static Discharge Aura.

multiattack: wounded.name: Multiattack: Wounded
multiattack: wounded.description: Malus Thorm can Multiattack if his hit points are at 40% or less.

multiattack: wounded target.name: Multiattack: Wounded Target
multiattack: wounded target.description: The drider can Multiattack if its target has fewer than all of its hit points.

multitasking.name: Multitasking
multitasking.description: You gain Advantage on Concentration Saving Throws.

murder hungry.name: Murder Hungry
murder hungry.description: Each time you kill a creature, gain 1 charge of Unstoppable.

murderous sight.name: Murderous Sight
murderous sight.description: You can see in the dark up to 3 m (10 ft). In addition, you gain a +2 bonus to Initiative.

muscular.name: Muscular
muscular.description: This creature is very strong. It has Advantage on Ability Checks and Saving Throws using Athletics.

mystra's blessing.name: Mystra's Blessing
mystra's blessing.description: Creatures you Bless also gain Mystra's Blessing for an additional 1d4 bonus to spell attack rolls. [See: Bugs]

natural pugilist.name: Natural Pugilist
natural pugilist.description: You gain a +1 bonus to Melee Unarmed Attack Rolls and damage.

naturally stealthy.name: Naturally Stealthy
naturally stealthy.description: Your nimble nature makes you skilled at concealment. You have Advantage on Stealth Checks.

nature's embrace.name: Nature's Embrace
nature's embrace.description: Increase your Wild Shape Charge by 1. This additional charge is restored upon taking a Long Rest.

nature's step.name: Nature's Step
nature's step.description:
Alter the terrain around you, allowing nearby allies in the area to travel with ease.
You and your allies within 4 m (13 ft) of range aren't affected by Difficult Terrain, can't be Restrained or Paralysed, and gain Resistance to Poison damage.

nature's vengeance.name: Nature's Vengeance
nature's vengeance.description: When the wearer stands on certain surfaces and casts a spell that deals damage, the target also suffers the surface's effects.

nature's ward.name: Nature's Ward
nature's ward.description: You can't be Charmed or Frightened by elementals and fey. Disease and poison also no longer affect you.

necromantic evasion.name: Necromantic Evasion
necromantic evasion.description: When you fail a Saving Throw against necromancy spells or spells cast by undead foes, you can use your reaction to succeed instead.

necrotic claws.name: Necrotic Claws
necrotic claws.description: Your attacks deal an extra 1d6 Necrotic damage.

needle burst.name: Needle Burst
needle burst.description: Explode in a Needle Burst upon dying.

night walker.name: Night Walker
night walker.description: The affected creature cannot be Enwebbed, Entangled, or Ensnared and cannot slip on Grease or Ice.

nightsinger's reply.name: Nightsinger's Reply
nightsinger's reply.description: While obscured by shadow, the wearer deals 1d4 Necrotic damage to attackers that hit them with a melee attack.

nimble alchemist.name: Nimble Alchemist
nimble alchemist.description: A potions master, Dolor can throw or drink potions as a free action.

nimble as a cat.name: Nimble As a Cat
nimble as a cat.description: You gain a +1 bonus to your Dexterity Saving Throws and also increase your Jump distance by 1.5 m (5 ft).

nimble attack.name: Nimble Attack
nimble attack.description: When the wielder hits an enemy with this weapon, they gain Momentum for 2 turns.

nimblefinger.name: Nimblefinger
nimblefinger.description: Gnomes are granted +2 to Dexterity. Halflings and Dwarves gain +1 Dexterity.

non-lethality.name: Non-Lethality
non-lethality.description: This weapon deals only Non-Lethal Damage.

nyrulna: glowing.name: Nyrulna: Glowing
nyrulna: glowing.description: This object shines with a glowing light in a radius of 6 m (20 ft).

oath of devotion tenets.name: Oath of Devotion Tenets
oath of devotion tenets.description:
Oath of Devotion paladins abide by the following tenets:
Courage. Stride dauntlessly into action.
Compassion. Show clemency when prudent, and lend your arm to those in need.
Duty. Tend your responsibilities, obey just laws, and support those entrusted to your care.

oath of the ancients tenets.name: Oath of the Ancients Tenets
oath of the ancients tenets.description:
Oath of the Ancients paladins abide by the following tenets:
Kindle the Light. Through your acts of mercy, kindness, and forgiveness, kindle the light of hope in the world, beating back despair.
Shelter the Light. Where there is good, beauty, love, and laughter in the world, stand against the wickedness that would swallow it. Where life flourishes, stand against the forces that would render it barren.
Preserve Your Own Light. Delight in song and laughter, in beauty and art. If you allow the light to die in your own heart, you can’t preserve it in the world.
Be the Light. Be a glorious beacon for all who live in despair. Let the light of your joy and courage shine forth in all your deeds.

oath of the crown tenets.name: Oath of the Crown Tenets
oath of the crown tenets.description:
Oath of the Crown paladins abide by the following tenets:
Law. Uphold civilisation and order.
Loyalty. Your word is your bond; without loyalty, oaths and laws are meaningless.
Responsibility. Deal with the consequences of your actions, and fulfil your duties and obligations.

oath of vengeance tenets.name: Oath of Vengeance Tenets
oath of vengeance tenets.description:
Oath of Vengeance paladins abide by the following tenets:
Fight the Greater Evil. Exerting your wisdom, identify the higher morality in any given instance, and fight for it.
No Mercy for the Wicked. Chasten those who dole out their villainy by wiping their blight from the world forever.

odd gift.name: Odd Gift
odd gift.description: While wearing Khalid's Gift, Jaheira cannot be Cursed .

one with shadows.name: One with Shadows
one with shadows.description: You learn how to cast One with Shadows.

opportune predator.name: Opportune Predator
opportune predator.description: When an entity enters your attack range, you can strike them.

opportunity attack.name: Opportunity Attack
opportunity attack.description: Automatically attack an enemy moving out of your reach.

order of nature.name: Order of Nature
order of nature.description: Undead creatures that hit the wearer receive 1d6 Radiant damage. Beasts that hit the wearer deal an additional 1d6 Radiant damage.

organ rearranger.name: Organ Rearranger
organ rearranger.description: Reduce the number you need to roll a Critical Hit while attacking by 1. This effect can stack. When you roll 2 damage or less, reroll the dice, taking the highest result.

otherworldly leap.name: Otherworldly Leap
otherworldly leap.description: You can cast the Enhance Leap spell without expending a spell slot.

outer-entity slayer.name: Outer-Entity Slayer
outer-entity slayer.description: When wielded against fey, fiends, or undead foes, this weapon has a +1d4 bonus to Damage and Attack Rolls.

overcharge.name: Overcharge
overcharge.description: Chance to Stun the wielder, unless it is a Construct.

pack tactics.name: Pack Tactics
pack tactics.description: When an ally is within 3 m (10 ft) of your target and is not Incapacitated, your Attack Rolls against the target have Advantage.

pact boon.name: Pact Boon
pact boon.description:
Your otherworldly patron bestows a gift upon you for your loyal service. You gain one of the following features of your choice:
==== Pact of the Chain====
Gain the service of a familiar, a fey spirit that takes a form you choose. This can be an animal, imp, or quasit.
* Find Familiar
* Find Familiar: Imp
* Find Familiar: Quasit
==== Pact of the Blade ====
You can Summon a pact weapon, or Bind the one you are wielding, making it magical.
Pact weapons use the wielder's Spellcasting Ability Modifier instead of Strength or Dexterity.
* Pact of the Blade
* Bind Pact Weapon
==== Pact of the Tome ====
Your patron grants you a grimoire called 'The Book of Shadows', which allows you to cast several spells.
* Guidance
* Vicious Mockery
* Thorn Whip

pact of the blade.name: Pact of the Blade
pact of the blade.description: You can Summon a pact weapon, or Bind the one you are wielding as one, making it magical.

pact of the chain.name: Pact of the Chain
pact of the chain.description: Gain the service of a familiar, a fey spirit that takes a form of your choosing. This can be an animal, imp, or quasit.

pact of the tome.name: Pact of the Tome
pact of the tome.description: Your patron grants you a grimoire called "The Book of Shadows", which allows you to cast Guidance, Vicious Mockery, and Thorn Whip.

paragon of charisma.name: Paragon of Charisma
paragon of charisma.description:
This Dark Justiciar was anointed by Shar as a sentinel of Charisma, representing one of her most valued attributes in a follower.
They have Advantage on all Charisma Saving Throws and Spell Attack Rolls.

paragon of intelligence.name: Paragon of Intelligence
paragon of intelligence.description:
This Dark Justiciar was anointed by Shar as a sentinel of Intelligence, representing one of her most valued attributes in a follower.
They have Advantage on all Intelligence Saving Throws and Spell Attack Rolls.

paragon of wisdom.name: Paragon of Wisdom
paragon of wisdom.description:
This Dark Justiciar was anointed by Shar as a sentinel of Wisdom, representing one of her most valued attributes in a follower.
They have Advantage on all Wisdom Saving Throws and Spell Attack Rolls.

paralysing critical.name: Paralysing Critical
paralysing critical.description: Once per Long Rest, when scoring a Critical Hit on a humanoid, the wearer can Paralyse the target for 2 turns.

parry.name: Parry
parry.description: Parry the next melee attack that hits you to reduce the damage by 1d8 + Dexterity Modifier.

partial ceremorphosis.name: Partial Ceremorphosis
partial ceremorphosis.description: You are in the early stages of transformation - gaining access to more aberrant powers as you evolve your illithid potential.

performer.name: Performer
performer.description: You gain Musical Instrument Proficiency, and your Charisma increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.

permanent mind sanctuary.name: Permanent Mind Sanctuary
permanent mind sanctuary.description: You can use actions and bonus actions interchangeably.

perseverance.name: Perseverance
perseverance.description: Once per Short Rest, when you are reduced to 0 hit points, retain 1 Hit Points instead.

personal space.name: Personal Space
personal space.description: After shoving an enemy [See Notes] , the wearer gains a +1 to their Armour Class until their next turn.

phalanx formation.name: Phalanx Formation
phalanx formation.description: Has Advantage on Attack Rolls if within 3 m (10 ft) of an ally that carries a shield and isn't Incapacitated.

piercing counter.name: Piercing Counter
piercing counter.description: When the wearer has 50% hit points or less and is damaged by a melee attack, they deal 1d4 Piercing to the attacker.

poison trails.name: Poison Trails
poison trails.description: When the wearer casts a spell that deals Poison damage, it deals an additional 1d4 Poison damage.

poisonous synergy.name: Poisonous Synergy
poisonous synergy.description: While concentrating, your melee weapon attacks deal an additional 1d4 Poison .

polearm master: bonus attack.name: Polearm Master: Bonus Attack
polearm master: bonus attack.description:
When attacking with a Glaive, Halberd, Pike, Quarterstaff, or Spear, you can use a Bonus Action to attack with the butt of your weapon.
This attack does 1d4 (1~4) + Strength or Dexterity modifier Bludgeoning

polearm master: opportunity attack.name: Polearm Master: Opportunity Attack
polearm master: opportunity attack.description: When wielding a glaive, halberd, quarterstaff, or spear, you can make an Opportunity Attack when a target comes within range.

portent.name: Portent
portent.description:
Your dreams grant you glimpses that let you influence the future.
After each Long Rest, the user gains two random Portent Dice. During the day, they can use their reaction to change the die of an Attack Roll or Saving Throw rolled near them to one of their Portent Dice.
Each Portent Die can only be used once; unused Portent Dice are lost at the end of the day.

potent cantrip.name: Potent Cantrip
potent cantrip.description:
Your cantrips become harder to evade entirely.
When a creature succeeds its Saving Throw against one of your cantrips, it still takes half the cantrip's damage, but suffers no additional effects.

potent healing.name: Potent Healing
potent healing.description: Whenever you are healed, you restore the maximum number of possible hit points.

potent spellcasting.name: Potent Spellcasting
potent spellcasting.description:
Your god grants you even more intense power.
You can add your Wisdom Modifier to the damage you deal with Cleric cantrips.

prey decelerator.name: Prey Decelerator
prey decelerator.description: When this weapon lands a Critical Hit, it also Slows the target creature.

prey upon the weak.name: Prey Upon the Weak
prey upon the weak.description: This weapon deals an additional 1d4 Piercing damage against targets with 50% of their hit points or fewer.

prey's scent.name: Prey's Scent
prey's scent.description: You deal an additional 1d6 Physical damage to creatures marked by your Ranger's Hunter's Mark.

primal strike.name: Primal Strike
primal strike.description: While in beast form, your attacks count as magical for the purpose of overcoming Resistance and Immunity to non-magical damage.

prime aegis of fire.name: Prime Aegis of Fire
prime aegis of fire.description: You have Resistance to Fire damage and cannot be Burned. You take 3 less damage from all sources.

projected ward.name: Projected Ward
projected ward.description: When a nearby ally takes damage and you have an active Arcane Ward, you can sacrifice your ward to reduce the damage they take equal to its charges and then lose 1 charge.

promised victory.name: Promised Victory
promised victory.description: On a hit, possibly inflict Guiding Bolt upon the target.

propelling strike.name: Propelling Strike
propelling strike.description: On a hit, push the target 4.5 m (15 ft) away from you.

protection.name: Protection
protection.description: When you have a Shield, impose Disadvantage on an enemy who attacks one of your allies when you are within 1.5 m (5 ft). You must be able to see the enemy.

psionic backlash.name: Psionic Backlash
psionic backlash.description: When an enemy within 9 m (30 ft) casts a spell, you can use your reaction to inflict 1d4 Psychic damage to the caster per the spell's level.

psionic dominance.name: Psionic Dominance
psionic dominance.description: When an enemy within 18 m (60 ft) targets you with a spell of a Level that is lower than or equal to your Proficiency Bonus, you can use your reaction to nullify the spell.

psionic empowerment.name: Psionic Empowerment
psionic empowerment.description: Your attacks deal an extra 1d6 Psychic damage - the scars of illithid enslavement run deep.

psionic retribution.name: Psionic Retribution
psionic retribution.description: The Netherbrain permits no interference - as a reaction to taking damage, it releases Brainquakes.

psionic revenge.name: Psionic Revenge
psionic revenge.description: When you succeed a Saving Throw, the foe that caused the throw takes 1d4 Psychic . Githyanki also gain a +1 bonus to Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma Saving Throws.

psionic skin.name: Psionic Skin
psionic skin.description: Removes all conditions at the start of its turns.

psionic ward.name: Psionic Ward
psionic ward.description:
If the item detects that the wearer is gith, they have Resistance to Psychic damage.
Whenever the wearer succeeds on a Saving Throw against a spell, they regain 1d4 Hit Points .

psychic leech.name: Psychic Leech
psychic leech.description: When an enemy fails a Charisma, Intelligence, or Wisdom Saving Throw against one of your spells or cantrips, you regain 1d4 Hit Points .

psychic missiles.name: Psychic Missiles
psychic missiles.description: Shoot an additional dart whenever you cast Magic Missile.

psychic steel virtuoso.name: Psychic Steel Virtuoso
psychic steel virtuoso.description: When the wielder attacks with Advantage, they deal an additional 1d8 Psychic .

psychic vengeance.name: Psychic Vengeance
psychic vengeance.description: When the wearer has 50% Hit Points or less, they deal an additional 1d4 Psychic .

purity of body.name: Purity of Body
purity of body.description: You are Immune to Poison damage and can't be Poisoned or affected by disease thanks to the purifying ki flowing through your meridians.

quickened mage hand.name: Quickened Mage Hand
quickened mage hand.description: You can cast Mage Hand as a Bonus Action.

quickspell flinger.name: Quickspell Flinger
quickspell flinger.description: Cantrips that cost an Action cost a Bonus Action instead. This effect can be used once per Short Rest.

radiant strike.name: Radiant Strike
radiant strike.description: On a hit, inflict 1 turn of Radiating Orb upon the target.

radiating orb gloves.name: Radiating Orb Gloves
radiating orb gloves.description: When the wearer deals Radiant damage, the target receives 2 turns of Radiating Orb.

radiating shockwave.name: Radiating Shockwave
radiating shockwave.description: When the wearer deals Radiant damage, they cause a Radiant Shockwave.

rage becomes frenzy.name: Rage Becomes Frenzy
rage becomes frenzy.description: Your bloodthirst transforms your rage, making it stronger.

rakish audacity.name: Rakish Audacity
rakish audacity.description:
You gain a +2 bonus to initiative rolls. This scales with your rogue level.
You no longer need Advantage to trigger Sneak Attack as long as you are within 1.5 m (5 ft) of the target and don't have Disadvantage. [See: Bugs]

rampage.name: Rampage
rampage.description: When a Gnoll Downs a creature with a melee attack, the gnoll can use a Bonus Action to move up to half its Movement Speed and make a bite attack.

rampart aura.name: Rampart Aura
rampart aura.description: Costs Force Conduit to remain active. All entities with or in this aura have their movement speed halved.

ranger knight.name: Ranger Knight
ranger knight.description: You have sworn to serve a crown or nation and seek to bring its foes to ruin. Gain Proficiency with History and Proficiency with Heavy Armour.

rapid caster.name: Rapid Caster
rapid caster.description: Each time they Dash, the wearer gains Arcane Charge for 2 turns.

rat catcher.name: Rat Catcher
rat catcher.description: Attack Rolls against beasts have Advantage.

reaper.name: Reaper
reaper.description: Your Necromancy cantrips that only target 1 creature can target an additional creature.

reaper's rigidity.name: Reaper's Rigidity
reaper's rigidity.description: When activated, you can't be moved against your will by any spell or action, but have Disadvantage on Dexterity Saving Throws.

rebuke of the mighty.name: Rebuke of the Mighty
rebuke of the mighty.description: When a foe hits you with a melee attack, you can use your reaction, dealing 2d4 Force damage and knock it Prone unless they succeed a Dexterity Saving Throw.

reckless attack (passive feature).name: Reckless Attack (passive feature)
reckless attack (passive feature).description: Gain Advantage on Attack Rolls until the end of your turn, but enemies also have Advantage against you.

redirect attack.name: Redirect Attack
redirect attack.description: When a creature misses you with a melee attack, you can spend 1 Ki Point as a reaction to make an unarmed attack against the attacker.

redvein savagery.name: Redvein Savagery
redvein savagery.description: When you make an attack with Advantage, the target takes an additional 7 Piercing DRS damage.

refined vaulting.name: Refined Vaulting
refined vaulting.description: Jump distance is increased by 1.5 m (5 ft).

regeneration.name: Regeneration
regeneration.description: The wood woad regains 10 hit points if it walks through a vine surface, unless it recently took Fire damage.

regret.name: Regret
regret.description: The wielder takes 1 Psychic damage whenever they deal damage using this blade.

rejuvenating takedown.name: Rejuvenating Takedown
rejuvenating takedown.description: Whenever the wearer knocks a creature unconscious, the wearer regains 1d6 Hit Points .

relentless avenger.name: Relentless Avenger
relentless avenger.description: If you hit an enemy with an Opportunity Attack, your movement speed increases by 4.5 m (15 ft) on your next turn.

relentless endurance.name: Relentless Endurance
relentless endurance.description: If you reach 0 hit points, you regain 1 Hit Points instead of becoming Downed.

relentless rage.name: Relentless Rage
relentless rage.description: Once per Short Rest, if you drop to 0 hit points while Enraged, you regain 1 Hit Points instead of being Downed.

relentless revenge.name: Relentless Revenge
relentless revenge.description: When the wielder has 50% hit points or less, they deal an additional 1d4 Slashing damage.

reliable talent.name: Reliable Talent
reliable talent.description: When you make an Ability Check with a Skill you are Proficient with, the lowest result you can roll on the die is 10.

remarkable athlete: jump.name: Remarkable Athlete: Jump
remarkable athlete: jump.description: You're a master of your own body, your athletic prowess extended beyond the usual. Your Jump distance is increased by 3 m (10 ft).

remarkable athlete: proficiency.name: Remarkable Athlete: Proficiency
remarkable athlete: proficiency.description: You're a master of your own body, your athletic prowess extended beyond the usual. You can add half of your Proficiency Bonus to any Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution Checks that you are not Proficient in.

remedial rhymes.name: Remedial Rhymes
remedial rhymes.description: When you inspire an ally using Bardic Inspiration, you gain 4 temporary hit points.

rend with white lightning.name: Rend With White Lightning
rend with white lightning.description: Successful weapon attacks deal an additional 1d8 Lightning .

repelling blast.name: Repelling Blast
repelling blast.description: When you hit a creature with Eldritch Blast, you can push the creature up to 4.5 m (15 ft) away from you.

resilient: charisma.name: Resilient: Charisma
resilient: charisma.description:
* You increase your Charisma by 1, to a maximum of 20.
* Gain Proficiency in Charisma Saving Throws.

resilient: constitution.name: Resilient: Constitution
resilient: constitution.description:
* You increase your Constitution by 1, to a maximum of 20.
* Gain Proficiency in Constitution Saving Throws.

resilient: dexterity.name: Resilient: Dexterity
resilient: dexterity.description:
* You increase your Dexterity by 1, to a maximum of 20.
* Gain Proficiency in Dexterity Saving Throws.

resilient: intelligence.name: Resilient: Intelligence
resilient: intelligence.description:
* You increase your Intelligence by 1, to a maximum of 20.
* Gain Proficiency in Intelligence Saving Throws.

resilient: strength.name: Resilient: Strength
resilient: strength.description:
* You increase an Ability by 1, to a maximum of 20.
* Gain Proficiency in that ability's Saving Throws.

resilient: wisdom.name: Resilient: Wisdom
resilient: wisdom.description:
* You increase your Wisdom by 1, to a maximum of 20.
* Gain Proficiency in Wisdom Saving Throws.

retaliation.name: Retaliation
retaliation.description: Strike back at the next enemy that attacks you.

revenant scourge.name: Revenant Scourge
revenant scourge.description: When used against undead creatures this weapon has +1d4 bonus to Attack and Damage rolls.

revenant's ire.name: Revenant's Ire
revenant's ire.description: This profane entity's weapon attacks deal an additional 4d8 Necrotic damage.

ring of gorgeous bolts.name: Ring of Gorgeous Bolts
ring of gorgeous bolts.description: When you deal Lightning damage, deal an additional 2.

ring of veracity.name: Ring of Veracity
ring of veracity.description: You gain an Advantage on Insight Checks.

riposte.name: Riposte
riposte.description: When a hostile creature misses you with a melee attack, expend a superiority die to retaliate with a powerful strike that deals an additional Superiority Die damage.

risky attack.name: Risky Attack
risky attack.description: You gain Advantage on Attack Rolls and receive Disadvantage on Saving Throws.

ritual caster: free spells.name: Ritual Caster: Free Spells
ritual caster: free spells.description:
You learn two Ritual Spells of your choice from the following:
* Speak with Dead
* Find Familiar
* Longstrider
* Enhance Leap
* Disguise Self
* Speak with Animals

ruintamer heart.name: Ruintamer Heart
ruintamer heart.description: While Raging, the wearer generates 2 turns of Wrath. [See: Bugs]

running jump.name: Running Jump
running jump.description: Once per turn, after the wearer Dashes or takes a similar action, they can Jump without using a Bonus Action.

rupturing.name: Rupturing
rupturing.description: On a hit, the target becomes Ruptured for 3 turns.

sanctified stalker.name: Sanctified Stalker
sanctified stalker.description: You swore to hunt the enemies of a holy or druidic order. You gain Proficiency in Religion and can cast Sacred Flame.

sanctified weapon.name: Sanctified Weapon
sanctified weapon.description: Undead creatures struck by this weapon are possibly Turned.

savage attacker.name: Savage Attacker
savage attacker.description: When making melee weapon attacks, you roll your damage dice twice and use the highest result.

savage attacks.name: Savage Attacks
savage attacks.description: When you land a Critical Hit with a melee weapon attack, you deal an extra die of weapon damage.

saviour's allure.name: Saviour's Allure
saviour's allure.description: You restore an additional 2 Hit Points every time you heal another creature.

scar of dark thirst.name: Scar of Dark Thirst
scar of dark thirst.description: This character's attacks may apply Bleeding if its HP are less than 90%.

scar of fury.name: Scar of Fury
scar of fury.description: Score a Critical Hit when your health is lower than 40%.

scar of mirages.name: Scar of Mirages
scar of mirages.description: This character's attacks may apply Confused if its hit points are less than 90%.

scar of the agave.name: Scar of the Agave
scar of the agave.description: When this character is struck by a melee attack while at less than 60% of their hit points, the attacker takes 2d8 Piercing damage.

scar of the dunes.name: Scar of the Dunes
scar of the dunes.description: This character's movement speed is doubled and it cannot be targeted by attacks of opportunity, if its hit points are lower than 90%.

scar of the sand eclipse.name: Scar of the Sand Eclipse
scar of the sand eclipse.description: Your attacks deal an additional 4d8 Slashing damage when your hit points are at 20% or lower.

scar of the sirocco.name: Scar of the Sirocco
scar of the sirocco.description: This character's attacks may apply Prone if its hit points are less that 90%.

scarlet remittance.name: Scarlet Remittance
scarlet remittance.description: Gain a +1 bonus to Attack Rolls, damage, and Spell Save DC for every foe you slay, up to a maximum of +3.

scenting blood.name: Scenting Blood
scenting blood.description: If the sahuagin sees a wounded creature, it becomes Blood Frenzied.

scintillating.name: Scintillating
scintillating.description: You gain a +1 bonus to Charisma Ability Checks and Saving Throws.

scourge of pests.name: Scourge of Pests
scourge of pests.description: Deals an additional 1d6 Fire damage to Plants, Myconids [See: Bugs] , and Small creatures.

sculpt spells.name: Sculpt Spells
sculpt spells.description: Create pockets of safety within your Evocation spells. Allies automatically succeed their Saving Throws against these spells and take no damage from them.

sculptor of flesh.name: Sculptor of Flesh
sculptor of flesh.description: You can cast Polymorph with a Warlock spell slot.

second-story work.name: Second-Story Work
second-story work.description: You've mastered the art of falling and gain Resistance to Falling damage.

second-story work: climbing.name: Second-Story Work: Climbing
second-story work: climbing.description: Climbing no longer costs you extra movement speed.

seeking blood.name: Seeking Blood
seeking blood.description: You gain a +2 bonus to Attack Rolls when attacking creatures that have already taken damage.

seeking spell.name: Seeking Spell
seeking spell.description: When you make a Spell Attack Roll, you can spend a Sorcery Point to gain Advantage. This costs 1 Sorcery Point per spell slot Level. Cantrips cost 1 Sorcery Point.

seldom caught unawares.name: Seldom Caught Unawares
seldom caught unawares.description: You gain a +1 bonus to Initiative rolls.

selûne's blessing.name: Selûne's Blessing
selûne's blessing.description: You gain Advantage on Wisdom Saving Throws and Perception Checks.

selûne's ire.name: Selûne's Ire
selûne's ire.description: The Sliver can immediately deal 12d12 Radiant damage to an attacker. It can use Selûne's Ire again after its next turn.

selûne's protection.name: Selûne's Protection
selûne's protection.description: While the wearer has Mage Armour, each successful Saving Throw causes the source of the Saving Throw to take 1d4 Radiant damage.

semblance of fey.name: Semblance of Fey
semblance of fey.description: You have Advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma Saving Throws.

sentinel weapon.name: Sentinel Weapon
sentinel weapon.description: Gain a +1 bonus to Initiative rolls and Advantage on Perception Ability Checks.

sentinel: opportunity advantage.name: Sentinel: Opportunity Advantage
sentinel: opportunity advantage.description: You gain Advantage on Opportunity Attacks.

sentinel: snare.name: Sentinel: Snare
sentinel: snare.description: When you hit a creature with an Opportunity Attack, it can no longer move for the rest of its turn.

sentinel: vengeance.name: Sentinel: Vengeance
sentinel: vengeance.description: When an enemy in melee range attacks an ally, you can use a Reaction to make a weapon attack against that enemy. Target ally must not have the Sentinel feat.

shadeclinger.name: Shadeclinger
shadeclinger.description: While obscured, the wearer has Advantage on Saving Throws.

shadespell.name: Shadespell
shadespell.description: While the wearer is obscured in shadow, their spells gain a +1 bonus to Spell Save DC, making them more likely to succeed.

shadow ambush.name: Shadow Ambush
shadow ambush.description: This creature deals an additional 4d8 Necrotic damage when attacking from the shadows.

shadow blade.name: Shadow Blade
shadow blade.description: You have Advantage on Attack Rolls against Lightly or Heavily Obscured targets when using this blade.

shadow stealth.name: Shadow Stealth
shadow stealth.description: While Lightly or Heavily Obscured, this creature does not provoke opportunity attacks when they move away from a foe.

shadow veil.name: Shadow Veil
shadow veil.description: While Lightly or Heavily Obscured, the shadow mastiff is Resistant to non-magical Bludgeoning , Piercing , and Slashing damage.

shadow-blinding.name: Shadow-Blinding
shadow-blinding.description: If you attack with Advantage, you have a chance to Blind your target. [See: Bugs]

shadowblend.name: Shadowblend
shadowblend.description: While Lightly or Heavily Obscured, this creature gains the ability to blend with shadows and become Invisible.

shadowthief.name: Shadowthief
shadowthief.description: The wearer's weapon and unarmed attacks deal an additional 1d4 damage against Lightly or Heavily Obscured creatures, and creatures made of shadow.

shapechanger.name: Shapechanger
shapechanger.description: You can cast the Polymorph spell without expending a spell slot.

shapeshifter slayer.name: Shapeshifter Slayer
shapeshifter slayer.description: This weapon deals an additional 1d4 damage against shapeshifters or polymorphed creatures.

shapeshifter's boon.name: Shapeshifter's Boon
shapeshifter's boon.description: While shapeshifting or disguising yourself, gain a +1d4 bonus to all Ability Checks.

shar's blessing.name: Shar's Blessing
shar's blessing.description: You gain Advantage on Saving Throws while Lightly or Heavily Obscured. This weapon deals an additional 1d6 damage to creatures that are Lightly or Heavily Obscured.

shar's protection.name: Shar's Protection
shar's protection.description: While the wearer has Shield of Faith active, reduce all incoming damage by 2 and reflect damage received back at the attacker, who takes 1d4 Necrotic damage.

shar's rules.name: Shar's Rules
shar's rules.description: Damaging a Reflection that is not your own causes Shar to intervene, reducing all Ability Scores by 1 until your next Long Rest. This reduction can stack up to 4 times.

shar's umbrae.name: Shar's Umbrae
shar's umbrae.description: While obscured, the wearer has Advantage on Stealth Checks.

sharp caster.name: Sharp Caster
sharp caster.description: When you roll a 1 or 2 on a damage die(s) for a Spell Attack, that die(s) is rerolled once.

sharpened snare.name: Sharpened Snare
sharpened snare.description: Creatures have Disadvantage on Saving Throws when resisting your attacks and spells that inflict Restrained.

sharpshooter: all in.name: Sharpshooter: All In
sharpshooter: all in.description: Ranged weapon attacks with weapons you are Proficient with have a -5 penalty to their Attack Roll, but deal an additional 10 damage.

sharpshooter: low ground.name: Sharpshooter: Low Ground
sharpshooter: low ground.description: Your ranged weapon attacks are not penalized for High Ground Rules.

sharran veil.name: Sharran Veil
sharran veil.description: Shield of Faith also grants you a +2 to all Saving Throws.

shelter.name: Shelter
shelter.description: You have Advantage on Saving Throws against Charmed.

shield bash.name: Shield Bash
shield bash.description: When a foe hits you with a melee attack, you can use your reaction to knock it Prone unless they succeed a Dexterity Saving Throw.

shield conduit.name: Shield Conduit
shield conduit.description: The shield shrouds the wearer with Force Conduit at the start of its turn in combat.

shield master.name: Shield Master
shield master.description: Gain a +2 bonus to Dexterity Saving Throws when wielding a Shield.

shield master: block.name: Shield Master: Block
shield master: block.description:
If a spell forces you to make a Dexterity Saving Throw [See Notes] , you can use your Reaction to shield yourself and diminish the effect's damage.
On a failed save, you only take half damage [See: Bugs] . On a successful save, you don't take any damage, even if you normally would.

shield master: shove.name: Shield Master: Shove
shield master: shove.description: If you make a weapon attack, you can shove a creature with your shield as a bonus action.

shocking sting.name: Shocking Sting
shocking sting.description: On a hit, possibly Shock [See: Bugs] your target.

shockwave.name: Shockwave
shockwave.description: When the wearer Jumps, they deal 1d4 Thunder damage in a 3 m (10 ft) radius upon landing.

shoe slinger.name: Shoe Slinger
shoe slinger.description: Returns to its owner when thrown. On a hit deal an additional 2d4 Psychic damage.

shortened stride.name: Shortened Stride
shortened stride.description: Your movement speed is 7.5 m (25 ft).

shunt through space.name: Shunt Through Space
shunt through space.description: Using a Reaction after being damaged, Ptaris teleports as far as he can from the attacker.

sign of ill omen.name: Sign of Ill Omen
sign of ill omen.description: You can cast Bestow Curse with a Warlock Spell Slot.

silent.name: Silent
silent.description: This creature can't speak or cast spells that have a verbal component

skilled.name: Skilled
skilled.description: You gain Proficiency in 3 Skills of your choice.

skinburster force.name: Skinburster Force
skinburster force.description: When the wielder deals melee damage with this weapon, they gain 2 turns of Force Conduit.

skittish.name: Skittish
skittish.description: Will flee for 2 turns when badly hurt.

skulker: veiled ambusher.name: Skulker: Veiled Ambusher
skulker: veiled ambusher.description: You attack while Hidden without revealing your position.

skullduggery attack.name: Skullduggery Attack
skullduggery attack.description: Your Sneak Attack deals an additional 1d4 Force DRS damage.

slabjaw determination.name: Slabjaw Determination
slabjaw determination.description: You gain 15 temporary hit points whenever you Rage.

slay the wicked.name: Slay the Wicked
slay the wicked.description: This weapon deals an additional 1d6 Slashing damage against Fiends and Undead.

slayer knowledge.name: Slayer Knowledge
slayer knowledge.description: You have Advantage on Saving Throws against being Frightened by a Bhaalspawn Slayer - the tome Volo found was very informative.

slayer's extra attack.name: Slayer's Extra Attack
slayer's extra attack.description: You can make one additional attack after attacking with your main-hand weapon.

slayer's improved extra attack.name: Slayer's Improved Extra Attack
slayer's improved extra attack.description: You can make two additional attacks after attacking with your main-hand weapon.

slimy doom: stunned.name: Slimy Doom: Stunned
slimy doom: stunned.description: When the affected entity is hit with an attack, it becomes Stunned for 1 turn.

slippery slapsticky.name: Slippery Slapsticky
slippery slapsticky.description: When knocked Prone, a hostile creature with an Intelligence of 5 or more within 9 m (30 ft) of user must succeed a Wisdom Saving Throw or become stricken with Laughter.

slow fall.name: Slow Fall
slow fall.description: When you fall, you can use your reaction to gain Resistance to Falling damage.

slow: actions.name: Slow: Actions
slow: actions.description:
You can't take both an action and a bonus action. If you take an action, you lose a bonus action, and vice versa.
You also can't make more than 1 attack per turn.

slow: casting.name: Slow: Casting
slow: casting.description: If you cast a spell that costs 1 Action, roll a d20. On 11 or higher, you hang in prepare phase and skip turn. On your next turn you must spend an action point and finish casting. If you don't have an action point, the spell is cancelled.

smite the graceless.name: Smite the Graceless
smite the graceless.description: Creatures who miss their Attack Rolls against the wearer must make a DC 14 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 1d4 Radiant damage.

smooth start.name: Smooth Start
smooth start.description: At the start of combat, the wearer gains Momentum for 3 turns.

sneaky riposte.name: Sneaky Riposte
sneaky riposte.description: Strike a foe that just missed you with an attack, inflicting Sneak Attack damage if you have Advantage.

snowburst.name: Snowburst
snowburst.description: When the wearer deals Cold damage, they also create a 4.5 m (15 ft) circle of Ice around the target(s).

snowy liver.name: Snowy Liver
snowy liver.description: While Drunk you have Advantage on Constitution Saving Throws, and you gain Temporary Hit Points equal to your Constitution Modifier at the start of your turn.

song of defence.name: Song of Defence
song of defence.description: When you take damage during your Bladesong, you can expend a spell slot to subtract 5 damage per spell slot.

soothing songs.name: Soothing Songs
soothing songs.description: When you inspire an ally using Bardic Inspiration, they also regain 1d6 Hit Points .

soul catching.name: Soul Catching
soul catching.description: Once per turn, on an unarmed hit, you regain 10 Hit Points . Alternatively, you may forego healing to gain a +5 bonus on an Attack Roll or Saving Throw until the end of your next turn. [See: Bugs]

soul fist.name: Soul Fist
soul fist.description: Your unarmed attacks deal an additional 1d10 Force damage.

soul perception.name: Soul Perception
soul perception.description: Gain a +2 bonus to Attack Rolls, Initiative Rolls, and Perception Checks.

soul pillar proximity.name: Soul Pillar Proximity
soul pillar proximity.description: For each remaining Soul Pillar, Raphael's attacks deal an additional 1d12 Fire damage and he has a +3 bonus to his Dexterity score.

soul reaper.name: Soul Reaper
soul reaper.description: When Raphael reduces an enemy's hit points to 0, he Severs the soul from their body.

sparkswall armour.name: Sparkswall Armour
sparkswall armour.description: The wearer has +1 to Armour Class and Saving Throws as long as they have Lightning Charges.

speedy sparks.name: Speedy Sparks
speedy sparks.description: When the wearer Dashes or takes a similar action in combat, they gain 3 Lightning Charges

spell amplification.name: Spell Amplification
spell amplification.description: You gain an additional Level 2 Spell Slot.

spell protection.name: Spell Protection
spell protection.description: You have Advantage on Saving Throws against spells.
