spell resistance.name: Spell Resistance
spell resistance.description: You have Advantage on Saving Throws against spells.

spell sniper.name: Spell Sniper
spell sniper.description: You learn a cantrip, and the number you need to roll a Critical Hit while attacking with a Spell is reduced by 1. This effect can stack.

spellguard.name: Spellguard
spellguard.description: You gain Advantage on Saving Throws against spells. Spell Attack Rolls against you have Disadvantage.

spellmight.name: Spellmight
spellmight.description: When casting a spell that requires an Attack Roll, you can take a -5 penalty to the roll to deal an additional 1d8 damage.

spider fall.name: Spider Fall
spider fall.description: A network of spider silk slows the spider's fall, making it Resistant to Falling damage.

spider step.name: Spider Step
spider step.description: Immune to being Enwebbed. Your Movement Speed is not affected by Web surfaces.

spiteful thunder.name: Spiteful Thunder
spiteful thunder.description: When the wearer deals damage [See: Bugs] to a Reverberating creature, it becomes Dazed unless it succeeds a Constitution Saving Throw.

split enchantment.name: Split Enchantment
split enchantment.description: You know your enchantments inside and out. You can target 2 creatures with Enchantment spells that would normally only target 1 creature.

spore sacks.name: Spore Sacks
spore sacks.description: While imbued with Symbiotic Entity, you can spread Bibberbang Spores, Timmask Spores, and Haste Spores.

spreading spores.name: Spreading Spores
spreading spores.description: While Symbiotic Entity is active, you can create a cloud of Spreading Spores.

sprint.name: Sprint
sprint.description: Once per turn, the wearer can reduce the duration of their Momentum by 1 turn to Sprint.

sprouting necrosis.name: Sprouting Necrosis
sprouting necrosis.description: At the end of its turns, Shadow-Cursed Vines will sprout at this creature's feet.

staff of the ram.name: Staff of the Ram
staff of the ram.description: Once per turn, the blow possibly knocks a foe back 2 m (7 ft) and Stuns them. This has no effect on dragons or Huge creatures.

stalker's flurry.name: Stalker's Flurry
stalker's flurry.description: When you miss with a weapon attack, you can make another one for free.

starry form.name: Starry Form
starry form.description: You can expend a Wild Shape Charge to take on a Starry Form rather than transforming into a beast.

starry form: dragon.name: Starry Form: Dragon
starry form: dragon.description: When you make Intelligence or Wisdom Checks or Constitution Saving Throws, you can replace rolls of 9 or lower with a 10.

static discharge.name: Static Discharge
static discharge.description: Deal 2d8 Lightning to attackers if they are in the Static Discharge Aura.

staunch blessing.name: Staunch Blessing
staunch blessing.description:
When a creature misses the wielder with an attack, they gain a +1d4 bonus to their next Attack Roll that deals non-lethal damage.
This bonus is relinquished when the wielder deals lethal damage.

steadfast.name: Steadfast
steadfast.description: You cannot be forcibly moved by a foe's spells or actions, and you ignore the effects of Difficult Terrain.

stealthier.name: Stealthier
stealthier.description: While obscured, the wearer gains a +3 bonus to Stealth Checks.

stealthy.name: Stealthy
stealthy.description: Gain a +1 bonus to Stealth Checks.

stealthy critical.name: Stealthy Critical
stealthy critical.description: While Hiding, the number you need to roll a Critical Hit while attacking is reduced by 1. This effect can stack.

steel physiology.name: Steel Physiology
steel physiology.description: Reduce incoming Bludgeoning , Piercing , and Slashing damage by 1.

steel will.name: Steel Will
steel will.description: Advantage on Saving Throws against being Frightened.

steeped in slaughter.name: Steeped in Slaughter
steeped in slaughter.description: Has Advantage on Attack Rolls made against Bleeding foes.

stillness of mind.name: Stillness of Mind
stillness of mind.description: If you are Charmed or Frightened, you automatically cast Stillness of Mind to remove the condition.

sting the helpless.name: Sting The Helpless
sting the helpless.description: A Drow wielding this weapon deals an additional 1d4 Poison against Restrained targets.

stirring execution.name: Stirring Execution
stirring execution.description: When you kill an enemy, allies within 9 m (30 ft) gain temporary hit points equal to your [See: Bugs] Charisma Modifier (minimum 1).

stone camouflage.name: Stone Camouflage
stone camouflage.description: You have Advantage on Stealth checks.

storm's fury.name: Storm's Fury
storm's fury.description: When you are hit by a melee attack, you deal (Sorcerer Level) Lightning to the attacker and potentially push them away.

strange conduit.name: Strange Conduit
strange conduit.description: When Concentrating on a spell, the wearer's weapon attacks deal an additional 1d4 Psychic damage.

strength in suffering.name: Strength in Suffering
strength in suffering.description: Non-Cantrip spells deal an additional 1d4 Force damage when the wearer drops to half their hit points or lower.

strength of the grave.name: Strength of the Grave
strength of the grave.description: After reaching 0 Hit Points, you regain 1 instead of becoming downed.

strongheart resilience.name: Strongheart Resilience
strongheart resilience.description: You have Advantage on Saving Throws against being Poisoned and Resistance to Poison damage.

stygian empowerment.name: Stygian Empowerment
stygian empowerment.description: Affected entity's weapon attacks deal an additional 3d6 Piercing damage while within 18 m (60 ft) of Raphael

subtle swap.name: Subtle Swap
subtle swap.description: You gain a +1 bonus to Attack Rolls when throwing, and swap positions with the target if they fail a DC 13 Dexterity Saving Throw.

sun sickness.name: Sun Sickness
sun sickness.description: While in sunlight, has Disadvantage on Ability Checks, Attack Rolls, and Saving Throws.

sunlight hypersensitivity.name: Sunlight Hypersensitivity
sunlight hypersensitivity.description: This creature takes 20 Radiant damage if it starts its turn in sunlight. While sunlit, it has Disadvantage on Attack Rolls and Ability Checks.

sunlight sensitivity.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
sunlight sensitivity.description: While in sunlight, this creature has Disadvantage on Attack Rolls and Perception checks that rely on sight.

sunlight weakness.name: Sunlight Weakness
sunlight weakness.description: While in sunlight, this creature has Disadvantage on Attack Rolls and Saving Throws.

sunwalker's gift.name: Sunwalker's Gift
sunwalker's gift.description: The wearer can see in the dark up to 12 m (40 ft).

superior darkvision.name: Superior Darkvision
superior darkvision.description: Can see in the dark up to 24 m (80 ft).

supreme githyanki parry.name: Supreme Githyanki Parry
supreme githyanki parry.description: Parry unarmed and weapon attacks to reduce their damage by 20.

surge accuracy.name: Surge Accuracy
surge accuracy.description: When you use Action Surge, gain a +1d4 bonus to Attack Rolls for the rest of your turn.

swamp.name: Swamp
swamp.description: You can cast Melf's Acid Arrow and Darkness.

swathed in shadow.name: Swathed in Shadow
swathed in shadow.description: While obscured by shadow, the wearer gains +1 to Saving Throws when attacked. [See: Bugs]

sweet bloodletting.name: Sweet Bloodletting
sweet bloodletting.description: Possibly inflict Bleeding when hitting a creature with this weapon while Hiding or Invisible.

swift strides.name: Swift Strides
swift strides.description: When the wearer Dashes or takes a similar action during combat, they gain Momentum for 3 turns.

sword mastery.name: Sword Mastery
sword mastery.description: You gain Proficiency with shortswords, longswords, and greatswords. In addition, you gain a +1 bonus to melee Attack Rolls.

synchronicity.name: Synchronicity
synchronicity.description: This weapon deals additional damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.

synergetic cantrips.name: Synergetic Cantrips
synergetic cantrips.description: When you deal damage with a Cantrip, you gain Arcane Synergy for 2 turns.

synergetic moments.name: Synergetic Moments
synergetic moments.description: When you inflict a condition, gain Arcane Synergy for 2 turns. [See: Bugs]

tactical discipline.name: Tactical Discipline
tactical discipline.description: You are an expert in mustering self-control to gain an edge over your foes. You gain Advantage on all Ability Checks and Saving Throws during combat.

talkative.name: Talkative
talkative.description: Despite its lack of lips this creature can cast spells that have a verbal component.

tanglevine form.name: Tanglevine Form
tanglevine form.description: Any creature making a melee attack against this mess of writhing vines may become Entangled

tavern brawler.name: Tavern Brawler
tavern brawler.description: When you make an unarmed attack, use an improvised weapon, or throw something, your Strength Modifier is added to the damage and Attack Rolls an additional time.

temperature adjustment.name: Temperature Adjustment
temperature adjustment.description: You have Resistance to Fire and Cold Damage.

tempestuous magic.name: Tempestuous Magic
tempestuous magic.description: After you cast a Level 1 Spell or higher you can Fly as a Bonus Action up to 9 m (30 ft) until the end of your turn without receiving Opportunity Attacks.

tenacity.name: Tenacity
tenacity.description: When you miss a melee attack, you deal Strength Modifier Bludgeoning damage (minimum of 1) anyway.

territorial.name: Territorial
territorial.description: The Bulette will attack other monstrosities before going after smaller prey.

the absolute's mercy.name: The Absolute's Mercy
the absolute's mercy.description: If the wearer bears the Absolute's Brand, they have Advantage on Death Saving Throws.

the blade of frontiers.name: The Blade of Frontiers
the blade of frontiers.description:
The Champion of the Sword Coast, renowned for his heroic deeds and unusual stone eye.
* Grants Wyll proficiency with Rapiers.

the comeback.name: The Comeback
the comeback.description: When the wearer heals a target, it gains an additional 3 temporary hit points.

the pain maiden's blessing.name: The Pain Maiden's Blessing
the pain maiden's blessing.description: After a successful attack with this dagger, the wielder receives a +1d4 bonus to Attack Rolls and Saving Throws until the end of their next turn. [See: Bugs]

the scourge mistress' bane.name: The Scourge Mistress' Bane
the scourge mistress' bane.description: Chance to inflict upon the target a 1d4 penalty to Attack Rolls and Saving Throws. If the attacker still has 50% or more hit points, they take 1d6 Piercing themselves.

the shadow itself.name: The Shadow Itself
the shadow itself.description: Once per turn when you kill an enemy, shroud yourself in primeval darkness to become Invisible for 2 turns.

the tharchiate codex: blessing.name: The Tharchiate Codex: Blessing
the tharchiate codex: blessing.description: Once per Long Rest, gain 20 temporary hit points.

the water caller.name: The Water Caller
the water caller.description: On a hit, inflict Wet and create a 2 m (7 ft) Water surface centred around the target.

thermodynamo.name: Thermodynamo
thermodynamo.description: Whenever you deal damage with this weapon, you gain 2 turns of Heat.

thief of five fates.name: Thief of Five Fates
thief of five fates.description: Once per Long Rest, you can cast Bane using a Warlock Spell Slot.

thieves' cant.name: Thieves' Cant
thieves' cant.description: During your rogue training you learned thieves' cant, a secret mix of dialect, jargon, and code that allows you to hide messages in seemingly normal conversation. Only another creature that knows thieves' cant understands such messages. In addition, you understand a set of secret signs and symbols used to convey short, simple messages, such as whether an area is dangerous or the territory of a thieves' guild, whether loot is nearby, or whether the people in an area are easy marks or will provide a safe house for thieves on the run.

thought shield: psychic reflection.name: Thought Shield: Psychic Reflection
thought shield: psychic reflection.description: Your patron doesn't appreciate attempts to attack your mind. When you take Psychic damage, your attacker takes the same damage.

thought shield: psychic resistance.name: Thought Shield: Psychic Resistance
thought shield: psychic resistance.description: An elder being shields your brain. You gain Resistance to Psychic damage.

throw damage immunity.name: Throw Damage Immunity
throw damage immunity.description: Creature is immune to being damaged by being thrown.

throwing boost.name: Throwing Boost
throwing boost.description: The wearer gains a 1d4 bonus to Throw damage.

throwing: lightning damage.name: Throwing: Lightning Damage
throwing: lightning damage.description: When launched at a target, deal an additional 1d4 Lightning damage.

thunderbolt strike.name: Thunderbolt Strike
thunderbolt strike.description: When you deal Thunder or Lightning damage to a creature that is Large or smaller, you can also push it up to 3 m (10 ft).

thunderous acuity.name: Thunderous Acuity
thunderous acuity.description: Whenever the wearer deals Thunder damage, they gain Arcane Acuity.

thunderous conversion.name: Thunderous Conversion
thunderous conversion.description: When the wearer deals Thunder , Lightning , or Radiant damage, inflict 2 turns of Reverberation upon the target(s).

tides of chaos.name: Tides of Chaos
tides of chaos.description:
Activate to gain Advantage on your next Attack Roll, Ability Check, or Saving Throw.
Increased chance of Wild Magic surge afterwards.

tiger heart.name: Tiger Heart
tiger heart.description: While Raging, you can use Tiger's Bloodlust, and your jump distance increases by 4.5 m (15 ft).

time thoroughly bided.name: Time Thoroughly Bided
time thoroughly bided.description: The wearer gains Arcane Charge whenever they are hit by a melee attack.

tippler's rage.name: Tippler's Rage
tippler's rage.description: While you are Drunk, you have Advantage on Attack Rolls. You also create a blast with each melee hit landed, dealing 1d4 Thunder damage to all creatures and objects in a radius of 3 m (10 ft), excluding yourself.

titan weapon.name: Titan Weapon
titan weapon.description: This weapon deals additional damage equal to your Strength Modifier.

toggle non-lethal attacks.name: Toggle Non-Lethal Attacks
toggle non-lethal attacks.description: Knock someone Unconscious instead of killing them.

torturous edges.name: Torturous Edges
torturous edges.description: Tortured creatures may receive Disadvantage on Constitution Saving Throws.

tough.name: Tough
tough.description: Your Hit Point maximum increases by 2 for every level you have gained.

toxic secretions.name: Toxic Secretions
toxic secretions.description: When an enemy makes a melee attack against the frog, they need to succeed a Constitution Saving Throw, or succumb to Madness for two turns.

training in war and song.name: Training in War and Song
training in war and song.description: You gain proficiency with Light armour and in the Performance skill. You also gain proficiency with Daggers, Longswords, Rapiers, Scimitars, Shortswords, and Sickles.

tranquillity.name: Tranquillity
tranquillity.description: Long Rests surround you with an aura of peace, granting you Sanctuary permanently until you attack.

treader by twilight.name: Treader by Twilight
treader by twilight.description: You gain a +1 bonus to Armour Class while obscured.

troubadour's wonder.name: Troubadour's Wonder
troubadour's wonder.description: Your Armour Class increases by 1. In addition, if you have Bardic Inspiration, you gain 1 more use of it.

true strike riposte.name: True Strike Riposte
true strike riposte.description: When a creature misses you with a melee attack, you may retaliate and gain True Strike.

turn resistance.name: Turn Resistance
turn resistance.description: Turn Resistance gives Advantage on Saving Throws against any effect that turns undead.

twinkling constellations.name: Twinkling Constellations
twinkling constellations.description:
Your Starry Forms are improved. The Archer's damage and the Chalice's healing are each increased by 1d8, and the Dragon gains the ability to hover and to Fly at a movement speed of 6 m (20 ft).
Once per turn, you can switch to a different Starry Form as a free action.

twist of fortune.name: Twist of Fortune
twist of fortune.description: When you roll 2 or less with this weapon's damage die, reroll it and take the new result.

two-weapon fighting.name: Two-Weapon Fighting
two-weapon fighting.description: When you make an offhand attack, you can add your Ability Score Modifier to the damage of the attack.

umbral attack.name: Umbral Attack
umbral attack.description: Your weapon attacks deal an additional 1d4 Necrotic damage.

unarmoured defence.name: Unarmoured Defence
unarmoured defence.description: Your body is as resilient as any armour. While not wearing armour, you add your Constitution Modifier to your Armour Class.

unarmoured movement.name: Unarmoured Movement
unarmoured movement.description: Your movement speed increases by 3 m (10 ft) while you are not wearing armour or using a shield.

uncanny dodge.name: Uncanny Dodge
uncanny dodge.description: Use your lightning-quick reflexes to protect yourself. When an attack hits you, you only take half the usual damage.

undead bane.name: Undead Bane
undead bane.description: Attack rolls with this weapon have Advantage against Undead. [See: Bugs]

undead fortitude.name: Undead Fortitude
undead fortitude.description: If the killing blow wasn't a critical hit and wasn't radiant damage, this undead comes back to life with 1 hit point.

undead thralls: additional undead.name: Undead Thralls: Additional Undead
undead thralls: additional undead.description: When you use Animate Dead, you can raise an additional corpse.

undead thralls: animate dead.name: Undead Thralls: Animate Dead
undead thralls: animate dead.description: You gain the Animate Dead spell, if you didn't have it already

undead thralls: better summons.name: Undead Thralls: Better Summons
undead thralls: better summons.description: Creatures created with Animate Dead have additional hit points equal to your wizard level, and your Proficiency Bonus is added to their damage.

undead ward.name: Undead Ward
undead ward.description: Allied undead within 6 m (20 ft) are Resistant to Bludgeoning , Slashing , and Piercing damage. [See: Bugs]

underdark.name: Underdark
underdark.description: You can cast Web and Misty Step.

underdog's bravery.name: Underdog's Bravery
underdog's bravery.description: The wearer gains Advantage on melee Attack Rolls while surrounded [See: Bugs] by 2 or more foes.

unearthly.name: Unearthly
unearthly.description: This creature is Immune to Falling damage.

unfettered fire.name: Unfettered Fire
unfettered fire.description: The target must succeed a 8 Constitution Saving Throw or Burn.

unflinching protection.name: Unflinching Protection
unflinching protection.description: When a nearby ally is targeted by an attack of any kind, you can use your Reaction to make that attack automatically miss. This effect can only be used once per Long Rest. [See: Bugs]

unhampered resistance.name: Unhampered Resistance
unhampered resistance.description: While the wielder is not wearing armour, they receive a +2 bonus to Saving Throws.

unstable backlash.name: Unstable Backlash
unstable backlash.description: While enraged, when you take damage or fail a Saving Throw, you trigger another Wild Magic effect that replaces the current one.

unstable blood.name: Unstable Blood
unstable blood.description: Your blood is now highly flammable and will explode when in contact with fire.

unwavering.name: Unwavering
unwavering.description: You ignore the effects of Difficult Terrain, and cannot be Paralysed or Restrained.

unwavering bull.name: Unwavering Bull
unwavering bull.description: You cannot be pushed against your will and you have an Advantage on Saving Throws against being Restrained.

urban tracker.name: Urban Tracker
urban tracker.description: An expert at navigating the wild within the city, you gain Sleight of Hand Proficiency.

valiant roll.name: Valiant Roll
valiant roll.description: Add a +1d6 bonus to your next Ability Check.

vampire ascendant.name: Vampire Ascendant
vampire ascendant.description:
Behold, the Vampire Ascendant! Thousands of souls have bought you power, granting you Ascendant Bite and Gaseous Form.
You also have a + 1d10 Necrotic damage bonus to weapon and unarmed attacks.

vampire regeneration.name: Vampire Regeneration
vampire regeneration.description: The vampire regains 10 Hit Points at the start of its turn if it isn't in sunlight, or has taken Radiant damage or damage from Holy Water, in which case this trait doesn't function until the start of its next turn.

vaprak's greed.name: Vaprak's Greed
vaprak's greed.description: Your carrying capacity is increased by a quarter.

veil of the wind.name: Veil of the Wind
veil of the wind.description: You gain a +3 m (10 ft) bonus to movement speed and jump distance. Equipping this weapon gives you Immunity to falling damage.

vengeful.name: Vengeful
vengeful.description: Creature gains an extra reaction. When attacked, the creature can use a reaction to counterattack with Vengeful Strike, dealing weapon damage and 2d4 Psychic damage.

vengeful father.name: Vengeful Father
vengeful father.description: At low health or the death of a family member, this Owlbear becomes Enraged.

vengeful guardian.name: Vengeful Guardian
vengeful guardian.description: Grym always attacks the last creature that hit it if possible.

venomous revenge.name: Venomous Revenge
venomous revenge.description: Whenever the wearer is healed, their weapon becomes coated in magic and deals an additional 1d6 Poison damage.

vicious dragon breath.name: Vicious Dragon Breath
vicious dragon breath.description: Enemies have Disadvantage on Saving Throws against your dragonborn breath weapon.

vital conduit.name: Vital Conduit
vital conduit.description: Grants the wearer 8 temporary hit points when they cast a Spell that requires Concentration.

volatile fungus.name: Volatile Fungus
volatile fungus.description: This Pearlspore Bell will explode when destroyed, dealing damage and leaving a poisonous surface behind.

volo's ersatz eye.name: Volo's Ersatz Eye
volo's ersatz eye.description: The damage wrought upon your ocular nerve during Volo's experiment is undone, allowing you to see Invisible creatures.

wakefulness.name: Wakefulness
wakefulness.description: You can't be unwillingly put to Sleep.

war caster: concentration.name: War Caster: Concentration
war caster: concentration.description: You gain Advantage on Saving Throws to maintain Concentration on a Spell.

war caster: opportunity spell.name: War Caster: Opportunity Spell
war caster: opportunity spell.description: You can also use a Reaction to cast Shocking Grasp at a target moving out of melee range.

war magic.name: War Magic
war magic.description: You have honed your body and magic for war. After you cast a cantrip, you can make a weapon attack using a Bonus Action.

war priest.name: War Priest
war priest.description: When you make an unarmed or weapon attack, you can spend a War Priest Charge to make an additional attack as a Bonus Action.

warding flare.name: Warding Flare
warding flare.description: Shield yourself with divine light. Use your Reaction to impose Disadvantage on an attacker, possibly causing their attack to miss.

warding hands.name: Warding Hands
warding hands.description: When you use your Channel Oath Charge spells, you gain Heroism.

wasteland wanderer: cold.name: Wasteland Wanderer: Cold
wasteland wanderer: cold.description: You have spent endless days surviving desolate tundras. Gain resistance to Cold damage, taking only half damage from it.

wasteland wanderer: fire.name: Wasteland Wanderer: Fire
wasteland wanderer: fire.description: You have spent endless days surviving forbidding deserts. Gain resistance to Fire , taking only half damage from it.

wasteland wanderer: poison.name: Wasteland Wanderer: Poison
wasteland wanderer: poison.description: You have spent endless days surviving fetid swamps. Gain resistance to Poison , taking only half damage from it.

watersparks.name: Watersparks
watersparks.description: If the wearer starts their turn on an Electrified Water surface, they gain 3 Lightning Charges.

watery guidance.name: Watery Guidance
watery guidance.description: This weapon has Advantage against Wet creatures.

watery rejuvenation.name: Watery Rejuvenation
watery rejuvenation.description: If the wearer is standing in a Water surface at the start of their turn, they heal 1d4 Hit Points .

weakened.name: Weakened
weakened.description: Its journey through hell has severely weakened this creature's defences.

weakened constitution.name: Weakened Constitution
weakened constitution.description: Your Constitution has been reduced by 2 by the Zaith'isk. The githyanki device failed to harm your illithid parasite - perhaps consuming more would mend your broken mind.

weakened intelligence.name: Weakened Intelligence
weakened intelligence.description: Your Intelligence has been reduced by 2 by the Zaith'isk. The githyanki device failed to harm your illithid parasite - perhaps consuming more would mend your broken mind.

weakened wisdom.name: Weakened Wisdom
weakened wisdom.description: Your Wisdom has been reduced by 2 by the Zaith'isk. The githyanki device failed to harm your illithid parasite - perhaps consuming more would mend your broken mind.

weapon master.name: Weapon Master
weapon master.description:
Increase your Strength or Dexterity by 1, to a maximum of 20.
Gain Proficiency with four Weapon types of your choice.

weave eater.name: Weave Eater
weave eater.description: Whenever the wearer succeeds a Saving Throw against a spell, they regain 1d6 Hit Points .

web sense.name: Web Sense
web sense.description: Knows the exact location of anything that touches its webs.

web walker.name: Web Walker
web walker.description: Isn't slowed down by Web surfaces, and can't be Enwebbed by them.

well-liked and well-fortified.name: Well-Liked and Well-Fortified
well-liked and well-fortified.description: At the beginning of the wearer's turn, the robe activates, granting them Temporary Hit Points equal to their Charisma Modifier.

whispers of the grave.name: Whispers of the Grave
whispers of the grave.description: You can cast Speak with Dead without expending a Warlock spell slot.

wild magic.name: Wild Magic
wild magic.description:
Unruly magic sparks and fizzes through your veins.
Each time you cast a spell of Level 1 or higher, your magic might surge and trigger a random magical effect.

wild magic surge.name: Wild Magic Surge
wild magic surge.description: A magical energy roils inside of you, ready to erupt. When you enter a Rage, you trigger a random magical effect.

wild strike.name: Wild Strike
wild strike.description: You can make an additional Attack Roll after making an Unarmed Strike while in an animal Wild Shape.

willing whip.name: Willing Whip
willing whip.description: Grants Resistance to Necrotic damage. Deals an additional 1d6 Necrotic DRS damage to nearby targets, including the wielder.

winter's clutches.name: Winter's Clutches
winter's clutches.description: When the wearer deals Cold damage, inflict 2 turns of Encrusted with Frost upon the target(s).

witchbreaker.name: Witchbreaker
witchbreaker.description: You gain Advantage on Attack Rolls against concentrating creatures.

withering barrier.name: Withering Barrier
withering barrier.description: When you deal Necrotic damage, you gain 1d6 temporary hit points. If a melee attack hits you while you still have temporary hit points, you deal 1d6 Piercing to all creatures within 3 m (10 ft).

withering cut.name: Withering Cut
withering cut.description: On a hit with a melee weapon, use a Reaction to deal additional Necrotic damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.

wolf heart.name: Wolf Heart
wolf heart.description: While Raging, you can use Inciting Howl, and your allies have Advantage on melee Attack Rolls against enemies within 2 m (7 ft) of you.

wound closure.name: Wound Closure
wound closure.description: When Downed, automatically stabilise at the start of the turn.

wrath of the storm.name: Wrath of the Storm
wrath of the storm.description: As a Reaction, strike back at an attacking creature, dealing 2d8 Lightning or 2d8 Thunder damage. The target takes half damage on a successful Saving Throw.

writhing dance.name: Writhing Dance
writhing dance.description: When the wearer has 50% hit points or less, they don't provoke Attacks of Opportunity.

xyanyde's fire.name: Xyanyde's Fire
xyanyde's fire.description: Once per short rest, you can encase a target in Faerie Fire for 2 turns if you miss an attack against it.

yeenoghu's gift.name: Yeenoghu's Gift
yeenoghu's gift.description:
Hitting an enemy with this weapon heals the wielder for 1d6 Hit Points - but they can go Mad if they don't continue hitting an enemy each turn.
Healing through this item doesn't trigger other passives that react to healing.

yeenoghu's hunger.name: Yeenoghu's Hunger
yeenoghu's hunger.description: Bloated with the spoils of slaughter, but still hungry - a new gnoll is growing in the hyena's belly.

zephyr connection.name: Zephyr Connection
zephyr connection.description: This weapon will return to your hand when thrown. You cannot be forced to drop the trident. When thrown, the weapon creates an explosion that deals 3d4 Thunder DRS damage in a 6 m (20 ft) blast centered on the target.

a coven of hags.name: A Coven of Hags
a coven of hags.description: You'll never find your Auntie Ethel.

a mother's desperation.name: A Mother's Desperation
a mother's desperation.description: Increase Strength by 2 and gain the ability to perform Multiattacks .

aberrant shape.name: Aberrant Shape
aberrant shape.description: Become an Intellect Devourer that can deal Psychic damage. It has 21 hit points. It can't talk or cast spells.

abjure enemy.name: Abjure Enemy
abjure enemy.description: Frighten an enemy. They have Disadvantage on ability checks and Attack Rolls, and they cannot move.

absolute power.name: Absolute Power
absolute power.description: A surge of Divine energy accompanies your swing. It deals an additional 1d6 Force damage and possibly pushes your target back 5 m / 17 ft.

absolute's talisman: aid.name: Absolute's Talisman: Aid
absolute's talisman: aid.description: Heal yourself and increase your hit point maximum by 5 hit points .

absorb intellect.name: Absorb Intellect
absorb intellect.description: Gobble up a foe's intellect, lowering their Intelligence by 1 per turn and healing your wounds for 5 turns.

acid breath.name: Acid Breath
acid breath.description: Spew forth a line of acid.

acid hallucination.name: Acid Hallucination
acid hallucination.description: Magically inebriated as he is, Thisobald the Brewer is hallucinating acidic imps into existence.

acid splash.name: Acid Splash
acid splash.description: Throw a bubble of acid that damages each creature it hits.

acidic regurgitation.name: Acidic Regurgitation
acidic regurgitation.description: A sip from the Brewer's special booze causes him to vomit acid, covering creatures and creating an acid puddle.

action surge.name: Action Surge
action surge.description: Immediately gain an extra Action to use this turn.

activate call lightning.name: Activate Call Lightning
activate call lightning.description: Call down more lightning to hit all targets within the area of effect.

activate witch bolt.name: Activate Witch Bolt
activate witch bolt.description: Activate the bolt and deal 1d12 Lightning .

adhesive whip.name: Adhesive Whip
adhesive whip.description: Seize a target to drag it towards you and possibly make it fall Prone .

aegis of the absolute.name: Aegis of the Absolute
aegis of the absolute.description: The Netherbrain can make itself Immune to all types of damage it took in a round of combat until the start of its next turn.

aid.name: Aid
aid.description: Bolster your allies with toughness and resolve to heal and increase their Hit Points maximum.

alchemist's fire.name: Alchemist's Fire
alchemist's fire.description: Hurl a flask of liquid fire that explodes on impact.

alternate form: dire wolf.name: Alternate Form: Dire Wolf
alternate form: dire wolf.description: Assume the form of a Dire Wolf.

alternate form: minotaur.name: Alternate Form: Minotaur
alternate form: minotaur.description: Assume the form of a Minotaur.

alternate form: phase spider.name: Alternate Form: Phase Spider
alternate form: phase spider.description: Assume the form of a Phase Spider.

alternate form: shadow mastiff.name: Alternate Form: Shadow Mastiff
alternate form: shadow mastiff.description: Assume the form of a Shadow Mastiff.

an apple a day.name: An Apple a Day
an apple a day.description: Summon Zlorb - a shapeshifting monstrosity that can adopt the aspect of several monsters and beasts.

ancient grudges.name: Ancient Grudges
ancient grudges.description: Touch your amulet to subsume a sliver of the knowledge of the gith. You gain Advantage on Attack Rolls against aberrations.

animal friendship.name: Animal Friendship
animal friendship.description: Convince a beast not to attack you.

animate dead.name: Animate Dead
animate dead.description: Animate a corpse to create an undead servant while not in combat.

animate dead: flying ghoul.name: Animate Dead: Flying Ghoul
animate dead: flying ghoul.description: Create a Flying Ghoul that specialises in melee combat.

animate dead: flying ghoul flock.name: Animate Dead: Flying Ghoul Flock
animate dead: flying ghoul flock.description: Create 3 Flying Ghouls that specialise in melee combat.

animate dead: ghoul.name: Animate Dead: Ghoul
animate dead: ghoul.description: Create a ghoul that specializes in melee combat.

animate dead: ghoul pack.name: Animate Dead: Ghoul Pack
animate dead: ghoul pack.description: Create 3 Ghouls that specialise in melee combat.

animate dead: skeleton.name: Animate Dead: Skeleton
animate dead: skeleton.description: Create a skeleton that specialises in ranged combat.

animate dead: skeleton squad.name: Animate Dead: Skeleton Squad
animate dead: skeleton squad.description: Create 3 Skeletons that specialise in ranged combat.

animate dead: zombie.name: Animate Dead: Zombie
animate dead: zombie.description: Create a zombie that specialises in melee combat.

animate dead: zombie battalion.name: Animate Dead: Zombie Battalion
animate dead: zombie battalion.description: Create 3 zombies that specialise in melee combat.

animating spores.name: Animating Spores
animating spores.description: Release spores at a corpse to animate it as a spore servant under your command.

animus screech.name: Animus Screech
animus screech.description: Screech into your target's soul, wounding them and possibly inflicting Confused

arabella's shadow entangle.name: Arabella's Shadow Entangle
arabella's shadow entangle.description: Cast this upon shadow and undead creatures to Entangle them.

arachnid compulsion.name: Arachnid Compulsion
arachnid compulsion.description: Take control of nearby spiders with a borrowed piece of drow magic.

arachnid jump.name: Arachnid Jump
arachnid jump.description: Jump up, down, and across. Your Strength affects how far you can jump.

arcane ammunition.name: Arcane Ammunition
arcane ammunition.description: Infuse your crossbow bolts with arcane energy. Your ranged weapon attacks deal an additional 1d4 Force damage.

arcane critical.name: Arcane Critical
arcane critical.description: Magically augment your ability to annihilate your foes with powerful attacks. The number you need to roll a Critical Hit while attacking is reduced by 2. This effect can stack.

arcane gate.name: Arcane Gate
arcane gate.description: Create two linked teleportation portals within range. All creatures, including enemies, may travel between the two portals as a free action.

arcane lock.name: Arcane Lock
arcane lock.description: Close a door or container with a magical lock. It can no longer be lockpicked or opened with Knock.

arcane recovery.name: Arcane Recovery
arcane recovery.description: Replenish Spell Slots while out of combat. You cannot restore spell slots above 5th level.

arcane shot: banishing arrow.name: Arcane Shot: Banishing Arrow
arcane shot: banishing arrow.description: Use Abjuration magic to potentially Banish your target to the Feywild.

arcane shot: beguiling arrow.name: Arcane Shot: Beguiling Arrow
arcane shot: beguiling arrow.description: Use Enchantment magic to deal an additional 2d6 Psychic damage. Target must succeed a Saving throw or become Charmed.

arcane shot: bursting arrow.name: Arcane Shot: Bursting Arrow
arcane shot: bursting arrow.description: Use Evocation magic to make your arrow explode on impact and deal an additional 2d6 Force damage to targets within 5 m / 17 ft.

arcane shot: enfeebling arrow.name: Arcane Shot: Enfeebling Arrow
arcane shot: enfeebling arrow.description: Use Necromatic magic to deal an additional 2d6 Necrotic damage. Target must succeed a Saving throw or become Feeble.

arcane shot: grasping arrow.name: Arcane Shot: Grasping Arrow
arcane shot: grasping arrow.description: Deal an additional 2d6 Poison damage. Affected entity's movement speed is reduced by 3 m / 10 ft and it will take 2d6 Slashing damage when it moves.

arcane shot: piercing arrow.name: Arcane Shot: Piercing Arrow
arcane shot: piercing arrow.description: Use Transmutation magic to attack all those within the line of your shot. Each target must succeed a Saving Throw or be dealt an additional 1d6 Piercing damage.

arcane shot: seeking arrow.name: Arcane Shot: Seeking Arrow
arcane shot: seeking arrow.description:
Use Divination magic to make your arrow seek a target. The arrow deals an additional 1d6 Force damage and possibly applies Faerie Fire .
This arrow always hits its target.

arcane shot: shadow arrow.name: Arcane Shot: Shadow Arrow
arcane shot: shadow arrow.description: Use Illusion magic to deal an additional 2d6 Psychic damage. Target must succeed a Saving throw or become Blinded.

archer's eye.name: Archer's Eye
archer's eye.description: As a bonus action, add 1d10 to your next ranged attack roll or damage roll.

ascendant bite.name: Ascendant Bite
ascendant bite.description: Suck the blood from a living creature to heal yourself.

aspect of the elk.name: Aspect of the Elk
aspect of the elk.description: Grant yourself and nearby allies a 1.5 m / 5 ft bonus to Movement Speed

aspect of the wolf.name: Aspect of the Wolf
aspect of the wolf.description: You and nearby allies add your Dexterity modifier as a bonus to Stealth checks.

astral knowledge.name: Astral Knowledge
astral knowledge.description: Gain Proficiency in all Skills of a chosen Ability.

astral knowledge: charisma.name: Astral Knowledge: Charisma
astral knowledge: charisma.description: Gain Proficiency in Deception , Intimidation , Performance , and Persuasion .

astral knowledge: dexterity.name: Astral Knowledge: Dexterity
astral knowledge: dexterity.description: Gain Proficiency in Acrobatics , Sleight of Hand , and Stealth .

astral knowledge: intelligence.name: Astral Knowledge: Intelligence
astral knowledge: intelligence.description: Gain Proficiency in Arcana , History , Investigation , Nature , and Religion .

astral knowledge: wisdom.name: Astral Knowledge: Wisdom
astral knowledge: wisdom.description: Gain Proficiency in Animal Handling , Insight , Medicine , Perception , and Survival

astral rift.name: Astral Rift
astral rift.description: Open a tear in reality itself, allowing allies to enter this plane from the Astral Sea.

astral step.name: Astral Step
astral step.description: Surrounded by silver mist, you teleport to an unoccupied space you can see.

augmented shield of thralls.name: Augmented Shield of Thralls
augmented shield of thralls.description:
Conjure a volatile shield around yourself or an ally, granting the target 25 temporary hit points.
If these temporary hit points are lost due to incoming damage, the shield bursts and Stuns nearby foes.

aura of courage.name: Aura of Courage
aura of courage.description: You and any nearby allies can't be Frightened . The aura disappears if you fall unconscious.

aura of devotion.name: Aura of Devotion
aura of devotion.description: You and any nearby allies can't be Charmed . The aura disappears if you fall unconscious.

aura of hate.name: Aura of Hate
aura of hate.description: You and any nearby fiends and undead gain additional damage to melee weapon attacks equal to your Charisma Modifier.

aura of penance.name: Aura of Penance
aura of penance.description: You and other nearby creatures are Silenced .

aura of protection.name: Aura of Protection
aura of protection.description: You and nearby allies gain a bonus to Saving throws equal to your Charisma modifier. The aura disappears if you fall Unconscious.

aura of terror.name: Aura of Terror
aura of terror.description: Give enemies disadvantage on Attacks and saving throws while in your oppressive presence.

aura of warding.name: Aura of Warding
aura of warding.description: You and any nearby allies take only half the damage from spells.

awaken.name: Awaken
awaken.description: Nearby activity rouses Grym, readying it to crush any who set their eyes on its forge.

awaken crawling claws.name: Awaken Crawling Claws
awaken crawling claws.description: Awaken long-buried Crawling Claws to do the Absolute's bidding. In the same breath, Stun enemies within 12 m / 40 ft.

backbreaker.name: Backbreaker
backbreaker.description: Put extra force behind your strike to possibly knock your enemy Prone.

bad omen.name: Bad Omen
bad omen.description: Hurl one of your feathers at a target to mark it as cursed.

balm of the moonmaiden.name: Balm of the Moonmaiden
balm of the moonmaiden.description: Call upon Isobel to offer a furtive prayer to Selûne, healing up to 6 nearby allies.

bane.name: Bane
bane.description: Up to 3 creatures receive a -1d4 penalty to Attack Rolls and Saving Throws.

bane's wrath.name: Bane's Wrath
bane's wrath.description: Strike with the Black Hand's ire, dealing more damage and possibly Frightening your target.

banishing smite.name: Banishing Smite
banishing smite.description: Possibly Banish your target to another plane of existence.

banishing smite (melee).name: Banishing Smite (Melee)
banishing smite (melee).description: Possibly Banish your target to another plane of existence.

banishing smite (ranged).name: Banishing Smite (Ranged)
banishing smite (ranged).description: Possibly Banish your target to another plane of existence.

banishment.name: Banishment
banishment.description: Temporarily Banish your target to another plane of existence.

barkskin.name: Barkskin
barkskin.description: Touch a willing creature to toughen its skin and increase its Armour Class up to 16.

battle-ready owlbear.name: Battle-Ready Owlbear
battle-ready owlbear.description: Summon your owlbear cub - all grown up and ready to rage - in full armour.

beacon of hope.name: Beacon of Hope
beacon of hope.description: Your allies will regain the maximum Hit Points possible when healed. They also gain Advantage on Wisdom Saving throws and Death Saving Throws.

bear companion.name: Bear Companion
bear companion.description: Summon a black bear that can endure heavy attacks and draw the enemy's attention with its Goading Roar.

bear's endurance.name: Bear's Endurance
bear's endurance.description: Creature gains Advantage on Constitution Checks and gains 7 Temporary Hit Points.

beckoning darkness.name: Beckoning Darkness
beckoning darkness.description: Curse a creature to be haunted by darkness. It takes 2d8 Necrotic damage if it enters or starts its turn in a Lightly or Heavily Obscured area.

beguiling rebuke.name: Beguiling Rebuke
beguiling rebuke.description: Try to Beguile your attacker and its nearby allies.

bend luck: ability check bonus.name: Bend Luck: Ability Check Bonus
bend luck: ability check bonus.description: Grant your target a +1d4 bonus to Ability Checks.

bend luck: ability check penalty.name: Bend Luck: Ability Check Penalty
bend luck: ability check penalty.description: Grant your target a -1d4 penalty to Ability Checks.

benign transposition: teleport.name: Benign Transposition: Teleport
benign transposition: teleport.description: Teleport to a nearby, unoccupied space, or swap places with an ally.

bestow curse.name: Bestow Curse
bestow curse.description:
Curse a creature with your touch. The curse either bestows Disadvantage on Ability checks and Saving throws, Disadvantage on Attack rolls, lets you deal additional damage to the target, or robs it of its Actions.
The effect of the curse is based on the variant selected and lasts for 10 turns.

bestow curse: additional damage.name: Bestow Curse: Additional Damage
bestow curse: additional damage.description: Curse a creature with your touch. Your attacks and spells deal an additional 1d8 Necrotic damage to the target.

bestow curse: attack disadvantage.name: Bestow Curse: Attack Disadvantage
bestow curse: attack disadvantage.description: Curse a creature with your touch. It has Disadvantage on Attack rolls against you.

bestow curse: charisma disadvantage.name: Bestow Curse: Charisma Disadvantage
bestow curse: charisma disadvantage.description: Curse a creature with your touch. It suffers Disadvantage on Charisma Ability checks and Saving throws.

bestow curse: constitution disadvantage.name: Bestow Curse: Constitution Disadvantage
bestow curse: constitution disadvantage.description: Curse a creature with your touch. It suffers Disadvantage on Constitution Ability checks and Saving throws.

bestow curse: dexterity disadvantage.name: Bestow Curse: Dexterity Disadvantage
bestow curse: dexterity disadvantage.description: Curse a creature with your touch. It suffers Disadvantage on Dexterity Ability checks and Saving throws.

bestow curse: dread.name: Bestow Curse: Dread
bestow curse: dread.description: Curse a creature with your touch. It fills with dread, possibly skipping its turn.

bestow curse: intelligence disadvantage.name: Bestow Curse: Intelligence Disadvantage
bestow curse: intelligence disadvantage.description: Curse a creature with your touch. It suffers Disadvantage on Intelligence Ability checks and Saving throws.

bestow curse: strength disadvantage.name: Bestow Curse: Strength Disadvantage
bestow curse: strength disadvantage.description: Curse a creature with your touch. It suffers Disadvantage on Strength Ability checks and Saving throws.

bestow curse: wisdom disadvantage.name: Bestow Curse: Wisdom Disadvantage
bestow curse: wisdom disadvantage.description: Curse a creature with your touch. It suffers Disadvantage on Wisdom Ability checks and Saving throws.

bhaal's edict.name: Bhaal's Edict
bhaal's edict.description: Force a creature to become your murderer - if it does not kill another during its next turn, it will die instantly.

bhaal's power word kill ritual.name: Bhaal's Power Word Kill Ritual
bhaal's power word kill ritual.description: Begin a ritual that will end in you casting Power Word Kill upon the next eligible target you see.

bibberbang spores.name: Bibberbang Spores
bibberbang spores.description: Eject poisonous bibberbang spores and create a cloud of Noxious Fumes .

bind hexed weapon.name: Bind Hexed Weapon
bind hexed weapon.description: Bind to your main hand weapon. Its damage becomes magical, you cannot drop or throw it, and you become Proficient with it if you weren't already. When you attack with this weapon, there is a chance [See Notes] that Hexblade's Curse will be applied to the target.

bind pact weapon.name: Bind Pact Weapon
bind pact weapon.description: Bind to your main hand weapon. Its damage becomes magical, you cannot drop or throw it, and you become Proficient with it if you weren't already.

black fist enforcers.name: Black Fist Enforcers
black fist enforcers.description: Summon two elite assassin mercenaries from the Zhentarim's ranks.

black hand strike.name: Black Hand Strike
black hand strike.description: Attack with the closed fist of Bane.

black hole.name: Black Hole
black hole.description: Create a point of intense gravity that pulls in all nearby enemies and possibly Slows them.

blade barrier.name: Blade Barrier
blade barrier.description: Summons a wall of razor-sharp blades that turns the area into Difficult Terrain and damages anyone foolish enough to come close.

blade of rime.name: Blade of Rime
blade of rime.description: Throw a shard of ice that deals 1d10 Piercing damage. It explodes and deals 2d6 Cold to anyone nearby. It leaves an ice surface.

blade ward.name: Blade Ward
blade ward.description: Take only half the damage from Bludgeoning , Piercing , and Slashing attacks.

bladesong.name: Bladesong
bladesong.description: Invoke the Bladesong. You gain a +2 bonus to Armour Class and your movement speed increases by 3 m (10 ft). You also gain Advantage in Acrobatics and a +2 to Constitution Saving Throws.

bladesong climax.name: Bladesong Climax
bladesong climax.description: Unleash the full damaging and healing effects of your Bladesong at once. Your Bladesong Damage Charges will harm enemies an additional 1d6 Force damage, and your Bladesong Healing Charges will heal you and your allies an additional 1d6 hit points .

blazing retaliation.name: Blazing Retaliation
blazing retaliation.description: Huddle behind your shield to increase your Armour Class by 1 and reap scorching retaliation upon attacks who miss you.

bless.name: Bless
bless.description: Bless up to 3 creatures. They gain a +1d4 bonus to Attack Rolls and Saving Throws.

blessing of the trickster.name: Blessing of the Trickster
blessing of the trickster.description: Grant another creature Advantage on Stealth Checks.

blight.name: Blight
blight.description: Deals 8d8 Necrotic damage to a target. Plants take maximum damage from this spell, and have Disadvantage on the Saving Throw against it.

blinding ambush.name: Blinding Ambush
blinding ambush.description: Try to Blind a Hunted creature before it attacks or casts a spell against you.

blinding shot.name: Blinding Shot
blinding shot.description: Weave the lost magic of the children of Deep Duerra into your shot and possibly Blind your target.

blinding smite.name: Blinding Smite
blinding smite.description: Evoke a heavenly flare and possibly Blind your target

blindness.name: Blindness
blindness.description:
Limit a foe's sight range. It is easier to hit, and the creature will miss more often.
Attack rolls against it have Advantage and the foe attacks with Disadvantage.

blink.name: Blink
blink.description: At the end of your turn, roll a d20. On 11 or higher, you vanish into the Ethereal Plane. While there, you can't be harmed or seen in this world.

blink-of-an-eye bolt.name: Blink-of-an-eye Bolt
blink-of-an-eye bolt.description: Make a ranged attack with your equipped weapon.

blink: teleport.name: Blink: Teleport
blink: teleport.description: Teleport for an instant through the Ethereal Plane and reappear in the physical world up to 6 m / 20 ft from your original position.

blood frenzy.name: Blood Frenzy
blood frenzy.description: The scent of blood sends the sahuagin into a Blood-scent Frenzy!

blood money.name: Blood Money
blood money.description: Strike out greedily, dealing an additional proficiency bonus Piercing damage per 300 gold that the target possesses. The gold will be consumed.

blood sacrifice.name: Blood Sacrifice
blood sacrifice.description: Pain is a path to power. Take 1d4 Slashing damage to receive +1d4 bonus to Attack rolls and Saving throws.

blood skeleton slam.name: Blood Skeleton Slam
blood skeleton slam.description: Slam your foes with bones adrip with blood and inflict Bleeding.

bloodfest.name: Bloodfest
bloodfest.description: Gorge on a corpse of the fallen to regain hit points.

bloodletting.name: Bloodletting
bloodletting.description: Pierce an enemy's flesh and possible make them Bleed. Some undead and constructs can't suffer bleeding.

bloodlust.name: Bloodlust
bloodlust.description: The redcap's bloodthirsty cries fill one of its allies with bloodlust. It heals when it kills a creature and can attack three times.

bloodrender.name: Bloodrender
bloodrender.description: Deal additional damage equal to your proficiency bonus. On a successful hit, you gain Bloodrender which lets you deal more damage at the cost of some hitpoints.

bloody bonesaw.name: Bloody Bonesaw
bloody bonesaw.description: Hack at a target and possibly Slow it.

bludgeon the weak.name: Bludgeon the Weak
bludgeon the weak.description: Make an enemy Vulnerable to Bludgeoning damage.

blur.name: Blur
blur.description: Attackers have Disadvantage on Attack rolls against you.

boar charge.name: Boar Charge
boar charge.description: Charge forward, attacking all enemies in the way and possibly knocking them Prone.

boar companion.name: Boar Companion
boar companion.description: Summon a boar that can sweep through the battlefield and knock enemies off their feet with its Charge.

bolstering magic: boon.name: Bolstering Magic: Boon
bolstering magic: boon.description: You or an ally receive +1d4 bonus to Attack Rolls and Ability Checks for 10 turns.

bolstering magic: level 1 spell slot.name: Bolstering Magic: Level 1 Spell Slot
bolstering magic: level 1 spell slot.description: You or an ally recover a Level 1 Spell Slot.

bolstering magic: level 2 spell slot.name: Bolstering Magic: Level 2 Spell Slot
bolstering magic: level 2 spell slot.description: You or an ally recover a Level 2 Spell Slot.

bolstering magic: level 3 spell slot.name: Bolstering Magic: Level 3 Spell Slot
bolstering magic: level 3 spell slot.description: You or an ally recover a Level 3 Spell Slot.

bolstering overflow.name: Bolstering Overflow
bolstering overflow.description: Thisobald's unstable brew overflows, dealing 6d6 Force to surrounding enemies and empowering his allies with a Bolstering Brew .

bolt of celestial light.name: Bolt of Celestial Light
bolt of celestial light.description: Frighten your target with intimidating arrows. After attacking, ranged weapon attacks made by Gontr Mael deal an additional 1d4 Radiant damage.

bolts of doom.name: Bolts of Doom
bolts of doom.description: Embrace Kereska's lightning bolts to gain resistance to Lightning damage. Your lightning spells deal additional Lightning damage equal to your proficiency bonus.

bone chill.name: Bone Chill
bone chill.description: Prevent the target from healing until your next turn. The target cannot help Downed characters. An undead target receives Disadvantage on Attack Rolls.

bone-shaking thunder.name: Bone-shaking Thunder
bone-shaking thunder.description: Embrace Kereska's thunder to gain resistance to Thunder damage. Your thunder spells deal additional Thunder damage equal to your proficiency bonus.

booming blade.name: Booming Blade
booming blade.description: Strike with your weapon, afflicting your foe with a resonance that hurts them for 1d8 Thunder when they move.

boon of servitude.name: Boon of Servitude
boon of servitude.description: Bask in Ethel's boons. You regain 2d4+Spellcasting Modifier Hit Points each turn, and your Armour Class increased by 2.

boon of the unstoppable.name: Boon of the Unstoppable
boon of the unstoppable.description: Bhaal suffuses you with terrible power, making you Unstoppable.

boot of the giants.name: Boot of the Giants
boot of the giants.description: Try to kick a target away. Your chances depend on your Athletics, and are higher if you're hidden or invisible.

boots of dimension door.name: Boots of Dimension Door
boots of dimension door.description: Cast Dimension Door using your boots.

bout of storms.name: Bout of Storms
bout of storms.description: Ansur calls down tines of lightning that strike all around him in wild erratic patterns.

brace (melee).name: Brace (Melee)
brace (melee).description: Spend 6 m (20 ft) of your movement. For the rest of your turn, roll melee damage twice and use the highest result.

brace (ranged).name: Brace (Ranged)
brace (ranged).description: Spend 6 m (20 ft) of your movement. For the rest of your turn, roll ranged damage twice and use the highest result.

brand the weak.name: Brand the Weak
brand the weak.description: Expose the weak points of an enemy. They become Vulnerable to Bludgeoning , Slashing , or Piercing damage.

branding smite.name: Branding Smite
branding smite.description: Your weapon gleams with astral radiance as you strike and possibly mark your targets with light, preventing it from turning Invisible.

branding smite (melee).name: Branding Smite (Melee)
branding smite (melee).description: Your melee weapon gleams with astral radiance as you strike and possibly mark your targets with light, preventing it from turning Invisible .

branding smite (ranged).name: Branding Smite (Ranged)
branding smite (ranged).description: Your ranged weapon gleams with astral radiance as you strike and possibly mark your targets with light, preventing it from turning Invisible .

break of dawn.name: Break of Dawn
break of dawn.description: Emit a pulse of energy and possibly push all nearby creatures and objects away and knock them Prone .

brutal leap.name: Brutal Leap
brutal leap.description: Leap at a target and possibly knock it Prone.

brutal servitude.name: Brutal Servitude
brutal servitude.description: Unleash a roar that wounds and Slows nearby foes.

bufotoxin.name: Bufotoxin
bufotoxin.description: Touch a creature and possibly impose Disadvantage on its Dexterity Saving Throws.

bull rush.name: Bull Rush
bull rush.description: Charge forward and possibly knock your foes back 3 m (10 ft).

bulwark rebuke.name: Bulwark Rebuke
bulwark rebuke.description: When a foe hits you with a melee attack, deal it 2d4 Force and possibly knock it Prone.

burning age.name: Burning Age
burning age.description: Gain a +1 bonus to Attack rolls and deal an additional 1d4 Fire damage.

burning avarice.name: Burning Avarice
burning avarice.description: Wound targets for 2d8+2 Fire and an additional 1d6 Fire for each stack of 1000 gold pieces they carry.

burning claws.name: Burning Claws
burning claws.description: Lash out with burning claws, dealing 1d4 Fire damage.

burning hands.name: Burning Hands
burning hands.description: Each flammable target is hit with 3d6 Fire damage.

burning overflow.name: Burning Overflow
burning overflow.description: Thisobald's unstable brew overflows, dealing 6d6 Fire to surrounding enemies and empowering his allies with a Fiery Brew .

burrow.name: Burrow
burrow.description: Burrow into the ground and emerge at the target position, possibly knocking nearby creatures Prone .

bursting brood.name: Bursting Brood
bursting brood.description: Launch of clutch of brood to Infest your target.

bursting sinew.name: Bursting Sinew
bursting sinew.description: Explode a corpse, causing it to impale those around it.

buthir's wrath.name: Buthir's Wrath
buthir's wrath.description:
Increase Strength by 4, while Armour Class is reduced by 2.
Tactician difficulty:
Increase Strength by 4, while Armour Class is reduced by 2, and has Resistance to all physical damage.

call consort.name: Call Consort
call consort.description: Summon your mate to protect you in battle.

call lightning.name: Call Lightning
call lightning.description: Lightning strikes all targets within the area of effect for 3d10 Lightning damage. Then for 10 turns, you can call down lightning again without expending a spell slot.

call of the crustacean.name: Call of the Crustacean
call of the crustacean.description: Conjure an Armoured Crab to fight alongside you. The crab can use Razor Claw.

call of the damned.name: Call of the Damned
call of the damned.description: Speak the commands Myrkul whispers in your ear, and pull all nearby creatures 9 m / 30 ft towards you.

calling for help.name: Calling for Help
calling for help.description: The creature calls out in alarm to alert its allies.

calm emotions.name: Calm Emotions
calm emotions.description: Humanoids can't be Charmed, Frightened, or become enraged. [See: Bugs]

careful what you wish for.name: Careful What You Wish For
careful what you wish for.description: Polymorph target into a cheese. It reverts to its original form when reduced to 0 hit points.

carrion's explosive cloudkill.name: Carrion's Explosive Cloudkill
carrion's explosive cloudkill.description: Force an undead corpse to explode, wounding nearby creatures and creating a large cloud that deals heavy Poison damage to those lingering within it.

castigate heartform.name: Castigate Heartform
castigate heartform.description: Curse a creature whose heart you have mapped until they act against their nature.

caustic overflow.name: Caustic Overflow
caustic overflow.description: Thisobald's unstable brew overflows, dealing 6d6 Acid to surrounding enemies and empowering his allies with a Caustic Brew .

ceremorphosis.name: Ceremorphosis
ceremorphosis.description: Submit to the coaxing of the tadpole. Your very morphology will shift. The pain will be incredible. Once its over, you will be a mind flayer. Forever.

chain lightning.name: Chain Lightning
chain lightning.description: Strike an enemy with lightning. Three more bolts will leap from the target, electrifying as many as three other enemies within range.

chalice healing.name: Chalice Healing
chalice healing.description: Heal yourself or another creature within reach.

challenge to duel.name: Challenge to Duel
challenge to duel.description: Challenge an enemy to attack only you, inflicting Bleeding on the target.

champion challenge.name: Champion Challenge
champion challenge.description: Challenge the enemies around you, compelling them to attack only you. Any attacks they might make against other targets have Disadvantage.

channel divinity: cloak of shadows.name: Channel Divinity: Cloak of Shadows
channel divinity: cloak of shadows.description: Wrap yourself in shadows to become Invisible if you are obscured. [See: Bugs]

charge (deep rothé).name: Charge (Deep Rothé)
charge (deep rothé).description: Charge forward, attacking all enemies in the way and possibly knocking them Prone.

charge.name: Charge
charge.description: Charge forward, attacking all enemies in the way, pushing them back 2 m / 7 ft and possibly knocking them Prone .

charger: shove.name: Charger: Shove
charger: shove.description: Charge forward and Shove the first enemy in your way. Your chances depend on your Athletics, and are higher if you're hidden or invisible.

charger: weapon attack.name: Charger: Weapon Attack
charger: weapon attack.description: Deal more damage: charge forward and slam your weapon in the first enemy in your way.

charm animals and plants.name: Charm Animals and Plants
charm animals and plants.description: Channel fey magic to Charm nearby beasts and plants.

charm person.name: Charm Person
charm person.description: Charm a humanoid to prevent it from attacking you. You gain Advantage on Charisma Checks in dialogue.

cheesy smell.name: Cheesy Smell
cheesy smell.description: Create a cloud of gas so pungent it prevents creatures within it from taking actions.

chill of the mountain.name: Chill of the Mountain
chill of the mountain.description: Call forth the cold mountain winds and reduce the target's movement speed by 3 m / 10 ft.

chilling overflow.name: Chilling Overflow
chilling overflow.description: Thisobald's unstable brew overflows, dealing 6d6 Cold to surrounding enemies and empowering his allies with a Cold Brew .

choking wail.name: Choking Wail
choking wail.description: Unleash a wail that wounds and Paralyses nearby foes.

chromatic orb.name: Chromatic Orb
chromatic orb.description:
Hurl a sphere of energy.
It deals 3d8 Thunder damage, or 2d8 Acid , Cold , Fire , Lightning or Poison damage and creates a surface.

chromatic orb: acid.name: Chromatic Orb: Acid
chromatic orb: acid.description: Hurl a sphere of energy that deals 2d8 Acid damage and creates an Acid surface.

chromatic orb: cold.name: Chromatic Orb: Cold
chromatic orb: cold.description: Hurl a sphere of energy that deals 2d8 Cold damage and creates an Ice surface.

chromatic orb: fire.name: Chromatic Orb: Fire
chromatic orb: fire.description: Hurl a sphere of energy that deals 2d8 Fire damage and creates a Fire surface.

chromatic orb: lightning.name: Chromatic Orb: Lightning
chromatic orb: lightning.description: Hurl a sphere of energy that deals 2d8 Lightning damage and creates an Electrified Water surface.

chromatic orb: poison.name: Chromatic Orb: Poison
chromatic orb: poison.description: Hurl poisonous energy that damages the target and creates a bubbling surface to Poison creatures.

chromatic orb: thunder.name: Chromatic Orb: Thunder
chromatic orb: thunder.description: Hurl a sphere of energy that deals 3d8 Thunder damage.

cinderous swipe.name: Cinderous Swipe
cinderous swipe.description: Create a blooming cone of fire as you swipe at a foe.

circle of death.name: Circle of Death
circle of death.description: Sculpt a massive sphere of entropic energy around a creature. Devastate the target and all surrounding creatures.

circuitry interface.name: Circuitry Interface
circuitry interface.description: You are considered a construct. Your weapon Attack rolls have Advantage, and you have resistance to Lightning damage.

cleave.name: Cleave
cleave.description: Swing your weapon in a large arc to attack up to 3 enemies at once. They each take half the damage your weapon usually deals.

clench of the north wind.name: Clench of the North Wind
clench of the north wind.description: Hold a humanoid enemy still. They can't move, act or react. Attacks from within 3 m / 10 ft are always critical hits.

click heels.name: Click Heels
click heels.description: Click the heels of your boots to gain speed and freedom of movement.

cloak of shadows.name: Cloak of Shadows
cloak of shadows.description: Wrap yourself in shadows to become Invisible if you are obscured.

cloaking mist.name: Cloaking Mist
cloaking mist.description: Turn Invisible after casting Misty Step.

cloud of daggers.name: Cloud of Daggers
cloud of daggers.description: Conjure a cloud of spinning daggers that attack anyone inside.

cloud of jellyfish: attack.name: Cloud of Jellyfish: Attack
cloud of jellyfish: attack.description: Use your swarm to attack the same target and deal 1d6 Lightning damage.

cloud of jellyfish: mighty shocking stin.name: Cloud of Jellyfish: Mighty Shocking Sting
cloud of jellyfish: mighty shocking stin.description: Use your swarm to Shock and Disarm your target.

cloud of jellyfish: mighty teleport.name: Cloud of Jellyfish: Mighty Teleport
cloud of jellyfish: mighty teleport.description: Use your swarm to carry you to a new location within 5 m (17 ft) and gain a temporary +2 bonus to your Armour Class.

cloud of jellyfish: shocking sting.name: Cloud of Jellyfish: Shocking Sting
cloud of jellyfish: shocking sting.description: Use your swarm Shock your target.

cloud of jellyfish: teleport.name: Cloud of Jellyfish: Teleport
cloud of jellyfish: teleport.description: Use your swarm to carry you to a new location.

cloudkill.name: Cloudkill
cloudkill.description: Craft a large cloud that inflicts 5d8 Poison damage per turn. You can reposition the cloud every turn.

cocoon.name: Cocoon
cocoon.description: Trap a creature in your web to Cocoon it.

cold hallucination.name: Cold Hallucination
cold hallucination.description: Magically inebriated as he is, Thisobald the Brewer is hallucinating icy imps into existence.

colossal onslaught.name: Colossal Onslaught
colossal onslaught.description: Channel your mettlesome strength and strike all creatures in a line, dealing bonus Slashing damage equal to your proficiency bonus.

colour spray.name: Colour Spray
colour spray.description: Blind creatures up to a combined 33 Hit Points .

combat inspiration.name: Combat Inspiration
combat inspiration.description: Inspire an ally to add a +1d6 bonus to their next Attack Roll, Ability Check, Saving Throw, weapon damage, or Armour Class.

combat wild shape.name: Combat Wild Shape
combat wild shape.description:
As a bonus action, you can assume the form of a beast. You can transform twice per Short Rest.
This ability otherwise acts as Wild Shape.

combustible coins.name: Combustible Coins
combustible coins.description: Enchant a pile of coins to explode.

command.name: Command
command.description: Command a creature to flee, move closer, freeze, drop to the ground or drop its weapon. The target must succeed on a Wisdom Saving Throw in order to resist the effects.

command: approach.name: Command: Approach
command: approach.description: Command a creature to move toward you on its turn and do nothing else.

command: drop.name: Command: Drop
command: drop.description: Command a creature to drop its weapon.

command: flee.name: Command: Flee
command: flee.description: Command a creature to flee from you on its turn and do nothing else.

command: grovel.name: Command: Grovel
command: grovel.description: Command a creature to fall Prone immediately and do nothing else.

command: halt.name: Command: Halt
command: halt.description: Command a creature to halt, preventing it from moving or taking any type of action.

commander's strike.name: Commander's Strike
commander's strike.description: Direct an ally to strike a foe. The ally uses a reaction on their next turn to make a weapon attack.

commander's strike (attack).name: Commander's Strike (Attack)
commander's strike (attack).description: Directed by your ally. Use your Reaction to make a weapon attack with additional Superiority Die damage.

compelled duel.name: Compelled Duel
compelled duel.description: Force an enemy to attack only you, giving it Disadvantage against other targets.

concentrated blast.name: Concentrated Blast
concentrated blast.description: You must be concentrating on another spell to cast this. If the target was concentrating, you heal as much as the damage that was dealt to it.

concussive burst.name: Concussive Burst
concussive burst.description: A thunderous blast that ripples over your foes and pushes them back.

concussive smash.name: Concussive Smash
concussive smash.description: Hit an enemy with all your might to deal damage and possibly Daze them.

cone of cold.name: Cone of Cold
cone of cold.description: Make a flurry of frost, crisp air, and condensed snow crystals erupt from your hands.

confusion.name: Confusion
confusion.description: Befuddle a group of creatures, causing them to attack at random, wander around aimlessly, and occasionally skip turns in the stupor.

confusion ray.name: Confusion Ray
confusion ray.description: Shoot an eye ray that Befuddles its target.

conjure barrage.name: Conjure Barrage
conjure barrage.description: Channel your weapon's essence into a destructive, widespread volley.

conjure barrage: melee weapon.name: Conjure Barrage: Melee Weapon
conjure barrage: melee weapon.description: Channel your weapon's essence into a destructive, widespread volley.

conjure barrage: ranged weapon.name: Conjure Barrage: Ranged Weapon
conjure barrage: ranged weapon.description: Channel your weapon's essence into a destructive, widespread volley.

conjure elemental.name: Conjure Elemental
conjure elemental.description: Bend the barrier between the Planes until they disgorge an elemental ally to follow and fight for you.

conjure elemental: air elemental.name: Conjure Elemental: Air Elemental
conjure elemental: air elemental.description: The air elemental can use Primordial Gales , Gushing Air , and can Shock your foes.

conjure elemental: air myrmidon.name: Conjure Elemental: Air Myrmidon
conjure elemental: air myrmidon.description: The myrmidon can cast Invisibility , Electrified Flail , and Raging Vortex .

conjure elemental: earth elemental.name: Conjure Elemental: Earth Elemental
conjure elemental: earth elemental.description: The earth elemental can use Seismic Strike , Soil-Clogged Slam , and can create sludgy mud surfaces while walloping your foes.

conjure elemental: earth myrmidon.name: Conjure Elemental: Earth Myrmidon
conjure elemental: earth myrmidon.description: The myrmidon can cast Muck to Metal , Sludgy Sling , and Burrow (Earth Myrmidon) .

conjure elemental: fire elemental.name: Conjure Elemental: Fire Elemental
conjure elemental: fire elemental.description: The fire elemental can use Smouldering Touch , Erupting Cinder , and can make your foes Burn .

conjure elemental: fire myrmidon.name: Conjure Elemental: Fire Myrmidon
conjure elemental: fire myrmidon.description: The myrmidon can cast Scorching Strike , Myrmidon's Immolation , and Cinderous Swipe .

conjure elemental: water elemental.name: Conjure Elemental: Water Elemental
conjure elemental: water elemental.description: The water elemental can use Winter's Breath , Slam , and can mete out cold punishment upon foes with its fists.

conjure elemental: water myrmidon.name: Conjure Elemental: Water Myrmidon
conjure elemental: water myrmidon.description: The myrmidon can cast Hiemal Strike , Healing Vapours , and Explosive Icicle .

conjure minor elemental.name: Conjure Minor Elemental
conjure minor elemental.description: Conjure a minor elemental to fight alongside you.

conjure minor elemental: azer.name: Conjure Minor Elemental: Azer
conjure minor elemental: azer.description: Conjure an azer from the Plane of Fire. It deals both Bludgeoning and Fire damage with its warhammer, and can Overheat . It carries the Azer Warhammer.

conjure minor elemental: ice mephits.name: Conjure Minor Elemental: Ice Mephits
conjure minor elemental: ice mephits.description: Conjure two ice mephits from the Elemental Chaos. They can Hurl and Exhale ice, and Explode when they die.

conjure minor elemental: mud mephits.name: Conjure Minor Elemental: Mud Mephits
conjure minor elemental: mud mephits.description: Conjure two mud mephits from the Elemental Chaos. They can cast Mud Breath and Explode when they die.

conjure murder of crows.name: Conjure Murder of Crows
conjure murder of crows.description: Conjure a murder of crows to fight alongside you.

conjure shadow lantern wraith.name: Conjure Shadow Lantern Wraith
conjure shadow lantern wraith.description: Pull an undead creature from the depths of the Shadow Lantern's depraved magic to join your side in combat.

conjure us.name: Conjure Us
conjure us.description: Conjure Us to fight by your side.

conjure woodland being.name: Conjure Woodland Being
conjure woodland being.description: Conjure a dryad to fight alongside you. She can use Nature's Step , Entangle enemies, and Summon a wood woad.

conquering presence.name: Conquering Presence
conquering presence.description: Exude a terrifying presence that Frightens nearby enemies.

constrict.name: Constrict
constrict.description: Wrap your cursed tendrils around a creature to constrict it.

consume souls.name: Consume Souls
consume souls.description:
Absorb a soul from each Soul Pillar still standing to spend on powerful spells.
Your Punish Divinity is restored every time you absorb souls in this way.

contagion.name: Contagion
contagion.description:
Poison a target and possibly afflict them with a disease of your choice.
Once infected, the target will roll a Constitution Saving throw each turn. If it accumulates 3 successes, it recovers. If it accumulates 3 failures, it contracts the disease chosen by the spellcaster.

contagion: blinding sickness.name: Contagion: Blinding Sickness
contagion: blinding sickness.description: The target receives Disadvantage on Wisdom Ability Checks and Saving Throws, and is Blinded .

contagion: filth fever.name: Contagion: Filth Fever
contagion: filth fever.description: The target receives Disadvantage on Strength Ability Checks, Saving Throws, and Attack Rolls that use Strength.

contagion: flesh rot.name: Contagion: Flesh Rot
contagion: flesh rot.description: The target receives Disadvantage on Charisma Ability Checks, and is afflicted with Vulnerability to all damage.

contagion: mindfire.name: Contagion: Mindfire
contagion: mindfire.description: The target receives Disadvantage on Intelligence Ability Checks and Saving Throws, and is Befuddled .

contagion: seizure.name: Contagion: Seizure
contagion: seizure.description: The target receives Disadvantage on Dexterity Ability Checks, Saving Throws, and Attack Rolls.

contagion: slimy doom.name: Contagion: Slimy Doom
contagion: slimy doom.description: The target receives Disadvantage on Constitution Ability Checks and Saving Throws. Whenever they are hit, they get Stunned .

control undead.name: Control Undead
control undead.description: Use the power of your Oath to gain control over an undead creature. The undead will follow you around and attack your enemies.

corpulent rage.name: Corpulent Rage
corpulent rage.description:
As your health diminishes, let out a bone-quaking roar that pushes back anyone near you, and go Berserk.
Tactician difficulty:
In addition, you gain the effects of Reckless Attack.

corrosive age.name: Corrosive Age
corrosive age.description: Gain a +1 bonus to Attack rolls and deal an additional 1d4 Acid damage.

corrosive spit.name: Corrosive Spit
corrosive spit.description: Spray a target with corrosive fluids that slowly melt away its Armour Class.

corrosive strike.name: Corrosive Strike
corrosive strike.description: Deal additional Acid damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus. On a hit, create a pool of acid around the target which reduces Armour Class by 2.

cosmic omen: ability check.name: Cosmic Omen: Ability Check
cosmic omen: ability check.description: Give your allies a +1d6 bonus to Ability Checks.

countercharm.name: Countercharm
countercharm.description: You and any allies within 9 m / 30 ft have Advantage on Saving throws against being Charmed or Frightened .

counterspell.name: Counterspell
counterspell.description: Try to stop a spell being cast.

create lava.name: Create Lava
create lava.description: Draw on the Plane of Fire to melt the ground and create a small Lava surface under you.

create or destroy water.name: Create or Destroy Water
create or destroy water.description: Choose to call forth rain or destroy a water-based surface.

create sorcery points.name: Create Sorcery Points
create sorcery points.description: Spend Spell Slots to gain Sorcery Points. The level of spell slot spent creates the equivalent number of Sorcery Points.

create spell slot.name: Create Spell Slot
create spell slot.description: Spend Sorcery Points to unlock a Spell Slot.

create undead.name: Create Undead
create undead.description: Create a corpse as a heinous mummy that fights by your side.

create water.name: Create Water
create water.description: Call forth rain. It extinguishes exposed flames and forms a Water surface.

crown of madness.name: Crown of Madness
crown of madness.description:
Instil madness in a humanoid enemy, making them attack the creature closest to them (other than you), even if it's allied.
At the end of each turn, the affected creature can make a Wisdom Saving Throw to end this condition.

crowning strike.name: Crowning Strike
crowning strike.description: Unleash the wails of the dead that fell to your blade, and possibly instil Crown of Madness in the target.

crusader's mantle.name: Crusader's Mantle
crusader's mantle.description: Radiate a holy power that emboldens you and nearby allies. Their weapon attacks deal an additional 1d4 Radiant damage.

crushing flight.name: Crushing Flight
