crushing flight.description: Leap at a target, possibly knocking it Prone.

cry for help.name: Cry for Help
cry for help.description: The creature cries out in alarm to alert its allies.

cunning action: dash.name: Cunning Action: Dash
cunning action: dash.description: Cover more distance this turn: double your movement speed.

cunning action: disengage.name: Cunning Action: Disengage
cunning action: disengage.description: Retreat safely. Moving won't provoke Opportunity Attacks.

cunning action: hide.name: Cunning Action: Hide
cunning action: hide.description: Hide from enemies by succeeding at Stealth checks. Stick to the dark and avoid enemy sightlines. Attacking or casting a spell will reveal your location.

cure wounds.name: Cure Wounds
cure wounds.description: Heal a creature you can touch.

curriculum of strategy: artistry of war.name: Curriculum of Strategy: Artistry of War
curriculum of strategy: artistry of war.description: Summon the apparitions of 6 master strategists. Each apparition strikes a target of your choosing, dealing 2d6 + 6 Force damage (for a total of 12d6 + 36 Force ).

curse of regret.name: Curse of Regret
curse of regret.description: Curse a creature with regret. It takes 4~10 Psychic damage every turn, and becomes vulnerable to Psychic damage.

curse of terror.name: Curse of Terror
curse of terror.description: Strike terror into a creature's heart and Frighten it.

daddy's lecture.name: Daddy's Lecture
daddy's lecture.description: Daddy infuses his hand with putrefying energy to discipline the naughty children.

damsel in distress.name: Damsel in Distress
damsel in distress.description: Better choose the right one, dearie.

danse macabre.name: Danse Macabre
danse macabre.description: Create 4 ghouls that fight alongside you.

dark celebration.name: Dark Celebration
dark celebration.description: Wound nearby foes and heal nearby skeletons.

dark currents.name: Dark Currents
dark currents.description: Dissolve into the ground and emerge from the shadows at a different location.

dark deliverance.name: Dark Deliverance
dark deliverance.description: Summon the Nightbringer's unholy wrath as roiling and acrid clouds of darkness that spare only the faithful of Shar.

darkness.name: Darkness
darkness.description: Create a cloud of magical darkness that Heavily Obscures and inflicts Blind to creatures within. Creatures cannot make ranged attacks into or out of it.

darkness cloak.name: Darkness Cloak
darkness cloak.description: Create a cloud of magical darkness and immediately attempt to Hide .

dash.name: Dash
dash.description: Cover more distance this turn: double your Movement Speed.

dawnburst strike.name: Dawnburst Strike
dawnburst strike.description: Deal additional Radiant damage equal to your proficiency bonus. On a hit, light erupts around you in a 3 m (10 ft) area. Enemies in the light must succeed a Constitution Saving Throw or be Blinded.

daylight.name: Daylight
daylight.description: Enchant an item to shine like the sun or summon a sphere of sunlight that dispels all darkness around it.

daylight: enchant item.name: Daylight: Enchant Item
daylight: enchant item.description: Enchant an item or weapon to shine with the light of the sun and dispel all darkness around it. Target must have a weapon in its main hand.

daylight: sphere.name: Daylight: Sphere
daylight: sphere.description: Summon a sphere of sunlight that dispels all darkness around it. The sphere cannot be moved.

dazzling breath.name: Dazzling Breath
dazzling breath.description: Spew forth a dazzling cone of stars.

dazzling ray.name: Dazzling Ray
dazzling ray.description: Unleash a beam of brilliant light that Blinds all creatures in its path.

deadlier than arsenic.name: Deadlier than Arsenic
deadlier than arsenic.description: Embrace Kereska's poison to gain resistance to Poison damage. Your poison spells deal additional Poison damage equal to your proficiency bonus.

deadly leap.name: Deadly Leap
deadly leap.description: Leap to your targets, pushing them back 4 m / 13 ft, and possibly making them fall Prone

deadly orders.name: Deadly Orders
deadly orders.description: Command your troops to prioritise attacking a specific foe.

death burst.name: Death Burst
death burst.description: Explode in a burst of ice that damages all nearby creatures.

death shriek.name: Death Shriek
death shriek.description: Utter a hideous dirge that wounds nearby foes.

death ward.name: Death Ward
death ward.description: Protect a creature from death. The next time damage would reduce it to 0 Hit Points, it remains conscious with 1 Hit Point left.

deathbringer assault.name: Deathbringer Assault
deathbringer assault.description:
Unleash the Dread Lord's fury upon a target.
A Bhaalist worships murder - a Deathbringer embodies it.

deathbringer's legacy.name: Deathbringer's Legacy
deathbringer's legacy.description: Sarevok can use Deathbringer Assault until the end of his next turn.

debilitating infusion.name: Debilitating Infusion
debilitating infusion.description: When you deal a weapon damage to creature they have a 1d4 penalty to Saving throws against the next spell you cast.

debilitating shot.name: Debilitating Shot
debilitating shot.description: Fire a hefty ballista bolt that may Pin Down the target.

defensive flourish (melee).name: Defensive Flourish (Melee)
defensive flourish (melee).description: Attack defensively, increasing your Armour Class by 4 if you hit.

defensive flourish (ranged).name: Defensive Flourish (Ranged)
defensive flourish (ranged).description: Attack defensively, increasing your Armour Class by 4 if you hit.

defensive protocol: bulwark.name: Defensive Protocol: Bulwark
defensive protocol: bulwark.description: Hunker down into an Unyielding state and Repair yourself. While hunkered, you can launch Hellfire Missiles and Repel combatants.

deflect missiles: redirect.name: Deflect Missiles: Redirect
deflect missiles: redirect.description: Use your reflexes to catch a projectile from a ranged weapon attack and shoot it back at your attacker.

destroy water.name: Destroy Water
destroy water.description: Cause water-based surfaces (such as Water , Steam Cloud , Ice , Blood and Simple Toxin ) to vanish.

destructive wave.name: Destructive Wave
destructive wave.description: Create a shockwave of either divine or malevolent thunder that damages nearby enemies and possibly knocks them Prone.

destructive wave: necrotic.name: Destructive Wave: Necrotic
destructive wave: necrotic.description: Emit a shockwave of malevolent thunder that damages nearby enemies and possibly knocks them Prone .

destructive wave: radiant.name: Destructive Wave: Radiant
destructive wave: radiant.description: Emit a shockwave of divine thunder that damages nearby enemies and possibly knocks them Prone.

detect thoughts.name: Detect Thoughts
detect thoughts.description: Focus your mind to read the thoughts of certain creatures while talking to them.

dethrone.name: Dethrone
dethrone.description: Shred a foe's very essence by pulling on strands of the Weave.

detonate.name: Detonate
detonate.description: Blow up the powder keg on your back, damaging all nearby creatures and objects.

devour.name: Devour
devour.description: Bite a knocked down, prone, or sleeping target, and deal 3d10 + Strength Modifier Slashing damage. Heal that many hit points.

devour intellect.name: Devour Intellect
devour intellect.description: Consume a creature's mind. If its Intelligence is below 4, it takes damage and is Stunned . Otherwise, its Intelligence is reduced by 3.

devour soul.name: Devour Soul
devour soul.description: Consume the soul of your warlock's enemy while healing the warlock for half the damage.

diabolic chains.name: Diabolic Chains
diabolic chains.description: Spend 2 souls you have consumed to lash out with 3 magmatic chains of Hellfire and possibly push the targets back 5 m / 17 ft.

dig.name: Dig
dig.description: Search heaps of earth for untold wonders.

digestive sap.name: Digestive Sap
digestive sap.description: Regurgitate your Digestive Juices over nearby enemies, priming them to be Devoured if they are also Restrained .

dimension door.name: Dimension Door
dimension door.description: Teleport yourself and up to one adjacent ally to a place you can see. The ally cannot be larger than Medium.

dip.name: Dip
dip.description: Dip a weapon into a surface to alter the surface or enhance the weapon. If you are dual-wielding, you dip both weapons.

dire raven companion.name: Dire Raven Companion
dire raven companion.description: Summon a dire raven that can fly and Blind its enemies.

dirty trick: flick o' the wrist.name: Dirty Trick: Flick o' the Wrist
dirty trick: flick o' the wrist.description: Flick your weapon at a target and possibly Disarm them.

dirty trick: sand toss.name: Dirty Trick: Sand Toss
dirty trick: sand toss.description: Toss a handful of sand at your enemy and possibly Blind them.

dirty trick: vicious mockery.name: Dirty Trick: Vicious Mockery
dirty trick: vicious mockery.description: Insult a creature: it has Disadvantage on its next Attack Roll.

disarming attack (melee).name: Disarming Attack (Melee)
disarming attack (melee).description: Focus your attack on your foe's hands and possibly force them to drop the weapons they are holding.

disarming attack (ranged).name: Disarming Attack (Ranged)
disarming attack (ranged).description: Focus your shot on your foe's hands and possibly force them to drop the weapons they are holding.

disarming strike.name: Disarming Strike
disarming strike.description: Focus your attack on your foe's hands and possibly force them to drop the weapons they are holding.

disconcerting visage.name: Disconcerting Visage
disconcerting visage.description: Accentuate your unnatural form, Confusing nearby creatures.

disengage.name: Disengage
disengage.description: Focus on retreating safely. Moving won't provoke Opportunity Attacks.

disengage: bonus action.name: Disengage: Bonus Action
disengage: bonus action.description: Retreat safely. Moving won't provoke Opportunity Attacks.

disguise self.name: Disguise Self
disguise self.description: Magically change all aspects of your appearance.

disguise self: femme dragonborn.name: Disguise Self: Femme Dragonborn
disguise self: femme dragonborn.description: Disguise yourself as a dragonborn with a feminine body type.

disguise self: femme drow.name: Disguise Self: Femme Drow
disguise self: femme drow.description: Disguise yourself as a drow with a feminine body type.

disguise self: femme dwarf.description: Disguise yourself as a dwarf with a feminine body type.

disguise self: femme elf.description: Disguise yourself as an elf with a feminine body type.

disguise self: femme githyanki.description: Disguise yourself as a githyanki with a feminine body type.

disguise self: femme gnome.description: Disguise yourself as a gnome with a feminine body type.

disguise self: femme half-elf.description: Disguise yourself as a half-elf with a feminine body type.

disguise self: femme half-orc.description: Disguise yourself as a half-orc with a feminine body type.

disguise self: femme halfling.description: Disguise yourself as a halfling with a feminine body type.

disguise self: femme human.description: Disguise yourself as a human with a feminine body type.

disguise self: femme strong drow.name: Disguise Self: Femme Strong Drow
disguise self: femme strong drow.description: Disguise yourself as a drow with a strong feminine body type.

disguise self: femme strong elf.name: Disguise Self: Femme Strong Elf
disguise self: femme strong elf.description: Disguise yourself as an elf with a strong feminine body type.

disguise self: femme strong half-elf.name: Disguise Self: Femme Strong Half-Elf
disguise self: femme strong half-elf.description: Disguise yourself as a half-elf with a strong feminine body type.

disguise self: femme strong human.description: Disguise yourself as a human with a strong feminine body type.

disguise self: femme strong tiefling.name: Disguise Self: Femme Strong Tiefling
disguise self: femme strong tiefling.description: Disguise yourself as a tiefling with a strong feminine body type.

disguise self: femme tiefling.description: Disguise yourself as a tiefling with a feminine body type.

disguise self: masc dragonborn.description: Disguise yourself as a dragonborn with a masculine body type.

disguise self: masc drow.name: Disguise Self: Masc Drow
disguise self: masc drow.description: Disguise yourself as a drow with a masculine body type.

disguise self: masc dwarf.name: Disguise Self: Masc Dwarf
disguise self: masc dwarf.description: Disguise yourself as a dwarf with a masculine body type.

disguise self: masc elf.name: Disguise Self: Masc Elf
disguise self: masc elf.description: Disguise yourself as an elf with a masculine body type.

disguise self: masc githyanki.name: Disguise Self: Masc Githyanki
disguise self: masc githyanki.description: Disguise yourself as a githyanki with a masculine body type.

disguise self: masc gnome.description: Disguise yourself as a gnome with a masculine body type.

disguise self: masc half-elf.description: Disguise yourself as a half-elf with a masculine body type.

disguise self: masc half-orc.description: Disguise yourself as a half-orc with a masculine body type.

disguise self: masc halfling.description: Disguise yourself as a halfling with a masculine body type.

disguise self: masc human.description: Disguise yourself as a human with a masculine body type.

disguise self: masc strong drow.name: Disguise Self: Masc Strong Drow
disguise self: masc strong drow.description: Disguise yourself as a drow with a strong masculine body type.

disguise self: masc strong elf.name: Disguise Self: Masc Strong Elf
disguise self: masc strong elf.description: Disguise yourself as an elf with a strong masculine body type.

disguise self: masc strong half-elf.description: Disguise yourself as a half-elf with a strong masculine body type.

disguise self: masc strong human.description: Disguise yourself as a human with a strong masculine body type.

disguise self: masc strong tiefling.description: Disguise yourself as a tiefling with a strong masculine body type.

disguise self: masc tiefling.name: Disguise Self: Masc Tiefling
disguise self: masc tiefling.description: Disguise yourself as a tiefling with a masculine body type.

disintegrate.name: Disintegrate
disintegrate.description: If the target fails a Dexterity Saving Throw, and the spell reduces it to 0 hit points, it disintegrates into a crumbly ash.

dismiss arcane lock.name: Dismiss Arcane Lock
dismiss arcane lock.description: Remove your Arcane Lock from a door or container.

dismiss blink.name: Dismiss Blink
dismiss blink.description: Dismiss the effects of Blink early.

dismiss displacer beast shape.name: Dismiss Displacer Beast Shape
dismiss displacer beast shape.description: Dismiss your displacer beast shape and change back to your original form.

dismiss gaseous form.name: Dismiss Gaseous Form
dismiss gaseous form.description: Dismiss your gaseous shape and turn back into your original form.

dismiss shapechanger.name: Dismiss Shapechanger
dismiss shapechanger.description: Change back to your original form.

dismiss vampire bat form.name: Dismiss Vampire Bat Form
dismiss vampire bat form.description: Dismiss your transformation and change back to your original form.

dismiss wild shape.name: Dismiss Wild Shape
dismiss wild shape.description: Dismiss your Wild Shape and change back to your original form.

dismiss: slayer.name: Dismiss: Slayer
dismiss: slayer.description: Dismiss your Slayer form and change back to your original form.

dispel disguise.name: Dispel Disguise
dispel disguise.description: Dispel your disguise and revert to your original form.

dispel evil and good.name: Dispel Evil And Good
dispel evil and good.description: Aberrations [See: Bugs] , Celestials, Elementals, Fey, Fiends, and Undead have Disadvantage on Attack Rolls against you.

dispel evil and good: break enchantment.name: Dispel Evil And Good: Break Enchantment
dispel evil and good: break enchantment.description: Touch a creature that is Charmed , Frightened [See: Bugs] , or Possessed by an otherworldly entity to free its mind.

dispel identity.name: Dispel Identity
dispel identity.description: Dispel your disguise and revert to your original form.

dispel magic.name: Dispel Magic
dispel magic.description: Remove the magic cast upon a character or object.

displacer beast shape.name: Displacer Beast Shape
displacer beast shape.description: Transform into a displacer beast that can Displace itself and enemies, and has 85 hit points.

disrobing blinkstep.name: Disrobing Blinkstep
disrobing blinkstep.description: You teleport to an unoccupied space you can see. However, your clothes do not teleport with you.

dissonant whispers.name: Dissonant Whispers
dissonant whispers.description: Frighten a creature: they'll have Disadvantage on Ability checks and Attack rolls and they cannot move.

distracting strike (melee).name: Distracting Strike (Melee)
distracting strike (melee).description: Distract the target, giving your allies Advantage on their next attack roll against it.

distracting strike (ranged).name: Distracting Strike (Ranged)
distracting strike (ranged).description: Distract the target, giving your allies Advantage on their next attack roll against it.

divine favour.name: Divine Favour
divine favour.description: Your prayer empowers you with divine radiance. Your weapons deal an additional 1d4 Radiant damage.

divine guardian.name: Divine Guardian
divine guardian.description: Protect an ally with a shard of your divine essence. They become resistant to all damage.

divine intervention.name: Divine Intervention
divine intervention.description: Call upon your deity in your moment of greatest need. Once they interfere, your deity will never do so again in this manner.

divine intervention: arm thy servant.name: Divine Intervention: Arm Thy Servant
divine intervention: arm thy servant.description: Call upon your deity to grant you a legendary weapon forged in the fires of your holy bond.

divine intervention: golden generosity.name: Divine Intervention: Golden Generosity
divine intervention: golden generosity.description: Call upon your deity to provide you with a rich bounty of potions and Camp Supplies.

divine intervention: opulent revival.name: Divine Intervention: Opulent Revival
divine intervention: opulent revival.description: Resurrect fallen companions with half their hit points, and restore all nearby allies as if they had Long Rested.

divine intervention: sunder the heretica.name: Divine Intervention: Sunder the Heretical
divine intervention: sunder the heretica.description: Call upon your deity to bring forth a radiant cataclysm upon all nearby enemies.

divine retaliation.name: Divine Retaliation
divine retaliation.description: Strike back at the enemy that attacked you or your ally.

divine revelry.name: Divine Revelry
divine revelry.description: Conjure forth a barrel of Shadowdark Ale from the Yawning Portal and spread an Irrestible Dance across all nearby creatures.

divine sense.name: Divine Sense
divine sense.description: Tap into your spiritual awareness to gain Advantage on Attack Rolls against celestials, fiends, and undead.

divine smite.name: Divine Smite
divine smite.description: Your weapon deals an additional 2d8 Radiant DRS damage, increased by 1d8 Radiant damage when attacking Fiends or Undead.

divine strike: cold (melee).name: Divine Strike: Cold (Melee)
divine strike: cold (melee).description: Once per turn deal 1d8 Cold in addition to your weapon's damage when you make a melee attack.

divine strike: elemental fury.name: Divine Strike: Elemental Fury
divine strike: elemental fury.description: Once per turn deal 1d8 Cold , 1d8 Fire or 1d8 Lightning in addition to your weapon's damage when you make a melee attack.

divine strike: fire (melee).name: Divine Strike: Fire (Melee)
divine strike: fire (melee).description: Once per turn deal 1d8 Fire in addition to your weapon's damage when you make a melee attack.

divine strike: lightning (melee).name: Divine Strike: Lightning (Melee)
divine strike: lightning (melee).description: Once per turn deal 1d8 Lightning in addition to your weapon's damage when you make a melee attack.

divine strike: necrotic.name: Divine Strike: Necrotic
divine strike: necrotic.description: Once per turn deal 1d8 Necrotic in addition to your weapon's damage when you make a melee attack.

divine strike: poison.name: Divine Strike: Poison
divine strike: poison.description: Once per turn deal 1d8 Poison in addition to your weapon's damage when you make a melee attack.

divine strike: poison (melee).name: Divine Strike: Poison (Melee)
divine strike: poison (melee).description: Once per turn deal 1d8 Poison in addition to your weapon's damage when you make a melee attack.

divine strike: radiant.name: Divine Strike: Radiant
divine strike: radiant.description: Strike a foe with your weapon as it becomes wreathed in gleaming radiance.

divine strike: radiant (melee).name: Divine Strike: Radiant (Melee)
divine strike: radiant (melee).description: Hew into a foe with your weapon as it flames with an exquisite radiance.

divine strike: thunder.name: Divine Strike: Thunder
divine strike: thunder.description: Once per turn deal 1d8 Thunder in addition to your weapon's damage when you make a melee attack.

divine strike: thunder (melee).name: Divine Strike: Thunder (Melee)
divine strike: thunder (melee).description: Once per turn deal 1d8 Thunder in addition to your weapon's damage when you make a melee attack.

divine strike: weapon.name: Divine Strike: Weapon
divine strike: weapon.description: Once per turn deal 1d8 Weapon in addition to your weapon damage.

divine strike: weapon (melee).name: Divine Strike: Weapon (Melee)
divine strike: weapon (melee).description: Once per turn deal 1d8 Weapon in addition to your melee weapon damage.

diving strike.name: Diving Strike
diving strike.description:
Leap down unto a foe below you, dealing normal weapon damage and knocking them Prone.
You do not take falling damage. You must be at least 1.5 m (5 ft) above your target.
Available only when Raging.

dominate beast.name: Dominate Beast
dominate beast.description: Make a beast fight alongside you. Every time the Beast takes damage, it makes a Wisdom Saving Throw against your domination.

dominate person.name: Dominate Person
dominate person.description: Dominate a nearby humanoid. Allies are unaffected.

doppelganger.name: Doppelganger
doppelganger.description: Take the shape of a small or medium creature you've seen.

draconic elemental weapon.name: Draconic Elemental Weapon
draconic elemental weapon.description: Imbue a weapon with elemental power. It receives a +1 bonus to Attack Rolls and deals an additional 1d4 damage of your choice.

draconic elemental weapon: acid.name: Draconic Elemental Weapon: Acid
draconic elemental weapon: acid.description: Imbue a weapon with corrosive might. It receives a +1 bonus to Attack rolls and deals an additional 1d4 Acid damage.

draconic elemental weapon: cold.name: Draconic Elemental Weapon: Cold
draconic elemental weapon: cold.description: Imbue a weapon with an icy might. It receives a +1 bonus to Attack rolls and deals an additional 1d4 Cold damage.

draconic elemental weapon: fire.name: Draconic Elemental Weapon: Fire
draconic elemental weapon: fire.description: Imbue a weapon with an icy might. It receives a +1 bonus to Attack rolls and deals an additional 1d4 Fire damage.

draconic elemental weapon: lightning.name: Draconic Elemental Weapon: Lightning
draconic elemental weapon: lightning.description: Imbue a weapon with an icy might. It receives a +1 bonus to Attack rolls and deals an additional 1d4 Lightning damage.

draconic elemental weapon: thunder.name: Draconic Elemental Weapon: Thunder
draconic elemental weapon: thunder.description: Imbue a weapon with an icy might. It receives a +1 bonus to Attack rolls and deals an additional 1d4 Thunder damage.

draining kiss.name: Draining Kiss
draining kiss.description: Lay a deadly kiss upon a foe Charmed by your Fiendish Charm .

draining kiss (haarlep).name: Draining Kiss (Haarlep)
draining kiss (haarlep).description: Lay a deadly kiss upon a foe Charmed by your Incubus Charm .

dread ambusher (melee).name: Dread Ambusher (Melee)
dread ambusher (melee).description: On the first turn of each combat, ambush a target with an additional swift and precise attack.

dread ambusher (ranged).name: Dread Ambusher (Ranged)
dread ambusher (ranged).description: On the first turn of each combat, ambush a target with an additional swift and precise attack.

dread ambusher: hide.name: Dread Ambusher: Hide
dread ambusher: hide.description: Hide from enemies by succeeding at Stealth checks. Stick to the dark and avoid enemy sightlines. Attacking or casting a spell will reveal your location.

dread embrace.name: Dread Embrace
dread embrace.description: Hold a humanoid enemy still. They can't move, act, or react. Attacks from within 3 m / 10 ft are always Critical Hits.

dreadful aspect.name: Dreadful Aspect
dreadful aspect.description: Let your darkest emotions burst forth as a menacing pulse to Frighten nearby enemies.

dreadful glare.name: Dreadful Glare
dreadful glare.description: Affix a target with your baleful gaze to Frighten it.

drow magic: faerie fire.name: Drow Magic: Faerie Fire
drow magic: faerie fire.description: All targets within the light turn visible, and Attack Rolls against them have Advantage.

drunken inhale.name: Drunken Inhale
drunken inhale.description: Compel foes toward you with an intoxicating wind that makes them Drunk .

drunken technique.name: Drunken Technique
drunken technique.description: Punch twice in quick succession and grant yourself an additional 3 m / 10 ft movement and the benefits of Disengage .

dueller's enthusiasm.name: Dueller's Enthusiasm
dueller's enthusiasm.description: While you are not dual-wielding and your off hand is empty, you can make an additional melee attack with The Dueller.

eagle's splendour.name: Eagle's Splendour
eagle's splendour.description: Creature gains Advantage on Charisma Checks.

echoes in the dark.name: Echoes in the Dark
echoes in the dark.description: The creature cries out in alarm to alert its allies.

edge of darkness.name: Edge of Darkness
edge of darkness.description: Create a cloud of Darkness while you attack. [See Notes]

eldritch blast.name: Eldritch Blast
eldritch blast.description: Conjure a beam of crackling energy. Deals 1d10 Force damage to a target.

electrified flail.name: Electrified Flail
electrified flail.description: Clout a foe with your lightning-suffused flail and Stun them.

electrified regurgitation.name: Electrified Regurgitation
electrified regurgitation.description: A sip from the Brewer's special booze causes him to vomit an electrified fluid that can Stun those it hits.

elemental age.name: Elemental Age
elemental age.description: Give your main hand weapon a +1 bonus to its Attack Rolls and an additional 1d4 Acid , Cold or Fire damage to its strikes depending on the elemental age embodied.

elemental cleaver.name: Elemental Cleaver
elemental cleaver.description: Channel primordial might into your weapon. Until the end of your Rage, your weapon will deal 1d6 additional Acid , Cold , Fire , Lightning , or Thunder damage, and gain the Thrown property. If thrown, it will immediately reappear in your hand.

elemental warp.name: Elemental Warp
elemental warp.description: Surrounded by silver mist, you teleport to an unoccupied space you can see.

elemental weapon.name: Elemental Weapon
elemental weapon.description: Imbue a weapon with elemental power. It receives a +1 bonus to Attack Rolls and deals an additional 1d4 damage of your choice.

elemental weapon: acid.name: Elemental Weapon: Acid
elemental weapon: acid.description: Imbue a weapon with corrosive might. It receives a +1 bonus to Attack rolls and deals an additional 1d4 Acid damage.

elemental weapon: cold.name: Elemental Weapon: Cold
elemental weapon: cold.description: Imbue a weapon with an icy might. It receives a +1 bonus to Attack rolls and deals an additional 1d4 Cold damage.

elemental weapon: fire.name: Elemental Weapon: Fire
elemental weapon: fire.description: Imbue a weapon with fiery might. It receives a +1 bonus to Attack rolls and deals an additional 1d4 Fire damage.

elemental weapon: lightning.name: Elemental Weapon: Lightning
elemental weapon: lightning.description: Imbue a weapon with an electrical might. It receives a +1 bonus to Attack rolls and deals an additional 1d4 Lightning damage.

elemental weapon: thunder.name: Elemental Weapon: Thunder
elemental weapon: thunder.description: Imbue a weapon with thunderous might. It receives a +1 bonus to Attack rolls and deals an additional 1d4 Thunder damage.

embrace of the inferno.name: Embrace of the Inferno
embrace of the inferno.description: Expel the fire burning through your veins as 3 flaming rays. Each ray deals 2d6 Fire .

empowered unarmed strike.name: Empowered Unarmed Strike
empowered unarmed strike.description: Blessed by the unholy strength of Bane, deal 1d4 + Strength modifier Bludgeoning damage and 4d8 + Strength modifer Force damage.

end rage.name: End Rage
end rage.description: Use a bonus action to end your Rage.

endless rage.name: Endless Rage
endless rage.description:
While Raging, you deal an additional 1d4 Physical damage with weapon attacks, but receive 1d4 Psychic damage each turn.
Prevents Rage from ending early.

enhance ability.name: Enhance Ability
enhance ability.description: Bestow a magical enchantment upon an ally. They gain Advantage on Ability Checks with a chosen Ability.

enhanced jump.name: Enhanced Jump
enhanced jump.description: Jump up, down, and across. Your Strength affects how far you can jump.

enlarge.name: Enlarge
enlarge.description:
Make a creature larger.
Its weapons deal an extra 1d4 damage. It has Advantage on Strength Checks and Saving throws.

enlarge/reduce.name: Enlarge/Reduce
enlarge/reduce.description:
Make a creature larger or smaller. Either option has a duration of 10 turns.
This affects their weapon damage and Strength Checks and Saving throws.

enough, wretches!.name: Enough, Wretches!
enough, wretches!.description: Cazador switches from spells to savage melee attacks.

enrage.name: Enrage
enrage.description: Give in to the owlbear's base instincts to increase your Strength and Constitution by 2, gain 12 temporary hit points, and possibly make nearby creatures Fearful.

enraged throw.name: Enraged Throw
enraged throw.description: Pick up an item or creature and throw it at a target, dealing additional damage and knocking it Prone.

ensnaring strands.name: Ensnaring Strands
ensnaring strands.description: Your attack conjures thick sticky webbing that possibly Enwebs your target(s).

ensnaring strike.name: Ensnaring Strike
ensnaring strike.description: Your attack summons thorny vines that possibly Ensnare your target.

ensnaring strike (melee).name: Ensnaring Strike (Melee)
ensnaring strike (melee).description: Your attack summons thorny vines that possibly Ensnare your target.

ensnaring strike (ranged).name: Ensnaring Strike (Ranged)
ensnaring strike (ranged).description: Your attack summons thorny vines that possibly Ensnare your target.

entangle.name: Entangle
entangle.description: Vines sprout from the ground, turning it into Difficult Terrain and possibly Entangling creatures within.

entangling plants.name: Entangling Plants
entangling plants.description: Sprout cursed roots and vines all around you, slowing non-plant creatures and possibly Entangling enemies.

enthrall.name: Enthrall
enthrall.description: Reduce a creature's peripheral vision and make it look at you.

erupting cinder.name: Erupting Cinder
erupting cinder.description: Stoke a giant cinderball and lob it, bursting in wide explosion and creating a fiery surface.

eternal devotion.name: Eternal Devotion
eternal devotion.description: Recite your Oath to regain 1 Channel Oath Charge.

ethel's insect plague.name: Ethel's Insect Plague
ethel's insect plague.description:
Locusts attack everyone within range, make the area Difficult Terrain, and impose Disadvantage on Perception Checks.
Ethel and her allies are immune to the effects.

ethel's ray of sickness.name: Ethel's Ray of Sickness
ethel's ray of sickness.description: Possibly Poisons the target. 3 additional rays leap from the target to nearby foes within 8 m (27 ft).

ethereal jaunt.name: Ethereal Jaunt
ethereal jaunt.description: Surrounded by silver mist, you teleport to an unoccupied space you can see.

evard's black tentacles.name: Evard's Black Tentacles
evard's black tentacles.description: Tentacles sprout from the ground, turning the area into Difficult Terrain , attacking and Smothering creatures within.

evasive footwork.name: Evasive Footwork
evasive footwork.description: Evade attacks; enemies receive Disadvantage on melee attacks against you.

exhort the risen.name: Exhort the Risen
exhort the risen.description: Subjugate the undead with your commands.

expeditious retreat.name: Expeditious Retreat
expeditious retreat.description: Gain Dash immediately and as a bonus action on each of your turns until this spell ends.

expert stitching.name: Expert Stitching
expert stitching.description: Stitch up a flesh golem to heal it.

explosive icicle.name: Explosive Icicle
explosive icicle.description: Hurl three tridents forged of glistening ice that pierce targets and create ice surfaces on impact.

explosive retribution.name: Explosive Retribution
explosive retribution.description: Toss a cluster of damaging explosives around you that explode in 2 turns, dealing 4d8 Fire and 4d8 Force damage.

exposing bite.name: Exposing Bite
exposing bite.description: Nip at a target and distract it. If your attack hits, the next attack against the target from within 2 m (7 ft) will be a Critical Hit.

extract brain.name: Extract Brain
extract brain.description: Try to extract the brain of a Stunned or Unconscious creature.

extract brain (full-illithid).name: Extract Brain (Full-illithid)
extract brain (full-illithid).description: Lobotomize a nearby creature that is Stunned, Prone, Sleeping, or Unconscious.

extraplanar summons.name: Extraplanar Summons
extraplanar summons.description: Pull an ally into battle through the open Astral Rift.

exude mating pheromones.name: Exude Mating Pheromones
exude mating pheromones.description: The alioramus excretes its pheromones to drive any other nearby alioramus into a Frenzy .

eyebite.name: Eyebite
eyebite.description: Your eyes become black corridors walled in teeth, your gaze capable of inflicting dread, sickness, or putting creatures to sleep.

eyebite: panicked.name: Eyebite: Panicked
eyebite: panicked.description: Strike Fear deep into a creature's heart.

eyebite: sickened.name: Eyebite: Sickened
eyebite: sickened.description: Afflict a creature with Disadvantage on Attack Rolls and Ability Checks.

eyes of the dark: darkness.name: Eyes of the Dark: Darkness
eyes of the dark: darkness.description: Create a dark shroud that Heavily Obscures and Blinds creatures within. Creatures cannot make ranged attacks into or out of it.

faerie fire.name: Faerie Fire
faerie fire.description: All targets within the light turn visible, and Attack Rolls against them have Advantage.

faithwarden's vines.name: Faithwarden's Vines
faithwarden's vines.description: Vines sprout from the ground, turning it into Difficult Terrain and possibly Entangling creatures within.

fallen lover.name: Fallen Lover
fallen lover.description: Summon a Wood Woad bound to your tree to fight alongside you.

false life.name: False Life
false life.description: Bolster yourself with a necromantic facsimile of life to gain 7 temporary hit points.

fanatic retaliation.name: Fanatic Retaliation
fanatic retaliation.description: Avenge a fallen Spindleweb Fanatic with a psionic barrage that can Silence its killer.

fangs of the fire snake.name: Fangs of the Fire Snake
fangs of the fire snake.description: Hit foes from afar. Your next melee attacks deal an additional 1d4 Fire damage.

fear.name: Fear
fear.description: Hostile targets drop everything and become Fearful: they have Disadvantage on Ability Checks and Attack Rolls.

fear ray.name: Fear Ray
fear ray.description: Shoot an eye ray that Frightens its target.

feather fall.name: Feather Fall
feather fall.description: You and nearby allies gain Immunity to Falling damage.

feign death.name: Feign Death
feign death.description: Put an ally in a protective coma. They become Resistant to all damage except Psychic . Disease and poison no longer have any effect.

feinting attack.name: Feinting Attack
feinting attack.description: Use both your action and bonus action on a turn to attack a target with Advantage and bonus damage.

fey presence.name: Fey Presence
fey presence.description: Charm or Frighten nearby foes with the feywild's beguiling, disturbing magics.

fey presence: beguiling.name: Fey Presence: Beguiling
fey presence: beguiling.description: Charm nearby foes with the feywild's beguiling, seductive magics.

fey presence: disturbing.name: Fey Presence: Disturbing
fey presence: disturbing.description: Frighten nearby foes with the feywild's distressing, flustering magics.

fiendish ascension.name: Fiendish Ascension
fiendish ascension.description:
Harness the energy of a recently shattered Soul Pillar to take on a more powerful infernal form, and consume a new soul for every broken pillar.
Each time Raphael transforms he may stay in this heightened aspect for longer.

fiendish charm.name: Fiendish Charm
fiendish charm.description: Charm a humanoid to prevent it from attacking you. You gain Advantage on Charisma Ability Checks in dialogue.

fiendish flameblast.name: Fiendish Flameblast
fiendish flameblast.description: Explode in a powerful blast that ignites creatures with Infernal Burning .

fiendish resilience.name: Fiendish Resilience
fiendish resilience.description: Choose a damage type and become Resistant to it. You can pick a new damage type each Short Rest.

fiendish resilience: acid.name: Fiendish Resilience: Acid
fiendish resilience: acid.description: Grant yourself Resistance to Acid damage.

fiendish resilience: bludgeoning.name: Fiendish Resilience: Bludgeoning
fiendish resilience: bludgeoning.description: Grant yourself Resistance to Bludgeoning damage.

fiendish resilience: cold.name: Fiendish Resilience: Cold
fiendish resilience: cold.description: Grant yourself Resistance to Cold damage.

fiendish resilience: fire.name: Fiendish Resilience: Fire
fiendish resilience: fire.description: Grant yourself Resistance to Fire damage.

fiendish resilience: force.name: Fiendish Resilience: Force
fiendish resilience: force.description: Grant yourself Resistance to Force damage.

fiendish resilience: lightning.name: Fiendish Resilience: Lightning
fiendish resilience: lightning.description: Grant yourself Resistance to Lightning damage.

fiendish resilience: necrotic.name: Fiendish Resilience: Necrotic
fiendish resilience: necrotic.description: Grant yourself Resistance to Necrotic damage.

fiendish resilience: piercing.name: Fiendish Resilience: Piercing
fiendish resilience: piercing.description: Grant yourself Resistance to Piercing damage.

fiendish resilience: poison.name: Fiendish Resilience: Poison
fiendish resilience: poison.description: Grant yourself Resistance to Poison damage.

fiendish resilience: psychic.name: Fiendish Resilience: Psychic
fiendish resilience: psychic.description: Grant yourself Resistance to Psychic damage.

fiendish resilience: radiant.name: Fiendish Resilience: Radiant
fiendish resilience: radiant.description: Grant yourself Resistance to Radiant damage.

fiendish resilience: slashing.name: Fiendish Resilience: Slashing
fiendish resilience: slashing.description: Grant yourself Resistance to Slashing damage.

fiendish resilience: thunder.name: Fiendish Resilience: Thunder
fiendish resilience: thunder.description: Grant yourself Resistance to Thunder damage.

fierce perilous stakes.name: Fierce Perilous Stakes
fierce perilous stakes.description: Grant an ally an additional 15 Psychic damage, healing 2~16 Hit Points when they attack. They become Vulnerable to all damage for the duration of this effect.

fiery regurgitation.name: Fiery Regurgitation
fiery regurgitation.description: A sip from the Brewer's special booze causes him to vomit fire.

find familiar.name: Find Familiar
find familiar.description: Summon a familiar, a fey spirit that takes an animal form of your choosing

find familiar: boo.name: Find Familiar: Boo
find familiar: boo.description: Summon your adorable, occasionally violent, and above all faithful companion, Boo.

find familiar: cat.name: Find Familiar: Cat
find familiar: cat.description: Summon a cat familiar that can Meow to distract your enemies.

find familiar: cheeky quasit.name: Find Familiar: Cheeky Quasit
find familiar: cheeky quasit.description: Summon a familiar with the form of a quasit that can turn Invisible and Scare enemies.

find familiar: crab.name: Find Familiar: Crab
find familiar: crab.description: Summon a crab familiar that can slow enemies with its Crippling Pinch .

find familiar: frog.name: Find Familiar: Frog
find familiar: frog.description: Summon a frog familiar who can spread its Bufotoxin to enemies.

find familiar: imp.name: Find Familiar: Imp
find familiar: imp.description: Summon a familiar with the form of an imp that can fly, turn Invisible, and Sting enemies.

find familiar: quasit.name: Find Familiar: Quasit
find familiar: quasit.description: Summon a familiar with the form of a quasit that can turn Invisible and Scare enemies.

find familiar: rat.name: Find Familiar: Rat
find familiar: rat.description: Summon a rat familiar with an Infectious Bite .

find familiar: raven.name: Find Familiar: Raven
find familiar: raven.description: Summon a raven familiar that can Blind enemies with its beak.

find familiar: scratch.name: Find Familiar: Scratch
find familiar: scratch.description: Summon the best boy. Scratch's keen nose can discover many things hidden around the world.

find familiar: spider.name: Find Familiar: Spider
find familiar: spider.description: Summon a spider familiar with a poisonous Bite .

finger of death.name: Finger of Death
finger of death.description: Point at a foe to cause searing pain.

fire breath.name: Fire Breath
fire breath.description: Spew forth a cone of fire.

fire hallucination.name: Fire Hallucination
fire hallucination.description: Magically inebriated as he is, Thisobald the Brewer is hallucinating flaming imps into existence.

fire shield.name: Fire Shield
fire shield.description: Wreathe your body in flames that shed light in a 3 m (10 ft) radius, provide Resistance to Fire or Cold damage, and retaliate against melee attacks.

fire shield: chill.name: Fire Shield: Chill
fire shield: chill.description: Ice-cold flames shed light in a 3 m (10 ft) radius. You take only half the damage of all Fire damage, and deal 2d8 Cold damage to anyone who hits you with a melee attack.

fire shield: warm.name: Fire Shield: Warm
fire shield: warm.description: Scorching flames shed light in a 3 m / 10 ft radius. You take only half the damage of all Cold damage, and deal 2d8 Fire damage to anyone who hits you with a melee attack.

fireball.name: Fireball
fireball.description: Shoot a bright flame from your fingers that explodes upon contact, torching everything in the vicinity for 8d6 Fire damage.

firewine explosion.name: Firewine Explosion
firewine explosion.description: Fire ignites the alcohol remaining in the corpse, creating an explosion.

fist.name: Fist
fist.description: Lash out with a fungal hand.

fist of four thunders.name: Fist of Four Thunders
fist of four thunders.description: Release a wave of thunderous force that pushes away all creatures and objects.

fist of unbroken air.name: Fist of Unbroken Air
fist of unbroken air.description: Push the target back 6 m / 20 ft and knock it Prone.

flail of madness.name: Flail of Madness
flail of madness.description: Strike a creature with the Flail of Dread Skulls and possibly drive it Mad.

flail of pain.name: Flail of Pain
flail of pain.description: Strike a creature with the Flail of Dread Skulls to inflict as much pain as possible.

flail of paralysis.name: Flail of Paralysis
flail of paralysis.description: Strike a creature with the Flail of Dread Skulls and possibly Paralyse it.

flame blade.name: Flame Blade
flame blade.description: Conjure a flaming Scimitar in your hand for 10 turns that deals 3d6 Fire damage. It sheds a bright light in a 3 m (10 ft) radius and a dim light in a 6 m (20 ft) radius.

flame of wrath.name: Flame of Wrath
flame of wrath.description: Embrace Kereska's flame to gain resistance to Fire damage. Your fire spells deal additional Fire damage equal to your proficiency bonus.

flame strike.name: Flame Strike
flame strike.description: Make a pillar of divine fire roar down from the heavens like the wrath of affronted angels.

flames of the phoenix.name: Flames of the Phoenix
flames of the phoenix.description: Shoot a bright flame from your fingers that explodes upon contact, torching everything in the vicinity

flaming blade.name: Flaming Blade
flaming blade.description: Immolate your blade like a phoenix wing and strike a foe with its blazing steel.

flaming fury.name: Flaming Fury
flaming fury.description: Attack with a weapon wreathed in righteous flames.

flaming sphere.name: Flaming Sphere
flaming sphere.description: Summon a Flaming Sphere that deals 2d6 Fire damage to nearby enemies and objects. It also sheds bright light in a 6 m (20 ft) radius, and dim light for an additional 6 m (20 ft). You can move the sphere.

fleeting dream.name: Fleeting Dream
fleeting dream.description: Surrounded by silver mist, you teleport to an unoccupied space you can see.

flesh to gold.name: Flesh to Gold
flesh to gold.description: Restrain a target and, after 3 rounds, the target becomes inactive solid gold until the spell ends.

flesh to stone.name: Flesh to Stone
flesh to stone.description: Atrophy a foe, Restraining them until they temporarily turn to stone.

florrick's cohort.name: Florrick's Cohort
florrick's cohort.description: Summon Florrick's personal guard - highly defensive warriors who can hold their own in melee.

flourish.name: Flourish
flourish.description: Feint an attack to possibly throw your opponent Off Balance.

fluffy memory.name: Fluffy Memory
fluffy memory.description: Oliver summons his favourite fluffy friend!

flurry of blows: push.name: Flurry of Blows: Push
flurry of blows: push.description: Punch twice in quick succession and potentially push your target 5 m / 17 ft away.

flurry of blows: stagger.name: Flurry of Blows: Stagger
flurry of blows: stagger.description: Punch twice in quick succession and Stagger the target, making it unable to take Reactions.

flurry of blows: topple.name: Flurry of Blows: Topple
flurry of blows: topple.description: Punch twice in quick succession and potentially knock the target Prone.

flurry of moths: attack.name: Flurry of Moths: Attack
flurry of moths: attack.description: Use your swarm to attack the same target and deal 1d6 Psychic damage.

flurry of moths: blinding swarm.name: Flurry of Moths: Blinding Swarm
flurry of moths: blinding swarm.description: Use your swarm to Blind your target.

flurry of moths: mighty blinding swarm.name: Flurry of Moths: Mighty Blinding Swarm
flurry of moths: mighty blinding swarm.description: Use your swarm to Blind and Slow your target.

flurry of moths: mighty teleport.name: Flurry of Moths: Mighty Teleport
flurry of moths: mighty teleport.description: Use your swarm to carry you to a new location within 5 m (17 ft) and gain a temporary +2 bonus to your Armour Class.

flurry of moths: teleport.name: Flurry of Moths: Teleport
flurry of moths: teleport.description: Use your swarm to carry you to a new location.

fly.name: Fly
fly.description: Bestow the ability to Fly upon yourself.

fog cloud.name: Fog Cloud
fog cloud.description: Create a cloud of dense fog to Heavily Obscure and Blind creatures within.

force tunnel.name: Force Tunnel
force tunnel.description: Charge forward, pushing all objects and creatures in your path 4 m / 13 ft away from you.

forced manoeuvre.name: Forced Manoeuvre
forced manoeuvre.description: Increase an ally's movement speed by 4.5 m (15 ft). They don't provoke Opportunity Attacks.

forced teleportation.name: Forced Teleportation
forced teleportation.description: Cazador forcibly teleports one of his vampire spawn to a nearby location.

forceful throw.name: Forceful Throw
forceful throw.description: Throw an item at a creature, wounding it and possibly knocking it Prone .

form of dread.name: Form of Dread
form of dread.description: Manifest some of Vlaakith's power and appearance.

formsculpt tressym.name: Formsculpt Tressym
formsculpt tressym.description: Rearrange a creature's very being into the image of Gale's darling pet.

fox's cunning.name: Fox's Cunning
fox's cunning.description: Creature gains Advantage on Intelligence Checks.

fracture psyche.name: Fracture Psyche
fracture psyche.description: Invade a target's mind and disrupt its defences. The target's Armour Class and Saving throws are reduced by 1.

freedom of movement.name: Freedom of Movement
freedom of movement.description: Snap an ally out of any Stun. Difficult Terrain can't slow them down, and they can't be magically Paralysed or Restrained.

frenzied charge.name: Frenzied Charge
frenzied charge.description: Charge forward, attacking all enemies in the way and pushing them back 3 m / 10 ft.

frenzied fury.name: Frenzied Fury
frenzied fury.description: Filled with a furious anger, the gnoll can attack multiple times on its turn.

frenzied strike.name: Frenzied Strike
frenzied strike.description: As a bonus action, make a melee attack with your equipped weapon.

frenzy.name: Frenzy
frenzy.description: Your Rage turns into a frenzy! You gain Frenzied Strike and Enraged Throw. You can also make an Improvised Melee Weapon attack as a bonus action.

friends.name: Friends
friends.description: Gain Advantage on Charisma Checks against a non-hostile creature.

frightful presence.name: Frightful Presence
frightful presence.description: Exude terror, making your foes Fearful .

frigid blade.name: Frigid Blade
frigid blade.description:
You add your Proficiency Bonus as Cold Damage.
When the attack hits, apply Frostbitten. The creature takes 1d4 Cold damage when making a weapon attack.

frost breath.name: Frost Breath
frost breath.description: Spew forth a cone of ice.

frost of dark winter.name: Frost of Dark Winter
frost of dark winter.description: Embrace Kereska's ice to gain resistance to Cold damage. Your cold spells deal additional Cold damage equal to your proficiency bonus.

fungal infestation.name: Fungal Infestation
fungal infestation.description: Raises a mildewed, mould-encrusted zombie from a corpse.

gale.name: Gale
gale.description: Beat your majestic wings to create a gust that knocks creatures back 5 m / 17 ft and makes them fall Prone .

galvanise.name: Galvanise
galvanise.description: Bestow all allies within 5 m (17 ft) with an Action Surge they can spend.

gargantuan cleave.name: Gargantuan Cleave
gargantuan cleave.description: Swing your weapon with all your might. You can attack multiple targets, dealing bonus 1d6 Slashing DRS damage, but become Off Balanced.

gargoyle's countenance.name: Gargoyle's Countenance
gargoyle's countenance.description: Become stone, gaining Resistance to non-magical Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage.

garrotte.name: Garrotte
garrotte.description: Wraps a shadow rope around a Humanoid creature's throat to start Garrotting it.

gaseous form.name: Gaseous Form
gaseous form.description: Transform yourself or an ally into a tiny gas cloud. It can't fall, and fits through small openings. It is very hard to damage.

gather power.name: Gather Power
gather power.description: Take flight, land, and begin to gather power.

gather your allies.name: Gather Your Allies
gather your allies.description: You've forged bonds along your journey, adventurer. Call upon them in you hour of need.

gaze of the dead.name: Gaze of the Dead
gaze of the dead.description: Cast your empty eyes towards a creature and Frighten it.

ghoulish touch.name: Ghoulish Touch
ghoulish touch.description: Lash out with deadly claws and possibly Paralyse the target.

giant form.name: Giant Form
giant form.description: Grow to a fearsome size. Your weapons deal an additional 1d6 damage and you gain 27 temporary hit points and Advantage on Strength Checks and Saving throws.

giant's rage.name: Giant's Rage
giant's rage.description: Enter a Rage and increase in size. Your Rage damage bonus is doubled on Throw attacks.

githborn: flying boots.name: Githborn: Flying Boots
githborn: flying boots.description: Bestow the ability to Fly upon yourself.

githyanki psionics: mage hand.name: Githyanki Psionics: Mage Hand
githyanki psionics: mage hand.description: Create an invisible spectral hand that can manipulate and interact with objects.

glacial age.name: Glacial Age
glacial age.description: Gain a +1 bonus to Attack rolls and deals an additional 1d4 Cold damage.

globe of invulnerability.name: Globe of Invulnerability
globe of invulnerability.description: Create a barrier that makes creatures and objects inside it immune to all damage.

glyph of warding.name: Glyph of Warding
glyph of warding.description:
Inscribe a circle of arcane glyphs on the ground. When stepped on by an enemy the selected magical effect will trigger.
The glyph will last until triggered, or until a Long Rest.

glyph of warding: acid.name: Glyph of Warding: Acid
glyph of warding: acid.description:
The glyph explodes, dealing Acid damage to enemies in the vicinity. Creatures who pass the Dexterity Saving Throw still take half damage.
The glyph will last until triggered, or until a Long Rest.

glyph of warding: cold.name: Glyph of Warding: Cold
glyph of warding: cold.description:
The glyph explodes, dealing Cold damage to enemies in the vicinity. Creatures who pass the Dexterity Saving Throw still take half damage.
The glyph will last until triggered, or until a Long Rest.

glyph of warding: detonation.name: Glyph of Warding: Detonation
glyph of warding: detonation.description:
The glyph emits a gust of wind that pushes back everyone within range when stepped on by an enemy. Any creatures within the area of effect that fail the Dexterity Saving Throw will be pushed back.
The glyph will last until triggered, or until a Long Rest.

glyph of warding: fire.name: Glyph of Warding: Fire
glyph of warding: fire.description:
The glyph explodes, dealing Fire damage to enemies in the vicinity. Creatures who pass the Dexterity Saving Throw still take half damage.
The glyph will last until triggered, or until a Long Rest.

glyph of warding: lightning.name: Glyph of Warding: Lightning
glyph of warding: lightning.description:
The glyph explodes, dealing Lightning damage to enemies in the vicinity. Creatures who pass the Dexterity Saving Throw still take half damage.
The glyph will last until triggered, or until a Long Rest.

glyph of warding: sleep.name: Glyph of Warding: Sleep
glyph of warding: sleep.description:
The glyph emits a soothing magic that puts everyone within range to Sleep when stepped on by an enemy. Any creatures within the area of effect (that aren't immune to magical sleep) that fail the Dexterity Saving Throw will be put to Sleep.
The glyph will last until triggered, or until a Long Rest.

glyph of warding: thunder.name: Glyph of Warding: Thunder
glyph of warding: thunder.description:
The glyph explodes, dealing Thunder damage to enemies in the vicinity. Creatures who pass the Dexterity Saving Throw still take half damage.
The glyph will last until triggered, or until a Long Rest.

goading attack (melee).name: Goading Attack (Melee)
goading attack (melee).description: Goad an enemy into attacking only you. It gains Disadvantage on attack rolls against anyone but you. [See: Bugs]

goading attack (ranged).name: Goading Attack (Ranged)
goading attack (ranged).description: Goad an enemy into attacking only you. It gains Disadvantage on attack rolls against anyone but you. [See: Bugs]

goading blast.name: Goading Blast
goading blast.description: Blast nearby enemies, goading them into attacking you.

goading roar.name: Goading Roar
goading roar.description: Roar at nearby enemies to goad them into attacking you.

gondian steel watcher.name: Gondian Steel Watcher
gondian steel watcher.description: Summon a recalibrated bidpedal Steel Watcher - a durable, heavy-hitting frontline menace

gong of the summit.name: Gong of the Summit
gong of the summit.description: Damages all nearby creatures and objects. Creatures made of inorganic material such as stone have Disadvantage on their Saving throw.

goodberry.name: Goodberry
goodberry.description:
Conjure four magical berries for yourself or a companion. Creatures who eat a berry regain 1d4 hit points .
Each berry counts as one Camp Supplies.
The berries appear in the targeted creature's inventory and disappear after a Long Rest.

gossamer tomb.name: Gossamer Tomb
gossamer tomb.description: Entomb a creature that attacks your offspring with an Infested glob of web.

grand slam.name: Grand Slam
grand slam.description: Slam your weapon into the ground, dealing additional Thunder damage equal to your proficiency bonus, thunderously impacting nearby foes and possibly pushing them away.

grant flight.name: Grant Flight
grant flight.description: Bestow the ability to Fly upon yourself or an ally.

grapple.name: Grapple
grapple.description: Grapples a creature and deals 2d6 + Strength modifier Bludgeoning damage.

grasping appendage.name: Grasping Appendage
grasping appendage.description: Pull a creature 9 m / 30 ft closer.

grasping pull.name: Grasping Pull
grasping pull.description: Grasp a target and pull it 9 m / 30 ft towards you.

grasping vine.name: Grasping Vine
grasping vine.description: Summon a giant vine capable of dragging creatures toward itself.

grave repulsion.name: Grave Repulsion
grave repulsion.description: Release an ectoplasmic pulse that knocks living creatures back 8 m / 27 ft.

grave shot.name: Grave Shot
grave shot.description: Loose a bolt of necrotic energy. You can spend Predator Essence to empower the shot.

grease.name: Grease
grease.description: Cover the ground in flammable grease. It becomes Difficult Terrain and creatures within can fall Prone .

greasy discharge.name: Greasy Discharge
greasy discharge.description: Belch flammable grease at a target to knock it Prone .

greataxe slash.name: Greataxe Slash
greataxe slash.description: Cleave into a target with your mighty head.

greater invisibility.name: Greater Invisibility
greater invisibility.description: Turn a creature Invisible. Attacks against it have Disadvantage. It attacks with Advantage.

greater restoration.name: Greater Restoration
greater restoration.description: Touch a creature and negate any Charm, Petrification, Stun, or Curse.

greatsword slash.name: Greatsword Slash
greatsword slash.description: Slice into a target with your holy blade.

grounded thunder strike.name: Grounded Thunder Strike
grounded thunder strike.description: Wallop a foe with a fist of stone and thunder, potentially knocking them Prone.

guidance.name: Guidance
guidance.description: The target gains +1d4 bonus to Ability Checks.

guided strike.name: Guided Strike
guided strike.description: Gain a +10 bonus to your Attack Roll.

guiding bolt.name: Guiding Bolt
guiding bolt.description: The next attack roll against this target has Advantage.

guildmaster keene's fixers.name: Guildmaster Keene's Fixers
guildmaster keene's fixers.description: Summon two elite assassasin mercenaries from the Guild's ranks.

gur huntwardens.name: Gur Huntwardens
gur huntwardens.description: Summon Gur Monster hunters to hinder enemies while slipping in and out of the frontlines.

gushing air.name: Gushing Air
gushing air.description: Launch 2 jets of thunderous, billowing air.

gust of wind.name: Gust of Wind
gust of wind.description: Summon a strong wind that clears all clouds. Any creatures caught in the gale who fail a Strength Saving Throw will be pushed back 5 m (17 ft) and be thrown Off Balance.

hail of thorns.name: Hail of Thorns
hail of thorns.description: Shoot a volley of thorns. The thorns deal weapon damage to the target and then explode. The explosion deals an additional 1d10 Piercing damage to the target and surrounding creatures. On miss, the thorns still explode. On save, targets still take half damage from the explosion.

halberd slash.name: Halberd Slash
halberd slash.description: Cleave into a target with your glorious blade.

hallucination spores.name: Hallucination Spores
hallucination spores.description: Bestow hallucinations on a humanoid creature to make it wander around uncontrollably.

halo of spores.name: Halo of Spores
halo of spores.description: Unleash a cloud of necrotic spores upon a target. This uses a reaction, so other reactions won't trigger this turn.

hamstring shot.name: Hamstring Shot
hamstring shot.description: Shoot an enemy in the thigh and possibly reduce their movement speed by 50%.

hand me my leech.name: Hand Me My Leech
hand me my leech.description: Equips the Surgeon with a bloated, biting leech, allowing him to cast Leech .

hand me my saw.name: Hand Me My Saw
hand me my saw.description: Equips the Surgeon with a gory, jagged bonesaw, allowing him to cast Bloody Bonesaw .

hand me my syringe.name: Hand Me My Syringe
hand me my syringe.description: Equips the Surgeon with a crusty, rusted syringe, allowing him to cast This Won't Hurt A Bit .

hand me my trepan.name: Hand Me My Trepan
hand me my trepan.description: Equips the Surgeon with a poisonous trepan, allowing him to cast Terror Trepan .

harm.name: Harm
harm.description: Reduce a target's maximum Hit Points, but never below 1.

harmony of fire and water.name: Harmony of Fire and Water
harmony of fire and water.description: While not in combat, regain half of your Ki Points (rounded down).

harvest soul.name: Harvest Soul
harvest soul.description: Speak a word of fiendish destruction to instantly kill a creature with less than a third of its hit points, leaving it with a Severed Soul.

haste.name: Haste
haste.description: Target yourself or an ally to become Hastened. The creature has a +2 bonus to Armour Class, Advantage on Dexterity Saving Throws, its Movement Speed is doubled, and can take one additional Action per turn.

haste spores.name: Haste Spores
haste spores.description: Eject a cloud of white spores that Haste any creature that enters the cloud.

have nice gift!.name: Have Nice Gift!
have nice gift!.description: Give your Houndmaster the Prey Essence you collected.

headbutt.name: Headbutt
headbutt.description: Smash a foe with your head.

headcrack.name: Headcrack
headcrack.description: Lob a small payload at the target, wounding them and possibly inflicting Dazed.

heal.name: Heal
heal.description: Heals a target's wounds and remove Blindness and any diseases.

healing incense aura.name: Healing Incense Aura
healing incense aura.description: Emanating a soothing aura, You and nearby allies regain 1d4 Hit Points at the start of your turn

healing radiance.name: Healing Radiance
healing radiance.description: Heal yourself and all nearby allies. Regain the same amount the next turn.

healing vapours.name: Healing Vapours
healing vapours.description: Exude water vapour with your general elemental dampness, healing nearby creatures for 2d8 hit points .

healing word.name: Healing Word
healing word.description: Heal a creature you can see.

heart of the storm: lightning.name: Heart of the Storm: Lightning
heart of the storm: lightning.description: When you cast a spell that deals Lightning damage, you cause a small, local storm. All enemies within 6 m (20 ft) take (Sorcerer level / 2) Lightning damage.

heart of the storm: thunder.name: Heart of the Storm: Thunder
heart of the storm: thunder.description: When you cast a spell of level 1 or higher that deals Thunder damage, you cause a small, local storm. All enemies within 6 m (20 ft) take (Sorcerer level / 2) Thunder damage.

heartstopper.name: Heartstopper
heartstopper.description: Smash an enemy's chest in and possibly inflict Chest Trauma.

heartwrench.name: Heartwrench
heartwrench.description: Rend a target with a psychic barrage after you or an ally is struck by a Heartform Mapped creature.

heat metal.name: Heat Metal
heat metal.description: Cause a metal weapon or armour to glow red-hot and force the wearer to let go or receive Disadvantage on Attack Rolls and Ability Checks.

reapply heat metal.name: Reapply Heat Metal
reapply heat metal.description:
Cause a metal Weapon or Armour to glow red-hot and force the creature touching it to let go or receive Disadvantage on Attack rolls and Ability Checks. If the creature is only wearing metal armour, it always receives Disadvantage.
If the creature is still touching the metal, you can use a Bonus Action on subsequent turns to Reapply Heat Metal to deal another 2d8 Fire damage and force the creature to let go or receive Disadvantage.

hellcrawler.name: Hellcrawler
hellcrawler.description: Teleport to an area and deal 2d8 Fire damage where you land. The impact blast spreads in a 3 m / 10 ft zone.

hellfire curse.name: Hellfire Curse
hellfire curse.description: Induce a spark of hellfire within a target to give them Disadvantage on Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution Saving throws

hellfire exhaust.name: Hellfire Exhaust
hellfire exhaust.description: Vent a gout of hellfire from your engine. Any already Burning creatures caught in the blast take an extra 3d8 Fire damage.

hellfire missiles.name: Hellfire Missiles
hellfire missiles.description:
Shoot 24 hellfire missiles upwards that rain down on enemies. Each missile deals 4d6 Fire damage.
Hellfire ignores Resistance and Immunity to Fire damage.

hellfire orb.name: Hellfire Orb
hellfire orb.description: Hurl an exploding ball of hellfire that damages all nearby creatures and objects.

hellflame cleave.name: Hellflame Cleave
hellflame cleave.description: Spew hellish flames and strike your foes.

hellrider platoon.name: Hellrider Platoon
hellrider platoon.description: Summon Zevlor's Hellriders to Smite foes and support frontline allies.

hellstalker yurgir.name: Hellstalker Yurgir
hellstalker yurgir.description: Summon Yurgir the orthon - a deadly combatant at range or in melee who can become Invisible immediately after attacking.

help.name: Help
help.description: Help up Downed characters, or remove Burning, Ensnared, Entangled, Enwebbed, Prone, and Sleeping.

heroes' feast.name: Heroes' Feast
heroes' feast.description: You and everyone around can't be Poisoned, Diseased, or Frightened (status group). Everyone's maximum Hit Points increases by 12, and they make Wisdom Saving Throws with Advantage.

heroism.name: Heroism
heroism.description: Make yourself or a target immune to Frightened and gain 5 Temporary Hit Points each turn.

hex.name: Hex
hex.description: Make your attacks deal an additional 1d6 Necrotic damage to the target and give it Disadvantage on an Ability of your choosing.

hex (charisma).name: Hex (Charisma)
hex (charisma).description: Deal an additional 1d6 Necrotic damage when you attack the target and impart Disadvantage on Charisma Checks.

hex (constitution).name: Hex (Constitution)
hex (constitution).description: Deal an additional 1d6 Necrotic damage when you attack the target and impart Disadvantage on Constitution Checks.

hex (dexterity).name: Hex (Dexterity)
hex (dexterity).description: Deal an additional 1d6 Necrotic damage when you attack the target and impart Disadvantage on Dexterity Checks.

hex (intelligence).name: Hex (Intelligence)
hex (intelligence).description: Deal an additional 1d6 Necrotic damage when you attack the target and impart Disadvantage on Intelligence Checks.

hex (strength).name: Hex (Strength)
hex (strength).description: Deal an additional 1d6 Necrotic damage when you attack the target and impart Disadvantage on Strength Checks.

hex (wisdom).name: Hex (Wisdom)
hex (wisdom).description: Deal an additional 1d6 Necrotic damage when you attack the target and impart Disadvantage on Wisdom Checks.

hexblade's curse.name: Hexblade's Curse
hexblade's curse.description:
Curse a target. Your damage rolls against the target gain a bonus equal to your Proficiency bonus. The number you need to roll a Critical Hit while attacking the target is also reduced by 1.
If the target dies, you regain Warlock level + Charisma modifier hit points.

hide.name: Hide
hide.description:
Try to conceal yourself.
Hiding depends on your Stealth and whether you are Obscured. Attacking or casting spells reveals your location.

hide in plain sight.name: Hide in Plain Sight
hide in plain sight.description: Camouflage yourself with your environment to become Invisible and gain a +10 bonus on Stealth Checks, as long as you stand still.

hiemal strike.name: Hiemal Strike
hiemal strike.description: Pierce a creature with your frost-rimed trident and Chill it.

hold monster.name: Hold Monster
hold monster.description: Paralyse a creature. It can't move, act, or react. Attacks from within 3 m (10 ft) are always critical hits.

hold person.name: Hold Person
hold person.description:
Hold a humanoid enemy still. They can't move, act, or react. Attacks from within 3 m (10 ft) are always Critical Hits.
At the end of each turn, the affected creature can make a Wisdom Saving Throw to end this condition.

honeyed paws.name: Honeyed Paws
honeyed paws.description: Lash out with paws sticky from honey and Disarm your target. If it isn't holding any weapons, it falls Prone instead.

hook.name: Hook
hook.description: Lash out at a target to push it back 2 m / 7 ft and possibly make it Bleed .

hook clacks.name: Hook Clacks
hook clacks.description: As its allies draw near, the creature informs them of its exact location.

horde breaker (melee).name: Horde Breaker (Melee)
horde breaker (melee).description: Target two creatures standing close to each other. Attack the first creature and get a free shot at the second.

horde breaker (ranged).name: Horde Breaker (Ranged)
horde breaker (ranged).description: Target two creatures standing close to each other. Shoot the first creature and get a free shot at the second.

horde breaker follow-up (melee).name: Horde Breaker Follow-Up (Melee)
horde breaker follow-up (melee).description: Follow up on your horde breaker with a second attack.

horde breaker follow-up (ranged).name: Horde Breaker Follow-Up (Ranged)
horde breaker follow-up (ranged).description: Follow up on your horde breaker with a second attack.

hordestrike.name: Hordestrike
hordestrike.description: Launch a hammer of spectral force at a creature your minions are attacking.

horrific visage.name: Horrific Visage
horrific visage.description:
Release the Eldritch magic within you to terrify a creature with your twisted powers and regain 2 Sorcery Points.
The creature takes another 1d4 Psychic damage per turn.

hound of ill omen.name: Hound of Ill Omen
hound of ill omen.description: Summon forth a creature of darkness.

howl of the dead.name: Howl of the Dead
howl of the dead.description: Let out a bone-chilling howl that Numbs all nearby creatures.

hunger of hadar.name: Hunger of Hadar
hunger of hadar.description: Creatures within this black sphere are Blinded and take damage at the end of their turn and the start of their turn.

hunter's mark.name: Hunter's Mark
hunter's mark.description: Mark a creature as your quarry to deal an additional 1d6 Weapon damage whenever you hit it with a weapon attack.

hurl grease.name: Hurl Grease
hurl grease.description: Fling a hunk of nose-wrenching grease.

hush you!.name: Hush You!
hush you!.description: Slash a target and possibly Silence it.

hypnotic gaze.name: Hypnotic Gaze
hypnotic gaze.description: Charm and Incapacitates a creature. It cannot attack you. It cannot act.

hypnotic pattern.name: Hypnotic Pattern
hypnotic pattern.description: Hypnotise creatures that can see the pattern. They cannot attack you. They cannot move nor act.

ice breath.name: Ice Breath
ice breath.description: Exhale a cone of ice to damage foes.

ice knife.name: Ice Knife
ice knife.description: Throw a shard of ice that deals 1d10 Piercing damage. It explodes and deals 2d6 Cold damage to anyone nearby. It leaves an Ice surface. On miss, the shard of ice still explodes.

ice storm.name: Ice Storm
ice storm.description: Impel a storm of hail and ice to crash from the sky, covering the ground and striking all objects and creatures within range, dealing Bludgeoning and Cold damage. It also creates an Ice surface that lasts 2 turns.

icy regurgitation.name: Icy Regurgitation
icy regurgitation.description: A sip from the Brewer's special booze causes him to vomit ice that can Chill those it hits.

igniting spark.name: Igniting Spark
igniting spark.description: Launch a mote of infernal flame to set a target alight and Burn it.

illuminating shot.name: Illuminating Shot
illuminating shot.description: Fire a shimmering bolt that inflicts 1 turn of Radiating Orb upon the target.

illusory copy.name: Illusory Copy
illusory copy.description: Create an illusory displacer beast to attack nearby enemies.

immolating gaze.name: Immolating Gaze
immolating gaze.description: Sear and Frighten a target with nothing but your glower.

improvised melee weapon.name: Improvised Melee Weapon
improvised melee weapon.description: Pick up an item or creature and use it to make a melee attack.

incinerate.name: Incinerate
incinerate.description: Spend 2 souls to wreath a target in malevolent flame.

incineration caster: overheat.name: Incineration Caster: Overheat
incineration caster: overheat.description: Malfunction, exploding outwards in a fiery mess.

incise ligaments.name: Incise Ligaments
incise ligaments.description: Grind your saw's blackest teeth into an enemy's calves and possibly Slow them.

inciting howl.name: Inciting Howl
inciting howl.description: Each ally within earshot can move an additional 3 m / 10 ft during their next turn.

incongruent splash.name: Incongruent Splash
incongruent splash.description: Splash fiery water from the Infinite Cup upon your foe.

incubate death.name: Incubate Death
incubate death.description: Spawn a skeletal involucre. After 1 turn, the involucre explodes, dealing 3d8 Necrotic damage and birthing a necromite.

infectious bite.name: Infectious Bite
infectious bite.description: Bite a creature and Infect it.

infernal dagger.name: Infernal Dagger
infernal dagger.description: Strike a fiendish blow that might Poison the target and deal an additional 4d10 Poison damage.

infernal legacy: hellish rebuke.name: Infernal Legacy: Hellish Rebuke
infernal legacy: hellish rebuke.description: React to your next attacker with flames that deal 3d10 Fire damage.

infernal salve.name: Infernal Salve
infernal salve.description: Spend 1 soul to heal a Fiend.

infiltration expertise.name: Infiltration Expertise
infiltration expertise.description: Adopt a new identity, changing your appearance.

inflict wounds.name: Inflict Wounds
inflict wounds.description: Putrefy a creature with Necrotic energy filling your hands.

initiate collar detonation.name: Initiate Collar Detonation
initiate collar detonation.description: After the countdown is over, all Gondians will suffer a terrible fate.

inject nostrum.name: Inject Nostrum
inject nostrum.description: Inject an enemy with the mysterious liquid in your syringe and possibly Poison them.

inkblot.name: Inkblot
inkblot.description: Create a cloud of magical darkness and immediately attempt to hide.

insect plague.name: Insect Plague
insect plague.description: Locusts attack everyone within range, make the area Difficult Terrain, and impose Disadvantage on Perception Checks.

inspect moonlantern.name: Inspect Moonlantern
inspect moonlantern.description: Looks like there is something inside the lantern. Inspect it closely.

inspiring leader.name: Inspiring Leader
inspiring leader.description: Extemporise a rousing speech, granting you and your allies Level + Charisma Modifier temporary hit points.

intimidating presence.name: Intimidating Presence
intimidating presence.description: Menace an enemy and instil a terrible Fear within them.

intoxicating strike.name: Intoxicating Strike
intoxicating strike.description: Hit a creature with your bare fists and possibly get them Drunk .

invigorating flame.name: Invigorating Flame
invigorating flame.description: Ignite the corpses of nearby grease elementals with revitalising flame, resurrecting them as lava elementals to fight beside you.

invisibility.name: Invisibility
invisibility.description: Manipulate the currents of the air to make yourself undetectable.

invisible passage.name: Invisible Passage
invisible passage.description: Become Invisible. The spell ends if you attack, take an action, or take damage.

invocation of eternal debt.name: Invocation of Eternal Debt
invocation of eternal debt.description: Spend 1 soul to summon an Eternal Debtor to your side.

invoke duplicity.name: Invoke Duplicity
invoke duplicity.description: Distract your enemies with an illusion. Within 3 m (10 ft), Attack Rolls have Advantage for you and your allies.

invoke the black hand.name: Invoke the Black Hand
invoke the black hand.description: Gortash calls upon Bane's tyrannical aid, gaining 150 temporary hit points along with new strength and powers.

ironbound pursuit.name: Ironbound Pursuit
ironbound pursuit.description: Launch a flying kick that pushes the target back 2 m / 7 ft and knocks it Prone .

ironhand grenadiers.name: Ironhand Grenadiers
ironhand grenadiers.description: Summon the Ironhand Gnomes to damage and debilitate with thrown grenades.

jealous avarice.name: Jealous Avarice
jealous avarice.description: Seizing on greed, the toll collector damages a character based on how much gold they're carrying.

joyous trumpet.name: Joyous Trumpet
joyous trumpet.description: Blow air from your trunk, causing no damage at all but making a trumpet sound. Toot!

jugular strike.name: Jugular Strike
jugular strike.description: Lunge at a creature's throat. If the target is Prone, you deal an additional 2d6 + Strength or Dexterity modifier Piercing damage.

jump.name: Jump
jump.description:
Jump to a destination.
Your Strength affects how far you can jump.

karsite grip.name: Karsite Grip
karsite grip.description: Crush a creature's being with pure Netherese energy that can fork across to three other targets within 8m.

karsus' compulsion.name: Karsus' Compulsion
karsus' compulsion.description:
Channel the stones' magic to control the Crown of Karsus and dominate the Netherbrain.
The caster must channel this spell until their next turn for it to take effect.

keeper's fee.name: Keeper's Fee
keeper's fee.description: Magically snatch a weapon from the target's hand.

kereska's favour.name: Kereska's Favour
kereska's favour.description: Imbue yourself with elemental energy sourced from the draconic goddess, Kereska.

khalid's gift: aid.name: Khalid's Gift: Aid
khalid's gift: aid.description: Heal yourself and increase your hit point maximum by 10 hit points.

ki resonation: blast.name: Ki Resonation: Blast
