ki resonation: blast.description: Detonate the ki of a creature Resonating with you, hitting the creature and all creatures other than party members and summoned creatures within 5 m / 17 ft of it.

ki resonation: punch.name: Ki Resonation: Punch
ki resonation: punch.description: Hit a creature with your bare fists, making the ki in its body Resonate with yours.

ki resonation: punch (bonus action).name: Ki Resonation: Punch (Bonus Action)
ki resonation: punch (bonus action).description: Hit a creature with your bare fists, making the ki in its body Resonate with yours.

ki restoration.name: Ki Restoration
ki restoration.description: Using the spiritual energy in the amulet, you restore a number of Ki Points equal to your martial arts die. [See Notes]

kick up muck.name: Kick Up Muck
kick up muck.description: Slather a target in mud, Slowing them.

kith'raki inferno.name: Kith'raki Inferno
kith'raki inferno.description: Command the red dragon of Supreme Kith'rak Voss to breathe a wall of fire onto the battlefield.

knock.name: Knock
knock.description: Unlock an object that is held shut by a mundane lock.

knock unconscious.name: Knock Unconscious
knock unconscious.description: Make a non-lethal attack against a creature.

know your enemy.name: Know Your Enemy
know your enemy.description: Observe a creature. You gain Advantage on Attack Rolls against the target for 10 rounds.

knowledge of the ages.name: Knowledge of the Ages
knowledge of the ages.description: Gain Proficiency in all Skills of a chosen Ability.

knowledge of the ages: charisma.name: Knowledge of the Ages: Charisma
knowledge of the ages: charisma.description: Gain Proficiency in Deception , Intimidation , Performance , Persuasion .

knowledge of the ages: dexterity.name: Knowledge of the Ages: Dexterity
knowledge of the ages: dexterity.description: Gain Proficiency in Acrobatics , Sleight of Hand , and Stealth .

knowledge of the ages: intelligence.name: Knowledge of the Ages: Intelligence
knowledge of the ages: intelligence.description: Gain Proficiency in Arcana , History , Investigation , Nature , and Religion .

knowledge of the ages: strength.name: Knowledge of the Ages: Strength
knowledge of the ages: strength.description: Gain Proficiency in all Skills based on Strength.

knowledge of the ages: wisdom.name: Knowledge of the Ages: Wisdom
knowledge of the ages: wisdom.description: Gain Proficiency in all Skills based on Wisdom.

kuo-toa acolytes.name: Kuo-Toa Acolytes
kuo-toa acolytes.description: Call the fishfolk faithful from the Underdark to fight for their god - you.

lacerate.name: Lacerate
lacerate.description: Slash at your target's vital points to make it Bleed.

ladle sweet anguish.name: Ladle Sweet Anguish
ladle sweet anguish.description: The Brewer slams his foes with his enormous ladle.

lance charge.name: Lance Charge
lance charge.description: The coin halberd charges, piercing its foes and pushing them back 2 m / 7 ft.

launch protocol: bola.name: Launch Protocol: Bola
launch protocol: bola.description: Shoot a projectile that possibly Restrains your target.

lay on hands.name: Lay on Hands
lay on hands.description: Use your blessed touch to heal a creature or cure it of all diseases and poisons.

lay on hands: cure.name: Lay on Hands: Cure
lay on hands: cure.description: Imbue your hands with divine power to cure all diseases and poisons affecting a creature.

lay on hands: greater healing.name: Lay on Hands: Greater Healing
lay on hands: greater healing.description: Imbue your hands with divine power to heal an ally.

lay on hands: lesser healing.name: Lay on Hands: Lesser Healing
lay on hands: lesser healing.description: Imbue your hands with divine power to heal an ally.

leadership.name: Leadership
leadership.description:
Bolster nearby allies with a supernatural resolve. Their attacks deal an additional 1d4 Force .
Tactician difficulty:
Bolster nearby allies with Leadership and mark nearby non-believers as the Absolute's Enemy .

leaping static.name: Leaping Static
leaping static.description: Strike an attacker with lightning, dealing 3d8 Lightning . Three more bolts will leap from the target, electrifying as many as three other characters within 6 m (20 ft).

left coin whip.name: Left Coin Whip
left coin whip.description: Whip a target with jingle-jangling fury.

legacy of avernus: branding smite.name: Legacy of Avernus: Branding Smite
legacy of avernus: branding smite.description: Your weapon gleams with astral radiance as you strike and possibly mark your targets with light, preventing it from turning Invisible.

legacy of avernus: searing smite.name: Legacy of Avernus: Searing Smite
legacy of avernus: searing smite.description: Deal an extra 2d6 Fire and set your target on fire: it takes 1d6 Fire every turn.

legacy of cania: burning hands.name: Legacy of Cania: Burning Hands
legacy of cania: burning hands.description: Each flammable target is hit with 4d6 Fire damage.

legacy of cania: flame blade.name: Legacy of Cania: Flame Blade
legacy of cania: flame blade.description: Conjure a flaming Scimitar in your hand for 10 turns that deals 3d6 Fire damage. It sheds a bright light in a 3 m (10 ft) radius and a dim light in a 6 m (20 ft) radius.

legion of bees: mighty knockback.name: Legion of Bees: Mighty Knockback
legion of bees: mighty knockback.description: Use your swarm to push your target back 5 m / 17 ft and knock them Prone.

legion of bees: mighty teleport.name: Legion of Bees: Mighty Teleport
legion of bees: mighty teleport.description: Use your swarm to carry you to a new location within 5 m (17 ft) and gain a temporary +2 bonus to your Armour Class.

legion of bees: teleport.name: Legion of Bees: Teleport
legion of bees: teleport.description: Use your swarm to carry you to a new location.

lesser restoration.name: Lesser Restoration
lesser restoration.description: Cure a creature from Diseased , Poisoned , Paralysis, or Blinded .

let the slaughter begin.name: Let the Slaughter Begin
let the slaughter begin.description: Brand nearby creatures with a sinister mark so that their deaths make you harder to kill.

lethal leech.name: Lethal Leech
lethal leech.description: Suckle a foe with hundreds of piercing teeth, making them Bleed .

life drain.name: Life Drain
life drain.description: Possibly drain a target's hit points by 2d8. The target dies if its hit points are reduced to 0.

light.name: Light
light.description: Infuse an object with an aura of light.

lightning arrow.name: Lightning Arrow
lightning arrow.description: After the arrow hits, smaller bolts snake out from the target towards nearby creatures.

lightning aura.name: Lightning Aura
lightning aura.description: Consume 3 Lightning Charges and release a blast of electricity that damages and Jolts nearby enemies.

lightning blast.name: Lightning Blast
lightning blast.description: Focus the electricity in your veins to strengthen your next spell or cantrip.

lightning bolt.name: Lightning Bolt
lightning bolt.description: Call forth a blast of lightning that hits all creatures in the line of the eruption.

lightning breath.name: Lightning Breath
lightning breath.description: Spew forth a column of lightning.

longstrider.name: Longstrider
longstrider.description: Increase a creature's Movement Speed by 3 m (10 ft).

lorroakan's firestorm.name: Lorroakan's Firestorm
lorroakan's firestorm.description: Lorroakan uses all the arcane might of Ramazith's Tower to call down a fiery barrage.

lovely assistant.name: Lovely Assistant
lovely assistant.description: The Surgeon reanimates the corpse of one of his nurses.

loyal furry friend.name: Loyal Furry Friend
loyal furry friend.description: Mourn the Houndmaster's death and join him in the afterlife.

luminous arrow.name: Luminous Arrow
luminous arrow.description: Shoot a luminous arrow at a target.

lump's command.name: Lump's Command
lump's command.description: Lump designates a new nemesis. Each object thrown at the target by an ogre deals an additional 1d6 Bludgeoning damage.

lunar blessing.name: Lunar Blessing
lunar blessing.description: Surround yourself in a pillar of Selûne's light, inflicting Moonbeam on nearby foes.

lunar bulwark.name: Lunar Bulwark
lunar bulwark.description: Bathe yourself in the shielding magic of Selûne's watchful gaze.

lunar flare.name: Lunar Flare
lunar flare.description: Fire a mote of moonlight that spills roiling Holy Fire in a 2 m (7 ft) radius where it impacts.

lunar mend.name: Lunar Mend
lunar mend.description:
Expend spell slots to regain Hit Points while wild shaped.
You regain 1d8 hit points per spell slot level.

lunar smite.name: Lunar Smite
lunar smite.description: Engulf your weapon in Selûne's light, dealing an additional 1d6 Radiant damage and inflicting Holy Fire on a hit.

lunging bite.name: Lunging Bite
lunging bite.description: Lunge at a target to bite it and possibly knock it Prone.

lupine slash.name: Lupine Slash
lupine slash.description: Strike nearby targets within 3 m / 10 ft using a spectral sword that appears between your jaws.

luring song.name: Luring Song
luring song.description: Charm nearby creatures with a magical melody to Lure them to you.

mage armour.name: Mage Armour
mage armour.description: Surround an unarmoured creature in a protective magical force. Its Armour Class increases to 13 + its Dexterity modifier.

mage hand.name: Mage Hand
mage hand.description: Create a spectral hand that can manipulate and interact with objects.

magic allergy: chaotic offence.name: Magic Allergy: Chaotic Offence
magic allergy: chaotic offence.description: Gain 3 Mirror Images , become Enlarged , and become Hastened all at once.

magic allergy: force explosion.name: Magic Allergy: Force explosion
magic allergy: force explosion.description: Create an explosion that Dazes nearby creatures.

magic allergy: gremishka spawn.name: Magic Allergy: Gremishka Spawn
magic allergy: gremishka spawn.description: Burst into pieces. Two new gremishkas are born from your remains.

magic allergy: ice bloom.name: Magic Allergy: Ice Bloom
magic allergy: ice bloom.description: Create an ice surface and gain Armour of Agathys .

magic awareness.name: Magic Awareness
magic awareness.description: Anyone within range adds a 1d4 bonus to Saving throws.

magic missile.name: Magic Missile
magic missile.description:
Create three darts of magical force, each dealing 1d4 + 1 Force damage to its target.
The darts always hit their target, and can each be targeted individually.

magic weapon.name: Magic Weapon
magic weapon.description: Infuse a weapon with arcane energy. The weapon becomes magical, receiving a +1 bonus to Attack Rolls and Damage Rolls.

maiming pinch.name: Maiming Pinch
maiming pinch.description: Attack a creature's feet and inflict Pinched .

maiming strike.name: Maiming Strike
maiming strike.description: Possibly Maims your target. They can't move.

main hand attack.name: Main Hand Attack
main hand attack.description: Make a melee attack with your equipped weapon.

maintain hypnotic gaze.name: Maintain Hypnotic Gaze
maintain hypnotic gaze.description: Maintain your Hypnotic Gaze to extend its duration.

maintain intimidating presence.name: Maintain Intimidating Presence
maintain intimidating presence.description: Prolong the Fear inflicted on a target by your Intimidating Presence .

malfunctioning shell of resistance.name: Malfunctioning Shell of Resistance
malfunctioning shell of resistance.description: Gortash gains Malfunctioning Shell of Resistance for 1 turn, gaining vulnerability to elemental damage.

mammon's tax.name: Mammon's Tax
mammon's tax.description: Rend the flesh of a greedy creature, dealing 6d6 Slashing damage for every 500 gold it has.

manoeuvring attack (melee).name: Manoeuvring Attack (Melee)
manoeuvring attack (melee).description: Attack an enemy. On a hit, you can use Forced Manoeuvre on an ally, increasing their movement speed.

manoeuvring attack (ranged).name: Manoeuvring Attack (Ranged)
manoeuvring attack (ranged).description: Attack an enemy. On a hit, you can use Forced Manoeuvre on an ally, increasing their movement speed.

mantle of majesty: approach.name: Mantle of Majesty: Approach
mantle of majesty: approach.description:
Command a creature to move towards you on its turn and do nothing else.
Targets that are Charmed automatically fail their Saving Throw.

mantle of majesty: command.name: Mantle of Majesty: Command
mantle of majesty: command.description:
Command a creature to flee, move closer, freeze, drop to the ground or drop its weapon.
Targets that are Charmed automatically fail their Saving Throw.

mantle of majesty: drop.name: Mantle of Majesty: Drop
mantle of majesty: drop.description:
Command a creature to drop its weapon.
Targets that are Charmed automatically fail their Saving Throw.

mantle of majesty: flee.name: Mantle of Majesty: Flee
mantle of majesty: flee.description:
Command a creature to flee from you on its turn and do nothing else.
Targets that are Charmed automatically fail their Saving Throw.

mantle of majesty: grovel.name: Mantle of Majesty: Grovel
mantle of majesty: grovel.description:
Command a creature to fall Prone on its turn and do nothing else.
Targets that are Charmed automatically fail their Saving Throw.

mantle of majesty: halt.name: Mantle of Majesty: Halt
mantle of majesty: halt.description:
Command a creature to halt, preventing it from moving or taking any type of action.
Targets that are Charmed automatically fail their Saving Throw.

mapped terror: betrayal.name: Mapped Terror: Betrayal
mapped terror: betrayal.description: Exploit the target's mapped fear to Frighten it and Dominate one of its allies.

mapped terror: ceremorphosis.name: Mapped Terror: Ceremorphosis
mapped terror: ceremorphosis.description: Exploit the target's mapped fear to make it believe it has undergone ceremorphosis.

mapped terror: darkness.name: Mapped Terror: Darkness
mapped terror: darkness.description: Exploit the target's mapped fear to Frighten it and inflict Blinding Sickness upon it.

mapped terror: disease.name: Mapped Terror: Disease
mapped terror: disease.description: Exploit the target's mapped fear to Frighten it and inflict Flesh Rot upon it.

mapped terror: powerlessness.name: Mapped Terror: Powerlessness
mapped terror: powerlessness.description: Exploit the target's mapped fear to Frighten it and Rot its flesh.

mapped terror: spiders.name: Mapped Terror: Spiders
mapped terror: spiders.description: Exploit one of the target's deepest fears by transforming your followers into spiders.

mapped terror: wolves.name: Mapped Terror: Wolves
mapped terror: wolves.description: Exploit one of the target's deepest fears by transforming your followers into a pack of wolves.

mark of putrefaction.name: Mark of Putrefaction
mark of putrefaction.description: Mark a target to make it Vulnerable to Necrotic damage.

martial exertion.name: Martial Exertion
martial exertion.description: Push past your physical limits, taking 6d6 Piercing damage to gain an additional attack per turn and to double your movement speed.

mass cure wounds.name: Mass Cure Wounds
mass cure wounds.description: Unleash a soothing hum of energy that heals you and nearby allies.

matriarch's call.name: Matriarch's Call
matriarch's call.description: The spider matriarch calls on her brood, causing her nearby eggs to hatch.

maul blow.name: Maul Blow
maul blow.description: Smash into a target with your mighty head.

melf's acid arrow.name: Melf's Acid Arrow
melf's acid arrow.description:
Shoot a green arrow that bursts in a spray of acid. Deals 4d4 Acid damage immediately and 2d4 Acid damage at the end of the target's next turn.
If the spell misses, the target still takes half the initial damage, but no damage at the end of its next turn.

mellow harmony.name: Mellow Harmony
mellow harmony.description: You make a DC 15 Performance Check, success granting all your melee weapon attacks additional damage equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1 additional damage).

menacing attack (melee).name: Menacing Attack (Melee)
menacing attack (melee).description: Possibly Frighten your target. They'll have Disadvantage on ability checks and Attack Rolls and be unable to move.

menacing attack (ranged).name: Menacing Attack (Ranged)
menacing attack (ranged).description: Possibly Frightens your target. They'll have Disadvantage on Ability Checks and Attack Rolls and they cannot move.

menacing howl.name: Menacing Howl
menacing howl.description: Unleash a bellowing roar that can Menace nearby foes.

mental instruction.name: Mental Instruction
mental instruction.description: Give one of your students telepathic instructions to psionically empower them.

mental mark.name: Mental Mark
mental mark.description: Make a ranged attack with your equipped weapon.

meow.name: Meow
meow.description: Attract the attention of nearby creatures to draw them closer to you.

merciless crush.name: Merciless Crush
merciless crush.description: Crush a foe and make them Prone , unless they make a successful Dexterity save, which also halves the damage.

mighty impel.name: Mighty Impel
mighty impel.description: Throw a creature or object that is Medium-sized or smaller.

mind blast.name: Mind Blast
mind blast.description: Spew forth a conical wave of psychic energy and possibly Stun targets within.

mind flayer domination.name: Mind Flayer Domination
mind flayer domination.description:
Dominate a nearby humanoid. Allies are unaffected.
Each time the dominated creature takes damage, it may repeat the Saving throw against your domination.

mind flayer reinforcements.name: Mind Flayer Reinforcements
mind flayer reinforcements.description: A pod containing a mind flayer plummets from the nautiloid. It creates a blast in a 2m radius, spawning one mind flayer and two intellect devourers.

mind mastery.name: Mind Mastery
mind mastery.description: Cause an enemy to make a weapon attack against one of its allies.

mind sanctuary.name: Mind Sanctuary
mind sanctuary.description: Sculpt a magical nexus that allows those within to take actions and bonus actions interchangeably.

mind screech.name: Mind Screech
mind screech.description: Wrench at a foe's soul and inflict Confusion .

mind spike.name: Mind Spike
mind spike.description: Reach into an enemy's mind and impose Disadvantage on Wisdom Saving throws.

mind tax.name: Mind Tax
mind tax.description: Cleave into a Charmed or Frightened foe's brain tissue and invigorate your body.

mind-claw of tu'narath.name: Mind-Claw of Tu'narath
mind-claw of tu'narath.description: Summon a vestigial echo of Vlaakith's ire as a wicked psionic blade.

mindbreak.name: Mindbreak
mindbreak.description: Slice at a foe's psyche, allowing Inquisitor W'wargaz to possibly Mindsteal Link with the target if they are not already affected.

mindsteal link.name: Mindsteal Link
mindsteal link.description: Leech off a foe's psychic energy to make them more vulnerable and strengthen yourself.

mindsteal tempest.name: Mindsteal Tempest
mindsteal tempest.description: Force a psychic connection on those around you. Use Mindsteal Link on all nearby creatures.

minor conjuration: create water.name: Minor Conjuration: Create Water
minor conjuration: create water.description: Call forth rain. It extinguishes exposed flames and forms a Water surface.

minor illusion.name: Minor Illusion
minor illusion.description: Create an illusion that compels nearby creatures to investigate.

mirror image.name: Mirror Image
mirror image.description: Create 3 illusory duplicates of yourself to distract attackers. Each duplicate increases your Armour Class by 3.

mist stance.name: Mist Stance
mist stance.description: Transform into a tiny gas cloud. It can't fall, and fits through small openings. It is very hard to damage.

misty step.name: Misty Step
misty step.description: Surrounded by silver mist, you teleport to an unoccupied space you can see.

mizora, agent of avernus.name: Mizora, Agent of Avernus
mizora, agent of avernus.description: Summon Wyll's pactmistress to rain down powerful infernal sorcery and possibly Disintegrate your foes.

moan.name: Moan
moan.description: Produce a piercing moan and Frighten nearby creatures.

mobile flourish (melee).name: Mobile Flourish (Melee)
mobile flourish (melee).description: Thrust your weapon with enough force to push your target back 6 m / 20 ft. Afterwards, you can Teleport to the target.

mobile flourish (ranged).name: Mobile Flourish (Ranged)
mobile flourish (ranged).description: Thrust your weapon with enough force to push your target back 6 m / 20 ft. Afterwards, you can Teleport to the target.

mobile flourish: teleport.name: Mobile Flourish: Teleport
mobile flourish: teleport.description: Teleport to the target you hit with your Mobile Flourish ( Melee or Ranged ).

mobile shot.name: Mobile Shot
mobile shot.description: After using Dash or Disengage this turn, you can make a ranged attack as a bonus action.

moonbeam.name: Moonbeam
moonbeam.description: Call down a beam of light that damages any creatures that enters the beam or starts its turn in the light. You can use an Action to move the beam 18 m (60 ft).

moonlight butterflies.name: Moonlight Butterflies
moonlight butterflies.description: Strike a foe, conjuring an illusory swarm of moon-pale butterflies and gaining Advantage on attacks against the target.

moonmote.name: Moonmote
moonmote.description: Illuminate the area around you with wisps of moonish light that make movement difficult for enemies and bolster your allies' damage.

moral confinement.name: Moral Confinement
moral confinement.description: Unleash a roar that wounds and Silences nearby foes.

morphic brine explosion.name: Morphic Brine Explosion
morphic brine explosion.description: Shower nearby creatures in morphic brine that deals damage and coats surfaces.

mortal uncoiling.name: Mortal Uncoiling
mortal uncoiling.description: Turn an Undead entity against its master until combat ends. When the effect ends, the entity is destroyed.

move moonbeam.name: Move Moonbeam
move moonbeam.description: Move the beam of moonlight up to 18 m / 60 ft. The beam of light damages any creature that enters the beam or starts its turn in the light.

muck to metal.name: Muck to Metal
muck to metal.description: Harden your slippery body into a substance like steel, increasing your Armour Class by 2.

mud breath.name: Mud Breath
mud breath.description: Belch viscid mud at a foe to Restrain it.

multiattack (shadow druid).name: Multiattack (Shadow Druid)
multiattack (shadow druid).description: Make an additional ranged attack with your equipped weapon.

mummy's lullaby.name: Mummy's Lullaby
mummy's lullaby.description: Mummy sings a soothing lullaby that puts creatures up to a combined 120 hit points into a magical slumber.

murderous cloud of daggers.name: Murderous Cloud of Daggers
murderous cloud of daggers.description: Conjure a cloud of spinning daggers that attack anyone inside.

murderous retort.name: Murderous Retort
murderous retort.description: Immediately strike back at an attacker. If Deathbringer's Legacy is active, use Deathbringer's Assault instead.

myrmidon's immolation.name: Myrmidon's Immolation
myrmidon's immolation.description: Ignite with incandescent, primordial flames that Hasten you.

mystic carrion's vile curse.name: Mystic Carrion's Vile Curse
mystic carrion's vile curse.description: Bestow Mystic Carrion's Poisoned Curse on a foe.

narcoleptic burst.name: Narcoleptic Burst
narcoleptic burst.description: Explode upon death, releasing toxins that put nearby creatures to Sleep.

natural recovery.name: Natural Recovery
natural recovery.description: Replenish expended Spell Slots while out of combat.

nature's wrath.name: Nature's Wrath
nature's wrath.description: Invoke primaeval forces to restrain an enemy.

nautiloid airstrike.name: Nautiloid Airstrike
nautiloid airstrike.description: A devastating airstrike from the illithid nautiloid in a 5m radius.

nebulous black hole.name: Nebulous Black Hole
nebulous black hole.description: Create a point of intense gravity that pulls in all nearby enemies and possibly Slows them.

needles.name: Needles
needles.description: Expel the needles from your body towards a creature.

needlestorm.name: Needlestorm
needlestorm.description: The Giant Shadow Vine shoots shadow needles from the hole in its bark.

net.name: Net
net.description: Throw a net to Ensnare your target.

netherese orb blast.name: Netherese Orb Blast
netherese orb blast.description: Gale triggers the Netherese Orb in his chest, destroying everything and everyone in a wide radius.

nightbringer's shadow adepts.name: Nightbringer's Shadow Adepts
nightbringer's shadow adepts.description: Summon powerful Sharran clerics and their warrior underlings to battle.

nimble escape.name: Nimble Escape
nimble escape.description: Retreat safely: moving won't provoke Opportunity Attacks.

no rest for the wicked.name: No Rest for the Wicked
no rest for the wicked.description: Death is but a temporary inconvenience - raise a fallen undead with half of its hit points.

ochre sputum.name: Ochre Sputum
ochre sputum.description: Spit out an acidic substance and create an Acid surface on impact.

ocular nightmare.name: Ocular Nightmare
ocular nightmare.description: Possibly Wound, Confuse, Paralyse and Frighten all foes within 20 m (67 ft) with your flailing Eye Rays.

off-hand attack (melee).name: Off-Hand Attack (Melee)
off-hand attack (melee).description: Make a melee attack with your off-hand weapon.

off-hand attack (ranged).name: Off-Hand Attack (Ranged)
off-hand attack (ranged).description: Make a ranged attack with your off-hand weapon.

ominous bite.name: Ominous Bite
ominous bite.description: Bite a target and possibly place an Omen on them.

on black wings.name: On Black Wings
on black wings.description: Summons two ravens allied to you. You cannot control the ravens.

open wounds.name: Open Wounds
open wounds.description: Rend a creature's flesh and make them Bleed .

orb of negation.name: Orb of Negation
orb of negation.description: The Grand Design cannot be disrupted - manifest an orb of Netherese arcana that explodes on its turn, obliterating everything within range.

otiluke's conveniently portable freezing.name: Otiluke's Conveniently Portable Freezing Sphere
otiluke's conveniently portable freezing.description: Create a vessel for Otiluke's Freezing Sphere . Put it in your pocket, give it to an ally, or throw it away. It will explode after 10 turn(s).

otiluke's freezing sphere.name: Otiluke's Freezing Sphere
otiluke's freezing sphere.description: Create a ball of churning ice that can be launched instantly to generate a frosty explosion or stored for later use.

otiluke's resilient sphere.name: Otiluke's Resilient Sphere
otiluke's resilient sphere.description: Enclose a target in a sphere of shimmering force, reducing its movement speed by half, and blocking all incoming and spell effects.

otto's irresistible dance.name: Otto's Irresistible Dance
otto's irresistible dance.description: Cause a creature to start dancing, making it unable to take Actions or Move. Its attackers have Advantage on Attack rolls.

overflowing brew.name: Overflowing Brew
overflowing brew.description: Thisobald's unstable brew overflows, dealing 6d6 damage of the corresponding damage type to surrounding enemies and empowering his allies.

overheat.name: Overheat
overheat.description: Release a fraction of your inner fire. All nearby creatures take damage and start Burning Fiercely.

overwhelming grief.name: Overwhelming Grief
overwhelming grief.description: The Justiciar strikes at their foe's brain with pure malice, inflicting Call of the Dark Lady

owl's wisdom.name: Owl's Wisdom
owl's wisdom.description: Creature gains Advantage on Wisdom Checks.

pacifying spores.name: Pacifying Spores
pacifying spores.description: Pacify a creature. It can't move or take actions, bonus actions, or reactions.

panache.name: Panache
panache.description: Roll a Persuasion check to beguile a humanoid, who must contest it with an Insight check. Enemies who fail gain Panache: Disadvantage; others who fail become Charmed.

paralysing ray.name: Paralysing Ray
paralysing ray.description: Shoot an eye ray that Paralyses its target.

part the flesh.name: Part the Flesh
part the flesh.description: Thrust forward with diabolical precision, possibly stymying your target's ability to heal.

pass without trace.name: Pass Without Trace
pass without trace.description: Call forth a veil of shadow and silence that gives you and nearby allies a +10 bonus to Stealth Checks.

patient defence.name: Patient Defence
patient defence.description: Attack Rolls against you have Disadvantage, and you have Advantage on Dexterity Saving Throws.

pearlescent restoration.name: Pearlescent Restoration
pearlescent restoration.description: You can replenish expended spell slots of your choice up to third level.

pearlspore outbreak.name: Pearlspore Outbreak
pearlspore outbreak.description: Explode in a poisonous miasma that lingers behind.

perfectly balanced strike.name: Perfectly Balanced Strike
perfectly balanced strike.description: Send Belm snaking out with an adder's speed, the very exemplar of swiftness embodied in steel.

perform 'bard dance'.name: Perform 'Bard Dance'
perform 'bard dance'.description: Play an upbeat foot-tapper to attract and delight those around you.

perform 'of divinity and sin'.name: Perform 'Of Divinity and Sin'
perform 'of divinity and sin'.description: Play a mysterious tune to dazzle and intrigue those around you.

perform 'old time battles'.name: Perform 'Old Time Battles'
perform 'old time battles'.description: Play a rousing battle-chant to attract and delight those around you.

perform 'sing for me'.name: Perform 'Sing for Me'
perform 'sing for me'.description: Play a troubled bard's ballad to encourage and inspire those around you.

perform 'the power'.name: Perform 'The Power'
perform 'the power'.description: Play an enchanting crowd-pleaser to attract and delight those around you.

perform 'the queen's high seas'.name: Perform 'The Queen's High Seas'
perform 'the queen's high seas'.description: Play a jaunty sea shanty to rouse and excite those around you.

perform (drum).name: Perform (Drum)
perform (drum).description: Play a tune to attract and delight those around you.

perform (flute).name: Perform (Flute)
perform (flute).description: Play a tune to attract and delight those around you.

perform (lute).name: Perform (Lute)
perform (lute).description: Play a tune to attract and delight those around you.

perform (lyre).name: Perform (Lyre)
perform (lyre).description: Play an enchanting crowd-pleaser to attract and delight those around you.

perform (violin).name: Perform (Violin)
perform (violin).description: Play a tune to attract and delight those around you.

perform (whistle).name: Perform (Whistle)
perform (whistle).description: Play a tune to attract and delight those around you.

perilous stakes.name: Perilous Stakes
perilous stakes.description: Invest a creature with power that heals it when it attacks, but also makes it Vulnerable to all damage.

permit passage.name: Permit Passage
permit passage.description: The Umbral Tremor has opened, letting through a Dark Justiciar

perturbing visage.name: Perturbing Visage
perturbing visage.description: Accentuate your unnatural form, Unnerving nearby creatures.

petrifying sting.name: Petrifying Sting
petrifying sting.description: Mercilessly sting a foe and possibly inflict Mammon's Hold, turning them temporarily to gold.

phalar aluve: melody.name: Phalar Aluve: Melody
phalar aluve: melody.description: The sword hums in anticipation, ready to Sing or Shriek (see bugs on their respective pages).

phalar aluve: shriek.name: Phalar Aluve: Shriek
phalar aluve: shriek.description:
The sword Shrieks. All enemies within 6 m (20 ft) of range have a 1d4 penalty to all [See: Bugs] Saving Throws. Affected creatures receive an extra 1d4 Thunder DRS damage.
The sword will stop shrieking if unequipped.

phalar aluve: sing.name: Phalar Aluve: Sing
phalar aluve: sing.description:
The sword sings a melody. All allies within 6 m / 20 ft of range have a 1d4 bonus to Attack rolls and Saving throws.
The sword will stop singing if unequipped.

phantasmal force.name: Phantasmal Force
phantasmal force.description: Deal damage to a creature each turn. At the start of its turn, it takes Psychic damage. Each subsequent time it takes damage, the damage type of Phantasmal Force changes to match that damage type.

phantasmal killer.name: Phantasmal Killer
phantasmal killer.description: Haunt a creature with illusions of its greatest fears. It takes 4d10 Psychic Damage per turn, cannot move, has Disadvantage on Ability Checks and Attack Rolls

phantasms.name: Phantasms
phantasms.description: Fill the shadows with three illusory duplicates of yourself that can hurt and Frighten creatures with their haunting Moans .

pierce.name: Pierce
pierce.description: The coin halberd pierces its opponent with gleaming precision.

pierce the weak.name: Pierce the Weak
pierce the weak.description: Make an enemy Vulnerable to Piercing damage.

piercing growl.name: Piercing Growl
piercing growl.description: Fierce howls rise from your guts and wound nearby foes, possibly inflicting Bleeding and Fear .

piercing shot.name: Piercing Shot
piercing shot.description: Deal regular damage and possibly inflict Gaping Wounds which cause extra damage on attacks.

piercing strike.name: Piercing Strike
piercing strike.description: Stab an enemy and possibly inflict Gaping Wounds.

pin down.name: Pin Down
pin down.description: Deal regular damage and reduce target's Movement Speed by 3 m / 10 ft.

planar ally.name: Planar Ally
planar ally.description: Beseech one of these otherworldly entities for aid. Summon either an Elemental, Celestial, or Fiend to fight for you.

planar ally: cambion.name: Planar Ally: Cambion
planar ally: cambion.description: Conjure a Cambion to fight alongside you.

planar ally: deva.name: Planar Ally: Deva
planar ally: deva.description: Conjure a Celestial Deva to fight alongside you. It can cast Wrathful Smite, Revivify, and Concussive Smash.

planar ally: djinni.name: Planar Ally: Djinni
planar ally: djinni.description: Conjure a powerful djinni to fight alongside you. It can cast Sweetplum Gales, Thunderwave, and Drunken Inhale.

planar binding.name: Planar Binding
planar binding.description: Target an otherworldly creature and attach its consciousness to your own. It will follow and fight for you as an ally.

plant growth.name: Plant Growth
plant growth.description: Make weeds burst from the ground and smother the area. Creatures moving through the weeds have their Movement Speed quartered.

play the spider's lyre.name: Play the Spider's Lyre
play the spider's lyre.description: Play a troubled bard's ballad to encourage and inspire those around you.

pluck soul.name: Pluck Soul
pluck soul.description: Pull your warlock's enemy towards you up to 5 m (17 ft).

poison breath.name: Poison Breath
poison breath.description: Spew forth a cone of poison.

poison hallucination.name: Poison Hallucination
poison hallucination.description: Magically inebriated as he is, Thisobald the Brewer is hallucinating poisonous imps into existence.

poison mist.name: Poison Mist
poison mist.description: On a hit, deal extra Poison damage equal to your proficiency bonus and surround the target in a noxious cloud that possibly Poisons those within it.

poison spray.name: Poison Spray
poison spray.description: Project a puff of noxious gas, dealing 1d12 Poison to a target.

polearm clout.name: Polearm Clout
polearm clout.description: Sweep your polearm around, whacking a foe with the weapon's heavy haft.

polma's wrath.name: Polma's Wrath
polma's wrath.description: Increase Strength by 4, while Armour Class is reduced by 2.

polymorph.name: Polymorph
polymorph.description: Transform a creature into a harmless sheep.

polymorph: dire raven.name: Polymorph: Dire Raven
polymorph: dire raven.description: Take the shape of a dire raven that can avoid attention and Blind enemies. It has 13 hit points.

pommel strike.name: Pommel Strike
pommel strike.description: Make a non-lethal attack against an enemy and possibly Daze them.

portent die.name: Portent Die
portent die.description: Change the die of a nearby Attack roll or Saving throw to the portent die.

possession.name: Possession
possession.description: Possess a creature, forcing it to act according to your will and dealing 4d8 Necrotic damage to it every turn.

potent concentrated blast.name: Potent Concentrated Blast
potent concentrated blast.description: Blast a creature with sapping psychic energy. If the target was concentrating on a spell, you heal equal to the damage dealt.

potent misty escape.name: Potent Misty Escape
potent misty escape.description:
Transform into a tiny mist cloud. It can't fall, and fits through small openings. It is very hard to damage. Foes within 4 m (13 ft) of the cloud may be Blinded and take 3d6 Necrotic at the start of Cazador's turn.
The cloud has Advantage on Constitution, Dexterity, and Strength Saving Throws.

pounce.name: Pounce
pounce.description: Leap at a target to bite it and potentially knock it Prone .

power word kill.name: Power Word Kill
power word kill.description: Compel an enemy with 100 Hit Points or fewer to die instantly. Limited to one use only.

power word: ruin.name: Power Word: Ruin
power word: ruin.description: Speak a word of disaster into the Galerian Weave, calling forth three beams of pure destruction that each deal 10d6+40 Force damage.

prayer of healing.name: Prayer of Healing
prayer of healing.description: Heal all allies you can see within range.

precision attack.name: Precision Attack
precision attack.description: You can spend a Superiority Die to add it to the result to an Attack roll .

prepare.name: Prepare
prepare.description: Spend 6 m (20 ft) of your movement to deal an additional Strength modifier Physical DRS damage (minimum 1) on each successful melee weapon attack for the rest of the turn.

preserve life.name: Preserve Life
preserve life.description: Evoke a healing energy that restores 3 × Character level Hit Points to allied creatures.

press the advantage.name: Press the Advantage
press the advantage.description: After scoring a critical hit, use your Bonus Action to make an additional attack.

primal stampede.name: Primal Stampede
primal stampede.description: Charge forward, attacking all enemies in the way and possibly knocking them Prone.

primordial gales.name: Primordial Gales
primordial gales.description: Gales of cackling stormy wind swirl around you, battering at nearby creatures and Shocking them.

produce flame.name: Produce Flame
produce flame.description: A flame in your hand sheds a light in a 9 m (30 ft) radius and deals 1d8 Fire damage when thrown.

produce flame: dismiss.name: Produce Flame: Dismiss
produce flame: dismiss.description: Put out the conjured flame in your hand.

produce flame: hurl.name: Produce Flame: Hurl
produce flame: hurl.description: Hurl the conjured flame in your hand at a target and let it sizzle out.

profane scourge.name: Profane Scourge
profane scourge.description: Strike with subjugating fury, adding your proficiency bonus to the damage roll. If you hit a fiend or undead creature, deal an additional 2d6 Slashing DRS damage and possibly Bane it.

promise of wealth.name: Promise of Wealth
promise of wealth.description: Mark a target with Promise of Wealth . Your Allies with Infectious Greed gain Advantage on Attack rolls against it, convinced it carries great wealth.

protection from energy.name: Protection from Energy
protection from energy.description: Touch a creature to grant it Resistance to Acid , Cold , Fire , Lightning , or Thunder damage.

protection from energy: acid.name: Protection from Energy: Acid
protection from energy: acid.description: Touch a creature to grant it Resistance to Acid damage.

protection from energy: cold.name: Protection from Energy: Cold
protection from energy: cold.description: Touch a creature to grant it Resistance to Cold damage.

protection from energy: fire.name: Protection from Energy: Fire
protection from energy: fire.description: Touch a creature to grant it Resistance to Fire damage.

protection from energy: lightning.name: Protection from Energy: Lightning
protection from energy: lightning.description: Touch a creature to grant it Resistance to Lightning damage.

protection from energy: thunder.name: Protection from Energy: Thunder
protection from energy: thunder.description: Touch a creature to grant it Resistance to Thunder damage.

protection from evil and good.name: Protection from Evil and Good
protection from evil and good.description: Protect an ally against the attacks and powers of Aberrations, Celestials, Elementals, Fey, Fiends, and Undead.

protection from missiles.name: Protection from Missiles
protection from missiles.description: Amplify your reflexes to better contend with incoming missiles. Ranged weapon attacks against you have Disadvantage, and their damage is halved.

protection from poison.name: Protection from Poison
protection from poison.description: Touch a creature to neutralise all poisons affecting it, and grant it protection against poisonous influences.

prowl.name: Prowl
prowl.description: Turn Invisible while stalking your prey. While Invisible, your first attack deals an additional 1d8 damage.

pseudopod.name: Pseudopod
pseudopod.description: Lash out with a slimy grey tentacle.

pseudopod lash.name: Pseudopod Lash
pseudopod lash.description: Lash out with a tongue-like appendage to reduce the target's Armour Class by 2 and pull it 6 m / 20 ft closer.

psionic overload.name: Psionic Overload
psionic overload.description: Your attacks deal an additional 1d4 Psychic damage, but you take 1d4 Psychic damage every turn.

psionic pull.name: Psionic Pull
psionic pull.description: Pull one creature or object towards you.

psionic suggestion: drop.name: Psionic Suggestion: Drop
psionic suggestion: drop.description: Command a creature to drop its weapon on its turn and do nothing else.

psionic suggestion: flee.name: Psionic Suggestion: Flee
psionic suggestion: flee.description: Command a creature to flee from you on its turn and do nothing else.

psionic suggestion: grovel.name: Psionic Suggestion: Grovel
psionic suggestion: grovel.description: Command a creature to fall Prone immediately and do nothing else.

psionic suggestion: halt.name: Psionic Suggestion: Halt
psionic suggestion: halt.description: Command a creature to fall Prone on its turn and do nothing else.

psionic suggestion: hush.name: Psionic Suggestion: Hush
psionic suggestion: hush.description: Silence a creature with a psionic command.

psionic visage.name: Psionic Visage
psionic visage.description: Summon 3 psychic copies of yourself to protect you. As long as one of those copies remain, you are immune to Bludgeoning , Piercing , and Slashing damage.

psychic rend.name: Psychic Rend
psychic rend.description: Reach into an enemy's mind. Tear it to pieces and inflict Disadvantage on Intelligence and Wisdom Checks and Saving Throws.

psychic resonance.name: Psychic Resonance
psychic resonance.description: As its allies draw near, the creature informs them of its exact location.

psychic scream.name: Psychic Scream
psychic scream.description: The creature cries out in alarm to alert its allies.

pulling web.name: Pulling Web
pulling web.description: Strike at a creature with a gossamer, skin-adhering web and pull it 3 m / 10 ft closer to you.

punish divinity.name: Punish Divinity
punish divinity.description: After taking Radiant damage, Stun the attacker, allowing you to Drain its hit points.

pushing attack (melee).name: Pushing Attack (Melee)
pushing attack (melee).description: Spend a superiority die to deal an additional 1d8 Physical damage and possibly push the target back 4.5 m / 15 ft.

pushing attack (ranged).name: Pushing Attack (Ranged)
pushing attack (ranged).description: Spend a superiority die to deal an additional 1d8 Physical damage and possibly push the target back 4.5 m (15 ft).

quake.name: Quake
quake.description: Stomp the ground to cause a massive shockwave and knock nearby creatures Prone.

radiance of the dawn.name: Radiance of the Dawn
radiance of the dawn.description: The sun's divine power dispels any magical darkness.

radiant shockwave.name: Radiant Shockwave
radiant shockwave.description: Inflict Radiating Orb in a 3 m (10 ft) radius.

rage.name: Rage
rage.description: Deal 2 extra damage with melee and improvised weapons, and throwing.

rage: bear heart.name: Rage: Bear Heart
rage: bear heart.description: Enter a Rage that makes you tough enough to stand up to any punishment.

rage: eagle heart.name: Rage: Eagle Heart
rage: eagle heart.description: Enter a Rage that makes you near untouchable.

rage: elk heart.name: Rage: Elk Heart
rage: elk heart.description: Enter a Rage that grants you extraordinary swiftness.

rage: tiger heart.name: Rage: Tiger Heart
rage: tiger heart.description: Enter a Rage that empowers your leaps.

rage: wild magic.name: Rage: Wild Magic
rage: wild magic.description: Enter a Rage that releases all the magic roiling inside you, causing a random magical effect.

rage: wolf heart.name: Rage: Wolf Heart
rage: wolf heart.description: Enter a Rage so inciting it spurs on you allies.

raging vortex.name: Raging Vortex
raging vortex.description: Spiral the wind into a choking maelstrom that inflicts 2d8 Bludgeoning damage per turn and Silences creatures.

rakish sneak attack (melee).name: Rakish Sneak Attack (Melee)
rakish sneak attack (melee).description: Deal extra damage to a foe you have Advantage against. You can also use this attack without Advantage if there are no other combatants within 2 m (7 ft) of the target, or if you have an ally within that range.

rakish sneak attack (ranged).name: Rakish Sneak Attack (Ranged)
rakish sneak attack (ranged).description: Deal extra damage to a foe you have Advantage against. You can also use this attack without Advantage if there are no other combatants within 2 m / 7 ft of the target, or if you have an ally within that range.

rally.name: Rally
rally.description: Expend a superiority die to bolster the resolve of a friendly creature. It gains an additional 8 temporary hit points.

ram.name: Ram
ram.description: Slam into an enemy creature or object. On a successful save, the target still takes half damage.

ranged attack.name: Ranged Attack
ranged attack.description: Make a ranged attack with your equipped weapon.

ranger's companion.name: Ranger's Companion
ranger's companion.description: Gain a beast companion that accompanies you on your adventures and fights alongside you.

ravaging inferno.name: Ravaging Inferno
ravaging inferno.description: Spend 2 souls to hurl an exploding ball of Hellfire that damages all nearby creatures and objects.

ray of enfeeblement.name: Ray of Enfeeblement
ray of enfeeblement.description: Weaken a foe: they deal half damage with weapon attacks using Strength.

ray of frost.name: Ray of Frost
ray of frost.description: Reduces the target's Movement Speed by 3 m (10 ft).

rays of fire.name: Rays of Fire
rays of fire.description: Hurl 3 rays of fire. Each ray deals 3d6 Fire damage.

razor claw.name: Razor Claw
razor claw.description: Clamp your pincers upon a foe and possibly inflict Bleeding .

razor gale.name: Razor Gale
razor gale.description: Swing your weapon in a cyclone of steel that deals razorblade-sharp damage to all enemies within range.

reach from beyond.name: Reach from Beyond
reach from beyond.description: Defile a target with Myrkul's decaying magic.

read thoughts.name: Read Thoughts
read thoughts.description: Read the thoughts of certain creatures while talking to them.

reap soul.name: Reap Soul
reap soul.description: Unsheathe a set of hexed sickles and rip your warlock's enemy to shreds.

reaper's scythe.name: Reaper's Scythe
reaper's scythe.description: Swing your weapon in a large arc that knocks targets back 4 m / 13 ft.

reapply hex.name: Reapply Hex
reapply hex.description: Curse a new creature without expending an extra Spell Slot.

reapply hex (charisma).name: Reapply Hex (Charisma)
reapply hex (charisma).description: Deal an additional 1d6 Necrotic damage when you attack the target and impart Disadvantage on Charisma Checks.

reapply hex (constitution).name: Reapply Hex (Constitution)
reapply hex (constitution).description: Deal an additional 1d6 Necrotic damage when you attack the target and impart Disadvantage on Constitution Checks.

reapply hex (dexterity).name: Reapply Hex (Dexterity)
reapply hex (dexterity).description: Deal an additional 1d6 Necrotic damage when you attack the target and impart Disadvantage on Dexterity Checks.

reapply hex (intelligence).name: Reapply Hex (Intelligence)
reapply hex (intelligence).description: Deal an additional 1d6 Necrotic damage when you attack the target and impart Disadvantage on Intelligence Checks.

reapply hex (strength).name: Reapply Hex (Strength)
reapply hex (strength).description: Deal an additional 1d6 Necrotic damage when you attack the target and impart Disadvantage on Strength Checks.

reapply hex (wisdom).name: Reapply Hex (Wisdom)
reapply hex (wisdom).description: Deal an additional 1d6 Necrotic damage when you attack the target and impart Disadvantage on Wisdom Checks.

reapply hunter's mark.name: Reapply Hunter's Mark
reapply hunter's mark.description: Shift your Hunter's Mark to a new creature without using a Spell Slot.

recast dazzling ray.name: Recast Dazzling Ray
recast dazzling ray.description: Unleash a beam of brilliant light that Blinds all creatures in its path.

recast speak with dead.name: Recast Speak with Dead
recast speak with dead.description: Cast Speak with Dead on a different corpse without expending a spell slot.

recast sunbeam.name: Recast Sunbeam
recast sunbeam.description: Call forth another beam of light that sears and Blinds all creatures in its path, without expending a spell slot.

reckless attack.name: Reckless Attack
reckless attack.description:
Throw all caution in the wind to gain Advantage on your melee Attack Roll.
Until your next turn, you have advantage on attack rolls, but enemies also have advantage on attack rolls against you.

reckless roar.name: Reckless Roar
reckless roar.description: Gain Advantage on Attack Rolls. Attackers also gain Advantage on Attack Rolls against you.

reckless warcry.name: Reckless Warcry
reckless warcry.description: Increase your Strength by 3, at the cost of decreasing your Armour Class by 1.

reduce.name: Reduce
reduce.description:
Make a creature smaller.
Its weapons deal 1d4 less damage (minimum of 1 damage). It has Disadvantage on Strength Checks and Saving throws.

reflective mucus.name: Reflective Mucus
reflective mucus.description: Increases Armour Class by 2, and reflects the first projectile flying towards it back at the attacker, after which the mucus is removed.

reflective shell.name: Reflective Shell
reflective shell.description: A protective shell envelops you. It reflects any projectiles targeted at you back to their point of origin.

regain hit points.name: Regain Hit Points
regain hit points.description: Fully restore hit points and spell slots outside of combat.

relentless lunge.name: Relentless Lunge
relentless lunge.description: Leap sinuously and smash into your foes, possibly knocking them Prone .

remove curse.name: Remove Curse
remove curse.description: Touch a creature or object to remove all Curses and Hexes affecting it.

rend vision.name: Rend Vision
rend vision.description: Attack a creature's eyes and Blind it.

repelling protocol.name: Repelling Protocol
repelling protocol.description: Expel a wave of force to push assailants back 8 m (27 ft) and knock them Prone.

reposition malefactor.name: Reposition Malefactor
reposition malefactor.description: Pulls the creature 9 m / 30 ft closer to you.

reprimand.name: Reprimand
reprimand.description: A pacifying strike that knocks the target Prone .

repulsor.name: Repulsor
repulsor.description: Unleash the Absolute's power to harm and push anything and anyone back 6 m / 20 ft.

repulsor (illithid power).name: Repulsor (Illithid Power)
repulsor (illithid power).description: Push anything and anyone back 6 m / 20 ft.

request surgical instrument.name: Request Surgical Instrument
request surgical instrument.description: Request a tool for advanced surgery.

resistance.name: Resistance
resistance.description: Make a target more resistant to spell effects and conditions: it receives a +1d4 bonus to Saving Throws.

restore bardic inspiration.name: Restore Bardic Inspiration
restore bardic inspiration.description: Play your instrument to restore one of your Bardic Inspiration slots.

restore soul.name: Restore Soul
restore soul.description: Overcome your Soul Wrenched state by reclaiming your soul from Raphael or a Soul Pillar

restore vitality.name: Restore Vitality
restore vitality.description: Use a bonus action to heal yourself or a nearby ally.

retinue of the vampire lord.name: Retinue of the Vampire Lord
retinue of the vampire lord.description: Summon an undead horde to overwhelm a section of the battlefield.

retributive brainquake.name: Retributive Brainquake
retributive brainquake.description: Upon first time that you take damage in a turn, emit a wave of psionic force that Mindbreaks nearby enemies.

revitalising strike.name: Revitalising Strike
revitalising strike.description: Smash into a foe, wounding them and healing your own injuries.

revivify.name: Revivify
revivify.description: Revive a companion. They return to life with 1 hit point.

revoke guest status.name: Revoke Guest Status
revoke guest status.description: Hope banishes one of the unwelcome guests from her house forever.

ride the winds.name: Ride the Winds
ride the winds.description: Transform into a cloud, becoming Resistant to all damage, gains Advantage on Constitution, Dexterity, and Strength Saving Throws, and becomes Tiny in size.

right behind you.name: Right Behind You
right behind you.description: Materialise next to your summoner's victim.

right coin whip.name: Right Coin Whip
right coin whip.description: Whip a target with jingle-jangling fury.

righteous clarity.name: Righteous Clarity
righteous clarity.description: Target yourself or an ally to additionally grant the target's proficiency bonus to their Attack Rolls.

roaring belch.name: Roaring Belch
roaring belch.description: Let out a colossal burp and possibly push nearby objects and creatures back 5 m / 17 ft.

rolan's colour spray.name: Rolan's Colour Spray
rolan's colour spray.description: Create an illustrious display of flashing lights to dazzle and Confuse creatures up to a combined 44 hit points .

rolan's fireball.name: Rolan's Fireball
rolan's fireball.description: Shoot a bright flame from your fingers that explodes upon contact, torching everything in the vicinity and Heating metal weapons and armour caught in the flames.

rolan's firestorm.name: Rolan's Firestorm
rolan's firestorm.description: Call upon Rolan, freed from the limitations of Lorroakan, to unleash a fiery barrage from the heights of Ramazith's Tower.

rolan's mage armour.name: Rolan's Mage Armour
rolan's mage armour.description: Grant a creature a rudimentary defensive boost, increasing its Armour Class by 2

rolan's magic missile.name: Rolan's Magic Missile
rolan's magic missile.description: Hurl a concentrated dart of magical force that can Daze the target.

rolan's thunderwave.name: Rolan's Thunderwave
rolan's thunderwave.description: Release a focused blast of thunderous force that pushes targets back 12 m / 40 ft and knocks them Prone .

rotting fist.name: Rotting Fist
rotting fist.description: Drive your fist into a foe and possibly afflict them with Mummy Rot.

rotting regurgitation.name: Rotting Regurgitation
rotting regurgitation.description: A sip from the Brewer's special booze causes him to vomit a necrotic fluid.

rupture.name: Rupture
rupture.description: Rupture the earth, causing debris to tear through nearby objects and creatures.

rush.name: Rush
rush.description: Charge forward and attack all enemies and objects in the way.

rush attack.name: Rush Attack
rush attack.description: Charge forward and attack the first enemy in your way, possibly pushing them Off Balance.

rush of the gale spirits.name: Rush of the Gale Spirits
rush of the gale spirits.description: Summon a strong wind that clears all clouds and pushes creatures back 5 m (17 ft), forcing them Off Balance.

sacred flame.name: Sacred Flame
sacred flame.description: Engulf a target in a flame-like radiance.

sacred munitions.name: Sacred Munitions
sacred munitions.description: Infuse your crossbow bolts with holy energy. For the rest of your turn, your ranged weapon attacks inflict Turned against undead.

sacred weapon.name: Sacred Weapon
sacred weapon.description: Turn your weapon into a Sacred Weapon . It has a higher chance of hitting, and emits a bright light.

sacrifice soul.name: Sacrifice Soul
sacrifice soul.description: Offer the soul of a recently killed humanoid to Vlaakith in return for heightened powers.

sanctuary.name: Sanctuary
sanctuary.description: You or an ally cannot be targeted until you attack or harm a creature. You can still take damage from area spells.

sanctuary of loss.name: Sanctuary of Loss
sanctuary of loss.description: Shield yourself or an ally from harm after they are attacked. This protection will wane when the protected creature attacks. Viconia can still use Heartwrench and keep this protection.

sanguine animation.name: Sanguine Animation
sanguine animation.description: Nearby Blood surfaces transform into Bloodmarrow Skeletons under your control.

sanguine lash.name: Sanguine Lash
sanguine lash.description: Sweep a warped appendage in front of you that Bleeds targets and knock them back 6ft.

sapping images.name: Sapping Images
sapping images.description: Creates magical effigies that steal 2 points of Charisma, Intelligence, and Wisdom from nearby targets.

sapping strike.name: Sapping Strike
sapping strike.description:
Strike a foe and create a magical effigy that steal 2 points of Charisma, Intelligence, and Wisdom from the target.
Destroying a mental effigy restores the ability points.

savage howl.name: Savage Howl
savage howl.description: Gather your pack. Each ally within earshot can move an additional 5 m / 17 ft during their next turn, and gains 20 temporary hit points

scare.name: Scare
scare.description: Lash at a creature to Frighten it.

scarlet feast.name: Scarlet Feast
scarlet feast.description: If you have a +3 bonus from Scarlet Remittance , consume it to empower yourself in combat.

scarlet regeneration.name: Scarlet Regeneration
scarlet regeneration.description: If you have a +3 bonus from Scarlet Remittance , consume it to recover 3d10 hit points .

scarlet saturation.name: Scarlet Saturation
scarlet saturation.description: If you have a +3 bonus from Scarlet Remittance , consume it to make your next attack a Critical Hit.

scarlet stupor.name: Scarlet Stupor
scarlet stupor.description: If you have a +3 bonus from Scarlet Remittance , consume it to give hostile creatures Disadvantage on Saving throws against your spells.

scorching ray.name: Scorching Ray
scorching ray.description: Hurl 3 rays of fire. Each ray deals 2d6 Fire damage.

scorching strike.name: Scorching Strike
scorching strike.description: Lash out with a blazing strike and possibly Burn your target.

seal wounds.name: Seal Wounds
seal wounds.description: Seal an ally's wounds shut, as if closing a door upon their pain.

searing blood.name: Searing Blood
searing blood.description: Cut into an enemy, dealing an extra Proficiency bonus Fire and 1d6 Fire damage to them, while you yourself take 1d6 Slashing damage. Additionally, the attack might cause the target to Bleed and Burn.

searing smite.name: Searing Smite
searing smite.description: Your weapon flares with white-hot intensity. It deals, on top of weapon damage, an extra 1d6 Fire damage and marks the target with Searing Smite.

second marriage.name: Second Marriage
second marriage.description: Summon the remains of Mayrina's husband.

second wind.name: Second Wind
second wind.description: Draw on your stamina to protect yourself. You regain 1d10 + Fighter Level Hit Points .

see invisibility.name: See Invisibility
see invisibility.description: Glimpse Invisible creatures, and possibly reveal them to others.

seeker matrix.name: Seeker Matrix
seeker matrix.description: Become able to see Invisible creatures, and possibly reveal them to others.

seething fury.name: Seething Fury
seething fury.description: Let the rage build within you. Once it overflows, you'll be able to attack multiple times per turn.

seismic strike.name: Seismic Strike
seismic strike.description: Bring down your arms like stone slabs, smashing nearby creatures, pushing them back 3m / 10ft, and making them wobble on Trembling Legs.

seismic wrath.name: Seismic Wrath
seismic wrath.description: Grym makes the earth quake and the ground roar - anything to eliminate intruders.

seize soul.name: Seize Soul
seize soul.description: Pull your warlock's enemy towards you up to 10 m / 33 ft.

self immolation.name: Self Immolation
self immolation.description: Set yourself on fire to gain Heat .

self-detonate.name: Self-Detonate
self-detonate.description: Explode in a burst of raging hellfire - eliminate all nearby wrongdoers.

self-detonation protocol.name: Self-Detonation Protocol
self-detonation protocol.description: As a last resort, initiate a countdown sequence that ends with Self-Detonation.

selûne's dream.name: Selûne's Dream
selûne's dream.description: An ally you touch regains 1d8 Hit Points , but possibly falls asleep.

sense hidden presence.name: Sense Hidden Presence
sense hidden presence.description: Search for Invisible creatures, possibly revealing them to others.

sethan: reduce.name: Sethan: Reduce
sethan: reduce.description:
Make a creature smaller.
Its weapons deal 1d4 less damage (minimum of 1 damage). It has Disadvantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws.

sethan: spiritual greataxe.name: Sethan: Spiritual Greataxe
sethan: spiritual greataxe.description: Summon a spiritual twin of Sethan in a point you can see, dealing 3d8 + 1 + Spellcasting modifier Force damage on a hit.

shadow arts: darkness.name: Shadow Arts: Darkness
shadow arts: darkness.description: Create a cloud of magical darkness that Heavily Obscures and Blinds creatures within. Creatures cannot make ranged attacks into or out of it.

shadow arts: darkvision.name: Shadow Arts: Darkvision
shadow arts: darkvision.description: Grant a creature the ability to see in the dark out to a range of 12 m / 40 ft.

shadow arts: hide.name: Shadow Arts: Hide
shadow arts: hide.description: Hide from enemies by succeeding at Stealth checks. Stick to the dark and avoid enemy sightlines. Attacking or casting a spell will reveal your location.

shadow arts: pass without trace.name: Shadow Arts: Pass Without Trace
shadow arts: pass without trace.description: Call forth a veil of shadow and silence that gives you and nearby allies a +10 bonus to Stealth checks.

shadow arts: silence.name: Shadow Arts: Silence
shadow arts: silence.description: Create a sound-proof sphere. All within are Silenced and immune to Thunder damage.

shadow pull.name: Shadow Pull
shadow pull.description: Whip a target with one of your vines and pull it 3 m / 10 ft towards you.

shadow spear.name: Shadow Spear
shadow spear.description: Deal an additional 4d12 Necrotic with your equipped melee weapon.

shadow step.name: Shadow Step
shadow step.description:
Teleport from shadow to shadow.
Afterwards, you have Advantage on your next melee Attack Roll.

shadow strike.name: Shadow Strike
shadow strike.description: Teleport to a foe from a hidden position, striking them with the creeping, psychic ferocity of the shadows themselves.

shadow strike: unarmed.name: Shadow Strike: Unarmed
shadow strike: unarmed.description: Teleport to a foe from a hidden position, striking them with the creeping, psychic ferocity of the shadows themselves.

shadow teleport.name: Shadow Teleport
shadow teleport.description: Teleport to a shadowy location. If you are Garrotte a creature, it teleports with you.

shadow teleportation.name: Shadow Teleportation
shadow teleportation.description: Teleport to an unoccupied, obscured spot.

shadow torrent.name: Shadow Torrent
shadow torrent.description: Call on the darkness to drag your target 6 m / 20 ft towards you.

shadow walk.name: Shadow Walk
shadow walk.description: Teleport into the shadows. The next spell you cast that turn will benefit from Distant Spell without costing any Sorcery Points.

shadowjaw bite.name: Shadowjaw Bite
shadowjaw bite.description: Sink your teeth into a target and possibly knock it Prone .

shadowslip.name: Shadowslip
shadowslip.description: The shadar-kai teleports to an unoccupied space it can see.

shadowsoaked blow.name: Shadowsoaked Blow
shadowsoaked blow.description: Strike an enemy, adding your proficiency bonus to the damage. Moreover, if the attack hits, it deals an additional 1d6 Psychic damage. This attack doesn't break concealment.

shadowy claws.name: Shadowy Claws
shadowy claws.description: Lash out with deadly claws and push the target back 1.5 m / 5 ft.

shar's aegis.name: Shar's Aegis
shar's aegis.description: Encase yourself with a shimmering field of magic that increases your Armour Class by 2.

shar's darkness.name: Shar's Darkness
shar's darkness.description: Create a dark shroud that Heavily Obscures and Blinds creatures within. Creatures cannot make ranged attacks into or out of it.

share untenable secret.name: Share Untenable Secret
share untenable secret.description: Share a secret with an ally to prevent the damage caused by Untenable Secret . The ally must pass a Wisdom Saving throw or is forced to pass on the secret to another ally.

shatter.name: Shatter
shatter.description: Damages all nearby creatures and objects.

shatter psyche.name: Shatter Psyche
shatter psyche.description: Invade a target's mind and disrupt its defences. The target's Armour Class and Saving throws are reduced by 2.

shatter psyche (full-illithid).name: Shatter Psyche (Full-illithid)
shatter psyche (full-illithid).description: The target's Armour Class is reduced by 6. All Saving throws are reduced by 5 and Disadvantage on Concentration Saving Throws.

shatter visage.name: Shatter Visage
shatter visage.description: Detonate a psionic visage, striking the attacker with a psychic wave that pushes it back 3 m / 10 ft.

shell of resistance.name: Shell of Resistance
shell of resistance.description: The Micromodron Force Curtain grants its target immunity to Thunder damage and resistance to elemental damage for one turn, along with an extra Bonus Action and 3 m / 10 ft extra movement speed.

shield.name: Shield
shield.description: When you are about to be hit by an enemy, use your Reaction to increase your Armour Class by 5. You also take no damage from Magic Missile. These effects last until the start of your next turn.

shield blow.name: Shield Blow
shield blow.description: When struck by a melee attack, your attacker must succeed a Dexterity Saving Throw or fall Prone.

shield of devotion: aid.name: Shield of Devotion: Aid
shield of devotion: aid.description: Heal yourself and increase your hit point maximum by 10 hit points.

shield of faith.name: Shield of Faith
shield of faith.description: Surround a creature with a shimmering field of magic that increases its Armour Class by 2.

shield of screams.name: Shield of Screams
shield of screams.description: Recall the voices of all who scorned you - and how they screamed in the end. They form a shield around you.

shield of thralls.name: Shield of Thralls
shield of thralls.description: Conjure a volatile shield around yourself or an ally, granting the target 10 temporary hit points.

shield shove.name: Shield Shove
shield shove.description: Shove a target with your shield to push it back.

shifting winds.name: Shifting Winds
shifting winds.description: Surrounded by silver mist, you teleport to an unoccupied space you can see.

shillelagh.name: Shillelagh
shillelagh.description:
Quarterstaff or Club Required.
Your staff or club becomes magical: it deals 1d8 + Spellcasting modifier Bludgeoning damage, and uses your Spellcasting modifier for Attack Rolls.

shocking grasp.name: Shocking Grasp
shocking grasp.description: The target cannot use Reactions. This spell has Advantage on creatures with metal Armour.

shocking overflow.name: Shocking Overflow
shocking overflow.description: Thisobald's unstable brew overflows, dealing 6d6 Lightning to surrounding enemies and empowering his allies with a Shocking Brew .

shooting spider companion.name: Shooting Spider Companion
shooting spider companion.description: Gain a beast companion that accompanies you on your adventures and fights alongside you.

shove.name: Shove
shove.description: Try to push your target away. Your chances depend on your Athletics, and are higher if you're hidden or invisible.

shred armour.name: Shred Armour
shred armour.description: Rip into a target's weaknesses, reducing their Armour Class by 2.

shredding scales.name: Shredding Scales
shredding scales.description: Expel crystalline scales outward, possibly causing targets to Bleed.

shroud self.name: Shroud Self
shroud self.description: Wrap yourself in shadows to become Invisible

sights of the seelie: summon deva.name: Sights of the Seelie: Summon Deva
sights of the seelie: summon deva.description: Conjure a Celestial Deva to fight alongside you. It can cast Wrathful Smite, Revivify, and Concussive Smash.

signalling cry.name: Signalling Cry
signalling cry.description: As its allies draw near, the creature informs them of its exact location.

silence.name: Silence
silence.description: Create a sound-proof sphere. All within are Silenced and Immune to Thunder damage.

silver harp squadron.name: Silver Harp Squadron
silver harp squadron.description: Summon elite Harper archers to provide ranged support from your back ranks.

silvered bulwark.name: Silvered Bulwark
silvered bulwark.description: Form an impenetrable barrier of moonlight around a target that follows them and makes all creatures within Immune to damage.

sinister howl.name: Sinister Howl
sinister howl.description: Push yourself and your pack beyond your limits, giving each member of the pack an additional Action.

sizzling cataclysm.name: Sizzling Cataclysm
sizzling cataclysm.description: Embrace Kereska's acid to gain resistance to Acid damage. Your acid spells deal additional Acid damage equal to your proficiency bonus.

slam.name: Slam
slam.description: Hit a target with your bare fists and infect it with the Crawling Gnaw .

slash the weak.name: Slash the Weak
slash the weak.description: Make an enemy Vulnerable to Slashing damage.

slashing flourish (melee).name: Slashing Flourish (Melee)
slashing flourish (melee).description: Attack up to 2 enemies at once.

slashing flourish (ranged).name: Slashing Flourish (Ranged)
slashing flourish (ranged).description: Attack up to 2 enemies at once.

slay.name: Slay
slay.description: Rake your malevolent claws across the body of your target.

slayer.name: Slayer
slayer.description: Manifest your savage compulsions and assume your sinuously deadly Slayer form. Your Slayer form has 98 hit points (increases to 153 hit points at level 10).

sleep.name: Sleep
sleep.description: Put creatures into a magical slumber. Select targets up to a combined 24 Hit Points.

sleet storm.name: Sleet Storm
sleet storm.description:
Call forth a storm that douses fire, creates an Ice surface, and forces spellcasters to succeed at a Concentration Saving throw in order to maintain Concentration.
Ice is a surface that is considered Difficult Terrain. Creatures moving through it have their Movement Speed halved, and will fall Prone on a failed Dexterity Saving throw.

slow.name: Slow
slow.description: Alter time around up to 6 enemies to Slow them. They won't get far, they can't do much, and they're easier to hit.

sludgy sling.name: Sludgy Sling
sludgy sling.description: Overwhelm creatures with painfully heavy sludge, miring the area around yourself in thick mud.

smouldering touch.name: Smouldering Touch
smouldering touch.description: Touch a foe with a heat like the bright core of a furnace, searing and Burning them.

sneak attack (melee).name: Sneak Attack (Melee)
sneak attack (melee).description: Deal an extra 1d6 damage to a foe you have Advantage against.

sneak attack (ranged).name: Sneak Attack (Ranged)
sneak attack (ranged).description: Deal an extra 1d6 damage to a foe you have Advantage against.

sobering realisation.name: Sobering Realisation
sobering realisation.description: Hit a Drunk target and sober them up by dealing bonus Psychic damage. On a successful hit, the monk also loses Life of the Party.

soil-clogged slam.name: Soil-Clogged Slam
soil-clogged slam.description: Punch a foe with a landslide's worth of force, leaving behind a residue of mud.

song of rest.name: Song of Rest
song of rest.description: Use your craft to soothe. You and your allies are revitalised as though you had taken a Short Rest.

sorrowful lash.name: Sorrowful Lash
sorrowful lash.description: Pulls the creature 3 m (10 ft) closer to you.

soul ascension.name: Soul Ascension
soul ascension.description: Create a column of writhing souls that transforms allied Cambions into Hellfire Cambions and deals 6d10 Necrotic to any non-fiend caught inside.

soul branding.name: Soul Branding
soul branding.description: Bestow the Absolute's flames on a creature. Its movement speed increases by 5 m (17 ft) and its next attack deals an additional 2d4 + 1 Fire damage.

soul drain.name: Soul Drain
soul drain.description: Drain the life force of an Infernally Stunned creature, restoring your hit points by half the damage dealt.

soul offering.name: Soul Offering
soul offering.description: Numb a creature's soul and offer it to Yeenoghu to prevent it from taking Bonus Actions or Reactions.

soul snare: heal.name: Soul Snare: Heal
soul snare: heal.description: Heal 10 hit points from catching a soul.

soulbreaker.name: Soulbreaker
soulbreaker.description: Rend the enemy's body and soul, dealing additional Psychic damage equal to your proficiency bonus, and possibly Stun them.

speak with animals.name: Speak with Animals
speak with animals.description: Gain the ability to comprehend and communicate with beasts.

speak with dead.name: Speak with Dead
speak with dead.description: Grant a semblance of life to a corpse, allowing it to answer questions.

spear thrust.name: Spear Thrust
spear thrust.description: Skewer a target upon your holy spike.

spectral aspect.name: Spectral Aspect
spectral aspect.description: Adopt your Spectral Aspect after being struck.

spell slot restoration.name: Spell Slot Restoration
spell slot restoration.description: Replenish an expended spell slot of any level.

sphere of elemental balance.name: Sphere of Elemental Balance
sphere of elemental balance.description:
Hurl a sphere of energy.
It deals 3d8 Thunder damage, or 2d8 Acid , Cold , Fire , Lightning or Poison damage and creates a surface.

sphere of elemental balance: acid.name: Sphere of Elemental Balance: Acid
sphere of elemental balance: acid.description: Hurl a sphere of energy that deals 2d8 Acid damage and creates an Acid surface.

sphere of elemental balance: cold.name: Sphere of Elemental Balance: Cold
sphere of elemental balance: cold.description: Hurl a sphere of energy that deals 2d8 Cold damage and creates an Ice surface.

sphere of elemental balance: fire.name: Sphere of Elemental Balance: Fire
sphere of elemental balance: fire.description: Hurl a sphere of energy that deals 2d8 Fire damage and creates a Fire surface.

sphere of elemental balance: lightning.name: Sphere of Elemental Balance: Lightning
sphere of elemental balance: lightning.description: Hurl a sphere of energy that deals 2d8 Lightning damage and creates an Electrified Water surface on impact.

sphere of elemental balance: poison.name: Sphere of Elemental Balance: Poison
sphere of elemental balance: poison.description: Hurl poisonous energy that damages the target and creates a bubbling surface to Poison creatures.

sphere of elemental balance: thunder.name: Sphere of Elemental Balance: Thunder
sphere of elemental balance: thunder.description: Hurl a sphere of energy that deals 3d8 Thunder damage.

spider queen's wrath.name: Spider Queen's Wrath
spider queen's wrath.description:
Gain one additional attack per turn. Increase Strength by 2, while Armour Class is reduced by 1.
Tactician Difficulty: Gain one additional attack per turn. Increase Strength by 2 and grant Resistance to physical damage.

spike growth.name: Spike Growth
spike growth.description:
Shape a piece of ground into hard spikes. A creature walking on the spikes takes 2d4 Piercing damage for every 1.5 m (5 ft) it moves.
The spikes are Difficult Terrain, halving a creature's Movement Speed.

spindleweb sanctuary.name: Spindleweb Sanctuary
spindleweb sanctuary.description:
Protect yourself from attackers in the Absolute's gaze. If you attack or harm another creature, the sanctuary shatters, dealing 3d8 Psychic to nearby creatures.
Until the affected entity attacks or harms another creature, it cannot be targeted by enemy attacks. However, it can still take damage from spells that influence a larger area.

spirit guardians.name: Spirit Guardians
spirit guardians.description: Call forth spirits to protect you.

spirit guardians: necrotic.name: Spirit Guardians: Necrotic
spirit guardians: necrotic.description: Call forth spirits to protect the area around you.

spirit guardians: radiant.name: Spirit Guardians: Radiant
spirit guardians: radiant.description: Call forth spirits to protect the area around you.

spiritual weapon.name: Spiritual Weapon
spiritual weapon.description: Summon a floating, spectral weapon that attacks your enemies alongside you.

spiteful suffering.name: Spiteful Suffering
spiteful suffering.description: Steep an enemy in the darkness that churns within you. The target takes 1d4 + Charisma Modifier Necrotic damage each turn and Attack Rolls against it have Advantage.

splinter shadow.name: Splinter Shadow
splinter shadow.description: When you are attacked by a melee attack that does not deal Radiant damage, splinter off a piece of yourself to spawn a new version from the shadows.

stage fright.name: Stage Fright
stage fright.description: Your targets have Disadvantage on Attack Rolls and take 2~12 Psychic damage each time they miss.

staggering smite.name: Staggering Smite
staggering smite.description: Possibly Stagger your target. It can't take reactions and is more likely to miss.

stand like stone.name: Stand Like Stone
stand like stone.description: Spend 1 turn of Force Conduit to become a strong bulwark that cannot be moved unwillingly.

star map: guiding bolt.name: Star Map: Guiding Bolt
star map: guiding bolt.description: The next attack roll against this target has Advantage.

starry form: archer.name: Starry Form: Archer
starry form: archer.description: A constellation of an archer appears on you. As a Bonus Action while in this Starry Form, you can cast Luminous Arrow.

starry form: chalice.name: Starry Form: Chalice
starry form: chalice.description: A constellation of a life-giving chalice appears on you. Whenever you cast a healing spell that consumes a spell slot, you can cast Chalice Healing.
