static overdrive.name: Static Overdrive
static overdrive.description: Emanate a static discharge that buffs nearby constructs and hurts all others.

steadfast strike.name: Steadfast Strike
steadfast strike.description: Slam into a foe, preventing them (and yourself) from being moved involuntarily.

stench.name: Stench
stench.description: Emit the stench of tomb mould and abattoirs to Nauseate nearby foes.

step of the wind: dash.name: Step of the Wind: Dash
step of the wind: dash.description: Double your movement speed. Jump no longer requires a Bonus Action.

step of the wind: disengage.name: Step of the Wind: Disengage
step of the wind: disengage.description: Move without triggering Opportunity Attacks. Jump no longer requires a Bonus Action.

stinking cloud.name: Stinking Cloud
stinking cloud.description: Create a cloud of gas so nauseating it prevents creatures from taking actions.

stoneskin.name: Stoneskin
stoneskin.description: Turn a creature's flesh hard as stone. It takes only half the damage of all non-magical Bludgeoning , Piercing , and Slashing damage.

stormheart nova.name: Stormheart Nova
stormheart nova.description: Blast the entire arena with an explosion of lightning, possibly Shocking your foes.

strength drain.name: Strength Drain
strength drain.description: Claw a foe's heart and possibly leech its Strength by 3. The target dies if its Strength is reduced to 0.

strength in numbers.name: Strength in Numbers
strength in numbers.description: As its allies draw near, the creature informs them of its exact location.

strengthened force tunnel.name: Strengthened Force Tunnel
strengthened force tunnel.description: Charge forward, pushing all objects and creatures in your path 4 m / 13 ft away from you.

strengthened shillelagh.name: Strengthened Shillelagh
strengthened shillelagh.description: Your staff or club becomes magical: it deals 4d8 Bludgeoning damage, and uses your Spellcasting Ability for Attack rolls.

strike of the guardian.name: Strike of the Guardian
strike of the guardian.description: Channel the power of your deity in your sword strike to protect the cleric that brought you into being.

stunning gaze.name: Stunning Gaze
stunning gaze.description:
Targets one creature it can see within 18 m (60 ft). The target must succeed a Wisdom Saving Throw or be Stunned until the end of its next turn.
Tactician difficulty: This action does not require concentration.

stunning strike (melee).name: Stunning Strike (Melee)
stunning strike (melee).description: Spend a Ki Point to deal normal weapon damage and possibly Stun the target.

stunning strike (unarmed).name: Stunning Strike (Unarmed)
stunning strike (unarmed).description: Spend a Ki Point to deal normal unarmed damage and possibly Stun the target.

sublimation.name: Sublimation
sublimation.description: Attempt to turn your enemies into solid gold .

subsume shadow.name: Subsume Shadow
subsume shadow.description: The Justiciar assumes their Umbral Form .

sudden rush.name: Sudden Rush
sudden rush.description: Increase your movement speed to 18 m / 60 ft. Moving no longer provokes Opportunity Attacks.

summon coin halberd.name: Summon coin halberd
summon coin halberd.description: Summon a coin halberd from a pile of gold to fight alongside you.

summon eternal debtor.name: Summon Eternal Debtor
summon eternal debtor.description: Summon an Eternal Debtor to fight for you.

summon gilded hellsboar.name: Summon Gilded Hellsboar
summon gilded hellsboar.description: Summon a boar, its tusks and tapered body agleam with gold, to fight alongside you.

summon mephit.name: Summon Mephit
summon mephit.description: Form a new Mephit from a Fire surface.

summon mephit (mud).name: Summon Mephit (Mud)
summon mephit (mud).description: Shape a mound of mud into a new mud mephit.

summon quothe the raven.name: Summon Quothe the Raven
summon quothe the raven.description: Summon a raven familiar that can Blind enemies with its beak.

sumptuous blood bath.name: Sumptuous Blood Bath
sumptuous blood bath.description: Slash open a foe's vital arteries. They start Bleeding , and the ensuing gush continuously heals your wounds.

sunbeam.name: Sunbeam
sunbeam.description: A beam of brilliant light sears and Blinds all creatures in its path.

supernatural attraction.name: Supernatural Attraction
supernatural attraction.description: You are part of a greater whole. Concentrate on your connection to teleport to another infected creature.

supreme sneak.name: Supreme Sneak
supreme sneak.description: Blend into the environment so completely that you become Invisible .

survival instinct.name: Survival Instinct
survival instinct.description: Infuse a creature with psionic force. If it reaches 0 Hit Points, it heals instead of falling Unconscious.

sweeping attack.name: Sweeping Attack
sweeping attack.description: Swing your weapon in a rapid, sweeping arc to attack multiple enemies at once. Roll your superiority die for damage.

sweeping cinder strike.name: Sweeping Cinder Strike
sweeping cinder strike.description: Expel fire from your outstretched hands and ignite anything flammable.

sweetplum gales.name: Sweetplum Gales
sweetplum gales.description: Coalesce the air in a fragrant but vicious whirlwind that Restrains those within.

sword of the silverlight.name: Sword of the Silverlight
sword of the silverlight.description: Summon Dame Aylin, Selûne's shining paladin, to join your side in battle.

symbiotic entity.name: Symbiotic Entity
symbiotic entity.description: Gain 4 temporary hit points per Druid level and deal an additional 1d6 Necrotic damage with weapon or unarmed attacks while you have them. Cast Halo of Spores with double damage.

synaptic consumption.name: Synaptic Consumption
synaptic consumption.description: Devour your foe, lowering all of their Ability Scores initially by 5, and by 1 each subsequent turn. Additionally, you regain 2~20 Hit Points per turn. This lasts for 5 turns, after which the target is left Prone

synaptic discharge.name: Synaptic Discharge
synaptic discharge.description: Expel a wave of telepathic energy.

tadpole charm.name: Tadpole Charm
tadpole charm.description: Channel the dark allure of the tadpole to Charm an enemy that attacks you, preventing them from attacking you until their next turn.

talk to the sentient amulet.name: Talk to the Sentient Amulet
talk to the sentient amulet.description: Speak with the consciousness lingering inside the Sentient Amulet.

targeting protocol: hellfire missiles.name: Targeting Protocol: Hellfire Missiles
targeting protocol: hellfire missiles.description: Prime and aim your Hellfire Missiles at a target to fire on your next turn.

tasha's hideous laughter.name: Tasha's Hideous Laughter
tasha's hideous laughter.description: Leave a creature Prone with laughter, without the ability to get up.

telekinesis.name: Telekinesis
telekinesis.description: Throw a creature or object up to 18 m (60 ft) with a thought. Once per turn, you can use Telekinesis again without expending a Spell Slot.

telekinetic thrust.name: Telekinetic Thrust
telekinetic thrust.description: Shove a target with your mind.

teleport to submersible.name: Teleport to Submersible
teleport to submersible.description: Teleport yourself and up to one ally back to the Submersible.

tempestuous magic: flight.name: Tempestuous Magic: Flight
tempestuous magic: flight.description: Fly to a nearby spot without receiving Opportunity Attacks.

tentacle whip.name: Tentacle Whip
tentacle whip.description: Lash out with a sleek, spinous tentacle.

terminate bulwark protocol.name: Terminate Bulwark Protocol
terminate bulwark protocol.description: End your Defensive Protocol: Bulwark and return to your normal combat calibration.

terrifying howl.name: Terrifying Howl
terrifying howl.description: Let out a blood-curdling howl that Frightens all beasts and humanoids that hear it.

terrifying visage.name: Terrifying Visage
terrifying visage.description: Accentuate your unnatural form, Frightening nearby creatures.

terror trepan.name: Terror Trepan
terror trepan.description: Bore into a foe's brain and Frighten them.

thaumaturgy.name: Thaumaturgy
thaumaturgy.description: Gain Advantage on Intimidation and Performance Checks.

the absolute's will.name: The Absolute's Will
the absolute's will.description: Use telekinesis to pull targets closer.

the blade least expected.name: The Blade Least Expected
the blade least expected.description: Hit a foe against whom you've got Advantage [See Notes] , dealing Sneak Attack damage.

the closed fist of bane.name: The Closed Fist of Bane
the closed fist of bane.description: Conjure the divine aspect of Bane the Accursed - a fist that hangs in the air until the end of the round before falling, crushing anyone under it for 12d10 Force damage.

the dead wastes.name: The Dead Wastes
the dead wastes.description: Open a necrotic rift from a new corpse that heals Undead 4d6 Hit Points and deals 4d6 Necrotic to living creatures at the start of their turns.

the watch (class action).name: The Watch (class action)
the watch (class action).description: Summon some of the City Watch's great weapon fighters to protect their home.

third eye: darkvision.name: Third Eye: Darkvision
third eye: darkvision.description: You gain the ability to see in the dark out to a range of 24 m (80 ft)

third eye: see invisibility.name: Third Eye: See Invisibility
third eye: see invisibility.description: Become able to see Invisible creatures, and possibly reveal them to others.

this won't hurt a bit.name: This Won't Hurt A Bit
this won't hurt a bit.description: Jab a foe with a syringe and Poison them.

thorn whip.name: Thorn Whip
thorn whip.description: Pulls the creature 3 m (10 ft) closer to you.

throat punch.name: Throat Punch
throat punch.description: Throw a ki-empowered punch to a foe's throat, wounding and possibly Dazing them, knocking them Prone, and Silencing them.

throw.name: Throw
throw.description: Throw a character or item from the world or your inventory.

throw stone.name: Throw Stone
throw stone.description: Throws a sharp stone at a foe.

thunderous smite.name: Thunderous Smite
thunderous smite.description: Your melee weapon rings with thunder as you strike, pushing your target 3 m (10 ft) away and possibly knocking them Prone.

thunderwave.name: Thunderwave
thunderwave.description: Release a wave of thunderous force that pushes away all creatures and objects in an area, while also dealing Thunder damage.

tiger's bloodlust.name: Tiger's Bloodlust
tiger's bloodlust.description: Lash out to attack up to 3 enemies at once. They each take half the damage your weapon usually deals and start to Bleed.

tightening orbit.name: Tightening Orbit
tightening orbit.description: Spend 1 turn of Force Conduit to pull every enemy in the radius toward you with damaging force.

timmask spores.name: Timmask Spores
timmask spores.description: Eject timmask spores that can Befuddle creatures.

tiny claws.name: Tiny Claws
tiny claws.description: Lash out with your tiny but deadly paws.

toll the dead.name: Toll the Dead
toll the dead.description: Ring the bell of impending doom. If the target is at full health, you deal 1d8 Necrotic damage instead.

topple.name: Topple
topple.description: Swipe at a creature to knock it Prone.

topple the big folk.name: Topple the Big Folk
topple the big folk.description: Deal additional damage equal to your proficiency bonus. On a hit, Large, Huge, or Gargantuan creatures take an additional 2d6 Slashing DRS damage and must succeed a Strength Saving Throw or fall Prone.

torrential undeath.name: Torrential Undeath
torrential undeath.description: Unleash a barrage of spiritual energy, granting undead Guardian Wraiths while haunting other creatures with Wrathful Spirits.

toss a coin.name: Toss a Coin
toss a coin.description: Show your appreciation for a wonderful performance.

touch of the storm.name: Touch of the Storm
touch of the storm.description: The target cannot use reactions. This spell has Advantage on creatures with metal armour.

transfuse health.name: Transfuse Health
transfuse health.description: Sacrifice half your remaining hit points to heal a target for the same amount.

transmuter's stone: acid resistance.name: Transmuter's Stone: Acid Resistance
transmuter's stone: acid resistance.description: Create a stone that grants the carrier Resistance to Acid damage.

transmuter's stone: cold resistance.name: Transmuter's Stone: Cold Resistance
transmuter's stone: cold resistance.description: Create a stone that grants the carrier Resistance to Cold damage.

transmuter's stone: constitution.name: Transmuter's Stone: Constitution
transmuter's stone: constitution.description: Create a stone that grants the carrier Proficiency in Constitution Saving Throws.

transmuter's stone: darkvision.name: Transmuter's Stone: Darkvision
transmuter's stone: darkvision.description: Create a stone that lets the carrier see in the dark out to a range of 12 m (40 ft). [See: Bugs]

transmuter's stone: fire resistance.name: Transmuter's Stone: Fire Resistance
transmuter's stone: fire resistance.description: Create a stone that grants the carrier Resistance to Fire damage.

transmuter's stone: lightning resistance.name: Transmuter's Stone: Lightning Resistance
transmuter's stone: lightning resistance.description: Create a stone that grants the carrier Resistance to Lightning damage.

transmuter's stone: speed.name: Transmuter's Stone: Speed
transmuter's stone: speed.description: Create a stone that increases the carrier's movement speed by 3 m (10 ft).

transmuter's stone: thunder resistance.name: Transmuter's Stone: Thunder Resistance
transmuter's stone: thunder resistance.description: Create a stone that grants the carrier Resistance to Thunder damage.

trephination.name: Trephination
trephination.description: Make a burr hole into an enemy's skull and possibly knock them Prone.

trident thrust.name: Trident Thrust
trident thrust.description: Plunge your glorious spikes into a target.

trip attack (melee).name: Trip Attack (Melee)
trip attack (melee).description: A powerful attack that possibly knocks the target Prone.

trip attack (ranged).name: Trip Attack (Ranged)
trip attack (ranged).description: A powerful shot that possibly knocks the target Prone.

true resurrection.name: True Resurrection
true resurrection.description: Resurrect a companion. They return to life with all their hit points.

true strike.name: True Strike
true strike.description: Gain Advantage on your next Attack Roll.

trumpet of blasting.name: Trumpet of Blasting
trumpet of blasting.description: Blast a cone of celestial noise from your trunk that knocks creatures Prone.

trumpet of sparkles.name: Trumpet of Sparkles
trumpet of sparkles.description: Blast forth a cone of celestial sparkles. Evil creatures have Disadvantage on the Saving Throw, and Good creatures take no damage. [See Notes]

tu'narath's embrace.name: Tu'narath's Embrace
tu'narath's embrace.description: Protect an ally that is targeted by an incapacitating condition [See Notes] with an Embrace that also grants 50 temporary hit points.

turn the faithless.name: Turn the Faithless
turn the faithless.description: Channel your Oath using ancient words to Turn nearby fey and fiends.

turn the tide.name: Turn the Tide
turn the tide.description: Shout out and heal all nearby non-enemy creatures.

turn the unholy.name: Turn the Unholy
turn the unholy.description: Turn nearby undead and fiends. They are forced to flee and cannot come close to you.

turn undead.name: Turn Undead
turn undead.description: Pray to Turn all undead that can see you.

twilit shroud.name: Twilit Shroud
twilit shroud.description: Fold twilight around yourself to become Hidden .

tyr's protection.name: Tyr's Protection
tyr's protection.description: Protect a creature from attacks: increases its Armour Class by 2.

tyrannical branding.name: Tyrannical Branding
tyrannical branding.description: Place a Tyrant's Curse on a target.

tyrant tongue.name: Tyrant Tongue
tyrant tongue.description: Grant an ally a +2 bonus on Intimidation checks.

tyrant's bindings.name: Tyrant's Bindings
tyrant's bindings.description:
Create heavy magical chains that bind to your targets, halving their Movement speed.
If the chains are still present at the beginning of your next turn, they break, dealing 8d8 Force damage to all targets.

umberlee's praise.name: Umberlee's Praise
umberlee's praise.description: Everyone around the caster is Charmed.

umbral ally.name: Umbral Ally
umbral ally.description: Transform a nearby corpse into a shadow that fights by your side.

umbral shroud.name: Umbral Shroud
umbral shroud.description: Wrap yourself in shadows to become Invisible if you are obscured.

umbral tangle.name: Umbral Tangle
umbral tangle.description: Trap your enemies in shadowy vines.

unarmed strike.name: Unarmed Strike
unarmed strike.description: Hit a target with your bare fists.

unnerving screech.name: Unnerving Screech
unnerving screech.description: Screech into your target's soul, wounding them and possibly making them Unnerved

unpetrification ray.name: Unpetrification Ray
unpetrification ray.description: Turn a Petrified creature back to its organic form.

unrelenting ferocity.name: Unrelenting Ferocity
unrelenting ferocity.description: Muster up your stamina to heal yourself.

unsettling visage.name: Unsettling Visage
unsettling visage.description: Exude pure terror, instilling Fear in your foes.

unshackling strike.name: Unshackling Strike
unshackling strike.description: Smite the magical bonds keeping a creature Restrained , Paralyzed , and Stunned , freeing it.

untenable secret.name: Untenable Secret
untenable secret.description: Inflict a mind-scarring secret upon a creature that it must pass on to an ally or receive damage after 1 turn.

ursine reinforcements.name: Ursine Reinforcements
ursine reinforcements.description: You summon an additional bear to fight alongside you.

urticating hairs.name: Urticating Hairs
urticating hairs.description: Eject barbed bristles at a target and possibly Blind it.

vacuum missile.name: Vacuum Missile
vacuum missile.description: Pierce a foe with a psychic dart and possibly drag other foes towards the target.

vampire bat form.name: Vampire Bat Form
vampire bat form.description: Channel your power as Vampire Ascendant and turn into a vampiric bat.

vampire bite.name: Vampire Bite
vampire bite.description: Suck the blood from a living creature to regain hit points. The target takes 2d4 Piercing damage, but not if it is Sleeping [See: Bugs] or you are Hiding.

vampiric shout.name: Vampiric Shout
vampiric shout.description: Vent a malevolent shout, wound nearby foes and healing yourself provided they're neither Constructs or Undead.

vampiric swarm.name: Vampiric Swarm
vampiric swarm.description: Call forth a swarm of vampire bats. Targets are pushed backwards 7 m (23 ft) and may become Swarmed.

vampiric touch.name: Vampiric Touch
vampiric touch.description: Touch an enemy to siphon their life force and regain half as many Hit Points.

vampiric vermin.name: Vampiric Vermin
vampiric vermin.description: Sink your teeth into a foe, hurting them and healing yourself.

veil of the weird.name: Veil of the Weird
veil of the weird.description: Channel Auntie Ethel's hag magic to render 5 creatures within range Invisible.

vengeful playmate.name: Vengeful Playmate
vengeful playmate.description: Envelop an area in The Wasting Quiet after one of your summoned shadows is destroyed.

vengeful strike.name: Vengeful Strike
vengeful strike.description: Lace your attack with all the vengeance hidden within you.

venomous bite.name: Venomous Bite
venomous bite.description: Bite a target and possibly Poison it.

venomous discharge.name: Venomous Discharge
venomous discharge.description: Spit out a venomous substance and possibly Poison those it hits.

venomous guilt.name: Venomous Guilt
venomous guilt.description: Unleash a roar that wounds and Poisons nearby foes.

venomous overflow.name: Venomous Overflow
venomous overflow.description: Thisobald's unstable brew overflows, dealing 6d6 Poison to surrounding enemies and empowering his allies with a Venomous Brew .

venomous regurgitation.name: Venomous Regurgitation
venomous regurgitation.description: A sip from the Brewer's special booze causes him to vomit a toxic fluid that can Poison those it hits.

versatile sneak attack.name: Versatile Sneak Attack
versatile sneak attack.description: Deal extra damage to a foe you have Advantage against.

vicious mockery.name: Vicious Mockery
vicious mockery.description: Insult a creature: it has Disadvantage on its next Attack roll .

virulent venom.name: Virulent Venom
virulent venom.description: Point your ringed finger at a target to make it vulnerable to Poison damage, unless it is immune to Poison damage.

voice of command.name: Voice of Command
voice of command.description: Command an ally in the Dark Lord's name, letting them channel Bane's Wrath.

voice of the circle.name: Voice of the Circle
voice of the circle.description: Grant an ally a +2 bonus on Persuasion checks.

volatile cluster.name: Volatile Cluster
volatile cluster.description:
Toss a cluster of 3 bombs that can possibly knock nearby creatures Prone.
Each bomb will explode in a Fiendish Flameblast

volley.name: Volley
volley.description: Fire a cascade of magical broadheads and bodkin arrows upon nearby foes.

vow of enmity.name: Vow of Enmity
vow of enmity.description: Gain Advantage on Attack Rolls against an enemy.

wail of loss.name: Wail of Loss
wail of loss.description: Malus Thorm has made all his assistants cast Wail of Loss simultaneously.

wall of fire.name: Wall of Fire
wall of fire.description: Create a blazing wall of fire, Burning anyone who dares stand too close. Deals Fire to anything that moves into or ends its turn in the area.

wall of ice.name: Wall of Ice
wall of ice.description: Raise a wall of solid ice that deals 10d6 Cold damage to anyone standing in its way.

wall of stone.name: Wall of Stone
wall of stone.description:
Raise a wall of non-magical, solid stone.
The wall can be created between any two points within range as long as there is a clear path between them. It is made up of Stone Pillars with 30 HP each, immune to Psychic and vulnerable to Force and Thunder damage. Pillars block movement and line of sight.

wall of thorns.name: Wall of Thorns
wall of thorns.description: Create a wall of pliable, twisting thorns surrounded by Entangling vines.

warden of vitality.name: Warden of Vitality
warden of vitality.description: While this aura lasts, you can cast Restore Vitality as a Bonus Action to heal yourself or nearby allies by 2d6 hit points .

warding bond.name: Warding Bond
warding bond.description: Ward an ally. They gain resistance to all damage, and a +1 bonus to their Armour Class and Saving Throws.

wasting overflow.name: Wasting Overflow
wasting overflow.description: Thisobald's unstable brew overflows, dealing 6d6 Necrotic to surrounding enemies and empowering his allies with a Wasting Brew .

watchful hunt.name: Watchful Hunt
watchful hunt.description: Observe your prey carefully, allowing you to interrupt their attacks and spells with a Blinding Ambush .

water whip.name: Water Whip
water whip.description: Possibly pulls a target 9 m / 30 ft toward you or knocks it Prone.

water whip: knock prone.name: Water Whip: Knock Prone
water whip: knock prone.description: Use the water whip to knock the target Prone.

water whip: pull.name: Water Whip: Pull
water whip: pull.description: Use the water whip to pull the target towards you.

weakening strike.name: Weakening Strike
weakening strike.description: Target an enemy's hands with a non-lethal attack and possibly inflict Weak Grip.

weapon bond.name: Weapon Bond
weapon bond.description: Ritually bind the weapon in your main hand. The weapon can't be knocked out of your hand, and it automatically returns to you when thrown.

web.name: Web
web.description:
Cover an area in thick, flammable webbing that can Enweb creatures within.
An ally can use its Help action to try and tear away the webs.

weird magic surge.name: Weird Magic Surge
weird magic surge.description: Draw on residual arcana after a spell is cast to create more illusory duplicates and shuffle yourself among them in a new position. A higher level spell will create more duplicates.

whip of shar.name: Whip of Shar
whip of shar.description: Strike at a creature with a shadow whip and pull it 5 m / 17 ft closer to you.

whirlwind attack.name: Whirlwind Attack
whirlwind attack.description: Strike out at all nearby foes, making separate Attack Rolls against each target.

wholeness of body.name: Wholeness of Body
wholeness of body.description: Regain half your Ki Points and enter a temporary state of Wholeness where you regain Ki Points and have an extra Bonus Action.

whossa large fellow?.name: Whossa Large Fellow?
whossa large fellow?.description: Grow in size to become stronger.

wicked coercion.name: Wicked Coercion
wicked coercion.description: Invade an enemy's mind and force them to join your side. They also take 2d4 Psychic immediately, and 1d6 Psychic per turn.

wild magic: action surge.name: Wild Magic: Action Surge
wild magic: action surge.description: You gain an additional action this turn.

wild magic: blur.name: Wild Magic: Blur
wild magic: blur.description: Each creature within 9 m (30 ft) becomes Blurred.

wild magic: bolt of light.name: Wild Magic: Bolt of Light
wild magic: bolt of light.description: Until the end of your Rage, you can shoot a Bolt of Light from your chest each turn.

wild magic: burning.name: Wild Magic: Burning
wild magic: burning.description: Each creature and item within 6 m (20 ft) starts burning and takes 1d6 Fire per turn.

wild magic: cambion.name: Wild Magic: Cambion
wild magic: cambion.description: Summon a cambion from the fiery nexus of the Nine Hells. It is hostile to everyone.

wild magic: cats and dogs.name: Wild Magic: Cats and Dogs
wild magic: cats and dogs.description: Each creature within 9 m (30 ft) is randomly transformed into either a cat or a dog.

wild magic: dark tendrils.name: Wild Magic: Dark Tendrils
wild magic: dark tendrils.description: Shadowy tendrils lash outwards from you. Each creature within 9 m (30 ft) of you must succeed a Constitution Saving Throw or take 1d12 Necrotic damage. Additionally, you gain 1d12 temporary hit points.

wild magic: enchant weapons.name: Wild Magic: Enchant Weapons
wild magic: enchant weapons.description: Enchant the weapon of each creature within 6 m (20 ft). Their next attack [See: Bugs] is a Critical Hit and deals an additional 1d4 Force .

wild magic: enlarge/reduce.name: Wild Magic: Enlarge/Reduce
wild magic: enlarge/reduce.description: Each creature within 9 m (30 ft) is randomly Enlarged or Reduced.

wild magic: entangle.name: Wild Magic: Entangle
wild magic: entangle.description: Create a vine surface around yourself, slowing down creatures, possibly Entangling them.

wild magic: explosive healing.name: Wild Magic: Explosive Healing
wild magic: explosive healing.description: When you hit a target with a spell, heal all creatures within 3 m / 10 ft for 1d4 hit points per Spell Slot level used.

wild magic: flight.name: Wild Magic: Flight
wild magic: flight.description: You can Fly until the end of the turn.

wild magic: fog.name: Wild Magic: Fog
wild magic: fog.description: Create a cloud of fog around yourself. Creatures within are Heavily Obscured and Blinded.

wild magic: intangible spirit.name: Wild Magic: Intangible Spirit
wild magic: intangible spirit.description: Until the end of your Rage, you can summon an Intangible Spirit each turn.

wild magic: magic retribution.name: Wild Magic: Magic Retribution
wild magic: magic retribution.description: You are protected by wild, vengeful magic. Enemies that hit you take 1d6 Force damage in retaliation.

wild magic: polymorph.name: Wild Magic: Polymorph
wild magic: polymorph.description: You are transformed into a beast.

wild magic: protective lights.name: Wild Magic: Protective Lights
wild magic: protective lights.description: You, and any allies within 3 m (10 ft) of you, have a +1 bonus to Armour Class.

wild magic: resilient sphere.name: Wild Magic: Resilient Sphere
wild magic: resilient sphere.description: Enclose yourself in an arcane sphere. You cannot be damaged by attacks or effects from outside the sphere, nor can you damage anything outside the sphere. Movement Speed is halved.

wild magic: shield.name: Wild Magic: Shield
wild magic: shield.description: Armour Class is increased by 5 and you are immune to the effects of Magic Missile

wild magic: sorcery points.name: Wild Magic: Sorcery Points
wild magic: sorcery points.description: Until the end of your next turn, each spell you cast restores Sorcery Points equal to its Spell Slot level.

wild magic: speak with animals.name: Wild Magic: Speak with Animals
wild magic: speak with animals.description: Gain the ability to comprehend and communicate with beasts.

wild magic: spike growth.name: Wild Magic: Spike Growth
wild magic: spike growth.description: Shape a piece of ground around yourself into hard spikes. A creature walking on the spikes takes 2d4 Piercing for every 1.5 m (5 ft) it moves.

wild magic: swap.name: Wild Magic: Swap
wild magic: swap.description: Swap positions with a target each time you cast a spell or cantrip.

wild magic: telekinesis.name: Wild Magic: Telekinesis
wild magic: telekinesis.description: Throw a creature or object up to 18 m (60 ft) with a thought. Once per turn, you can use Telekinesis again without expanding a spell slot.

wild magic: teleport.name: Wild Magic: Teleport
wild magic: teleport.description: As a bonus action, teleport up to 18 m (60 ft) to an unoccupied space you can see.

wild magic: teleport (sorcerer).name: Wild Magic: Teleport (Sorcerer)
wild magic: teleport (sorcerer).description: Until the end of your next turn, you can use a Bonus Action to teleport up to 9 m (30 ft).

wild magic: turn magic.name: Wild Magic: Turn Magic
wild magic: turn magic.description: At the start of each turn, trigger a random magical effect.

wild magic: vine growth.name: Wild Magic: Vine Growth
wild magic: vine growth.description: Flowers and vines spread outward from you in a radius of 5 m (17 ft) creating Difficult Terrain for everyone other than you.

wild magic: weapon infusion.name: Wild Magic: Weapon Infusion
wild magic: weapon infusion.description: Magic infuses your weapon. It deals an additional 1d6 Force damage and gains the Light and Thrown properties.

wild shape.name: Wild Shape
wild shape.description: Magically assume the shape of a beast.

wild shape: air myrmidon.name: Wild Shape: Air Myrmidon
wild shape: air myrmidon.description: Take the shape of an Air Myrmidon.

wild shape: badger.name: Wild Shape: Badger
wild shape: badger.description: Assume the shape of a giant badger that can Burrow into the ground. The badger has a starting health of 13 hit points that increases every two druid levels.

wild shape: bear.name: Wild Shape: Bear
wild shape: bear.description: Assume the shape of a polar bear that can Goad enemies into attacking it. The polar bear has a starting health of 30 hit points that increases every two druid levels.

wild shape: boar.name: Wild Shape: Boar
wild shape: boar.description: Take the shape of a Boar. It has 11 hit points.

wild shape: cat.name: Wild Shape: Cat
wild shape: cat.description: Take the shape of a cat that can avoid attention and Meow to distract enemies. It has 2 hit points.

wild shape: cave bear.name: Wild Shape: Cave Bear
wild shape: cave bear.description: Assume the shape of a cave bear that can Multiattack . The cave bear has a starting health of 36 hit points that increases every two druid levels.

wild shape: deep rothé.name: Wild Shape: Deep Rothé
wild shape: deep rothé.description: Assume the shape of a Deep Rothé that casts Dancing Lights (Deep Rothé) and Charges its enemies. The deep rothé has a starting health of 23 hit points that increase every two druid levels.

wild shape: dilophosaurus.name: Wild Shape: Dilophosaurus
wild shape: dilophosaurus.description: Take the shape of a dilophosaurus whose Corrosive Spit can dissolve a target's Armour Class.

wild shape: dire raven.name: Wild Shape: Dire Raven
wild shape: dire raven.description: Take the shape of a Dire Raven that can avoid attention and Blind enemies. It has 13 hit points.

wild shape: earth myrmidon.name: Wild Shape: Earth Myrmidon
wild shape: earth myrmidon.description: Take the shape of an Earth Myrmidon.

wild shape: fire myrmidon.name: Wild Shape: Fire Myrmidon
wild shape: fire myrmidon.description: Take the shape of a Fire Myrmidon.

wild shape: owlbear.name: Wild Shape: Owlbear
wild shape: owlbear.description: Take the shape of an Owlbear that can Rupture the ground and become Enraged.

wild shape: panther.name: Wild Shape: Panther
wild shape: panther.description: Take the shape of a panther that can Prowl around invisibly.

wild shape: sabre-toothed tiger.name: Wild Shape: Sabre-Toothed Tiger
wild shape: sabre-toothed tiger.description: Take the shape of a Sabre-Toothed Tiger that can Shred Armour and regenerate hit points.

wild shape: spider.name: Wild Shape: Spider
wild shape: spider.description: Assume the shape of of a giant spider that can Enweb enemies. The giant spider has a starting health of 20 hit points that increases every two druid levels.

wild shape: water myrmidon.name: Wild Shape: Water Myrmidon
wild shape: water myrmidon.description: Take the shape of a Water Myrmidon.

wild shape: wolf.name: Wild Shape: Wolf
wild shape: wolf.description: Assume the shape of a dire wolf that can Incite allies and Distract enemies. The dire wolf has a starting health of 18 hit points that increase every two druid levels.

wind walk.name: Wind Walk
wind walk.description: Transform yourself and all nearby party members into tiny clouds of mist to avoid attacks.

winter's breath.name: Winter's Breath
winter's breath.description: Exhale a freezing torrent of ice. Burning creatures undergo rapid cooling and become Brittle. Has no effect on inanimate objects.

witch bolt.name: Witch Bolt
witch bolt.description: Link yourself to a target with a bolt of lightning. Deal an additional 1d12 Lightning each turn by activating it.

withering gift.name: Withering Gift
withering gift.description: Give your Withering Life Force to another creature.

withering theft.name: Withering Theft
withering theft.description: Rob a creature of its life force and gain 20 temporary hit points.

withering touch.name: Withering Touch
withering touch.description: Touch a nearby creature and pour your fetid magic through its very soul.

woad's ensnaring strike.name: Woad's Ensnaring Strike
woad's ensnaring strike.description: Your attack summons thorny vines that possibly Ensnare your target.

wolf companion.name: Wolf Companion
wolf companion.description: Summon a wolf that can inflict devastating wounds and knock down enemies with its Lunging Bite.

wolf spider companion.name: Wolf Spider Companion
wolf spider companion.description: Summon a wolf spider that can shoot Webs and Poison enemies with its Bite.

worg companion.name: Worg Companion
worg companion.description: Gain a beast companion that accompanies you on your adventures and fights alongside you.

wounding ray.name: Wounding Ray
wounding ray.description: Shoot an eye ray that deals immense damage.

wrath of the storm: lightning.name: Wrath of the Storm: Lightning
wrath of the storm: lightning.description: Conflagrate a foe with electric bolts.

wrath of the storm: thunder.name: Wrath of the Storm: Thunder
wrath of the storm: thunder.description: Conflagrate a foe with electric bolts.

wrathful smite.name: Wrathful Smite
wrathful smite.description: Your weapon absorbs your wrath as you strike, possibly Frightening your target.

writhing tide.name: Writhing Tide
writhing tide.description: Condense part of your swarm into a mass that lifts you up. Gain a flying speed of 9 m / 30 ft and become unaffected by surface effects.

zephyr break.name: Zephyr Break
zephyr break.description: Zephyr Break imitates the effects of the spell Gust of Wind while dealing thunder damage.

zephyr flash.name: Zephyr Flash
zephyr flash.description: Rush forward, creating an air vortex that blasts foes and possibly inflicts Bleeding.
